local event_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Main/FireWorld/Dokkaebi/Event/EventBase')

---@field super FireWorldDokkaebiEventBase
---@class FireWorldDokkaebiEvent15 : FireWorldDokkaebiEventBase
local first_dokkaebi_event = newclass('FireWorldDokkaebiEvent15', event_base)

---@field super FireWorldDokkaebiEventBase
---@class FireWorldDokkaebiEvent16 : FireWorldDokkaebiEventBase
local second_dokkaebi_event = newclass('FireWorldDokkaebiEvent16', event_base)

---@field super FireWorldDokkaebiEventBase
---@class FireWorldDokkaebiEvent17 : FireWorldDokkaebiEventBase
local third_dokkaebi_event = newclass('FireWorldDokkaebiEvent17', event_base)

---@field super FireWorldDokkaebiEventBase
---@class FireWorldDokkaebiEvent18 : FireWorldDokkaebiEventBase
local fourth_dokkaebi_event = newclass('FireWorldDokkaebiEvent18', event_base)

---@field super FireWorldDokkaebiEventBase
---@class FireWorldDokkaebiEvent19 : FireWorldDokkaebiEventBase
local fifth_dokkaebi_event = newclass('FireWorldDokkaebiEvent19', event_base)

--region 2번 은하 (index 15)
function first_dokkaebi_event:init(main_section)
	self.super:init(main_section)
	self.index = 15
	self.is_complete = self.controller:is_search_dokkaebi(self.index)

	-- 란팡
	self.get_doll_girl = function()
		return get_character('doll_girl')
	end

	local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_dokkaebi_event_pos_1')

	local doll_girl = self.get_doll_girl()
	scene_util.set_direction(doll_girl, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(doll_girl, self, 'tired')
	character_util.set_position(doll_girl, pos - vector(1, 0, 0))
	field_object_util.set_active_state(doll_girl, active_state_type.enabled)

	-- 이미 깬 상태라면 세팅하지 않는다.
	if self.is_complete then
		scene_util.set_anim(doll_girl, self, { name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false })
		doll_girl.Interactable.Talk = 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_7'
		return
	end

	-- 은하 세팅
	-- 2번 은하 (left, attack, idle)
	self.super:set_dynamic_dokkaebi({
		emotion = 'attack',
		dir = 'left', pos = pos
	})

	-- 란팡 (right, tired, cast)
	scene_util.set_anim(doll_girl, self, 'cast')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function first_dokkaebi_event:start()
	local doll_girl = self.get_doll_girl()
	field_object_util.set_active_state(doll_girl, active_state_type.enabled)
end

function first_dokkaebi_event:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.super:dispose()
end

function first_dokkaebi_event:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function first_dokkaebi_event:on_interact_event(e)
	local dokkaebi = self.super:get_dokkaebi()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, dokkaebi) then
		if self.cur_state == self.state.step_2 then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_dokkaebi, self, dokkaebi)
		else
			sp_util.start_scene(self.absorb_dokkaebi, self, dokkaebi)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function first_dokkaebi_event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.cur_state == self.state.step_1 and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_dokkaebi_1_trigger_zone') then
		self.cur_state = self.state.step_2
		start_coroutine(self.show_dokkaebi_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 비강제 트리거존 존 엔터시 통제 빼앗지 않고 이벤트 진행한다.
function first_dokkaebi_event:show_dokkaebi_scene()
	-- 플레이어가 비강제 트리거존에 접촉시 아래 대화이벤트가 진행된다.
	local dokkaebi = self.super:get_dokkaebi()
	local doll_girl = self.get_doll_girl()

	-- 란팡 (right, tired, cast) : 꼬마도깨비군. 아까 말했던 사악한 계획 말인데….
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', play_pos = doll_girl.Position })
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(doll_girl, 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_1', false)

	-- 2번 은하 (left, attack, idle) : 싫어! 싫거든!?
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_ghost_detect_01', play_pos = dokkaebi.Position })
	self:show_portrait_speech_async(dokkaebi, 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_2', false)

	-- 2번 은하 (left, attack, cast2) : 왜 아직까지 졸졸 따라오는거야?
	self:play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, nil, 'cast2', nil,
			{ key = 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_3', skip = false })

	-- 란팡 (right, attack, cast2) : 나랑 같이 비밀작전을 해주겠다고 약속하지 않았나!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_angry_01', play_pos = doll_girl.Position })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(doll_girl, self, nil, 'cast2',
			'attack', { key = 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_4', skip = false })

	-- 2번 은하 (left, attack, cast2) : 몰라! 주민들은 너나 실컷구해! 난 축제 구경할 거니까!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_die_ant_01', play_pos = dokkaebi.Position })
	self:play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, nil, 'cast2', nil,
			{ key = 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_5', skip = false })

	-- 란팡 (right, tired, cross_arm) : 당해낼 수 없는 꼬맹이구만… 이를 어쩐다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(doll_girl, self, nil,
			{ name = 'cross_arm', keep = true },
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			{ key = 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_6', skip = false })

	-- 동태  (left, tired, dead 1회, 마지막 프레임 유지) 상태, 마지막 대사 반복하는 원라인 npc 된다.
	doll_girl.Interactable.Talk = 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_7'

	-- 2번 은하 상호작용 활성화
	dokkaebi.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

function first_dokkaebi_event:interact_dokkaebi(dokkaebi)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	-- 2번 은하 인터렉트 시, 컨트롤 빼앗는다.
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	-- 1초에 걸쳐 플레이어 walk 적용, 위 위치로 정렬한다.
	party_util.align_party(dokkaebi.Position, 'right', 1, 'arc')

	-- 도착 후 플레이어 (left, idle, release 2회) async
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 2번 은하 (right, attack, idle) : 넌 또 뭐야?! 헤실헤실하게 생겨선!
	self:play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, 'right', nil,
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_12')

	local function directing_game_over()
		-- 플레이어 (left, tired,  frustration 1회, 마지막 프레임 유지) async
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, {
			name = 'frustration', loop = false, keep_anim = true, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01'
		})

		-- 0.5초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 나레이션 : 은하의 독설에 기가 죽었다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_32' })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
	end

	-- (mercy) 모시러 왔습니다. 아가씨.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_13', 'mercy' },
		{ 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_14', 'brutal' },
	})

	if choose_result ~= 1 then
		-- (brutal) 난 버릇 없는 꼬마가 제일 싫어!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast2')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		-- 2번 은하 (right, attack, idle)  : 갑자기 들이닥쳐선 뭐라는 거야?!
		self:play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, nil, nil,
				nil, 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_17')

		-- 2번 은하 (right, attack, attack 3회)  : 바보! 멍청이!
		self:play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, nil, { name = 'attack', count = 3 },
				nil, 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_18')

		directing_game_over()
		return
	end

	-- (mercy) 모시러 왔습니다. 아가씨.

	-- 플레이어 (left, smile, release 2회) async
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 2번 은하 (right, smile, cast) : 아… 아가씨?!
	self:play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, nil, 'cast',
			'smile', 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_15')

	-- 2번 은하 (right, doyagao, cross_arm) : 흠흠, 그래. 내가 한 교양 하지.
	self:play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, nil,
			{ name = 'cross_arm', keep = true },
			{ name = 'doyagao', keep = true }, 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_16')

	-- (brutal) 가람, 나리! 와서 이 녀석 좀 어떻게 해봐!
	-- (intellect) 제가 과자 파티를 준비했어요!
	choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_19', 'brutal' },
		{ 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_20', 'intellect' },
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cross_arm')
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		-- 2번 은하 (right, attack, idle) : 흥, 그래봤자 소용 없거든?
		character_util.remove_anim(dokkaebi)
		self:play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, nil, nil,
				{ name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_21')

		-- 2번 은하 (right, attack, attack 3회) : 바보! 멍청이!
		self:play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, nil, { name = 'attack', count = 3 },
				nil, 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_22')

		directing_game_over()
		return
	end

	-- (intellect) 제가 과자 파티를 준비했어요!

	-- 플레이어 (left, smile, cast2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast2')

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 2번 은하 (right, smile, sing) : 뭐어? 과자 파티라구?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_die_ant_01')
	self:play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, nil, 'sing',
			'smile', 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_23')

	-- 2번 은하 (right, doyagao, cross_arm) : 흠흠, 파티장소는 어디에 있는데?
	self:play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, nil,
			{ name = 'cross_arm', keep = true },
			{ name = 'doyagao', keep = true }, 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_24')

	-- (forced) 그동안 내가 얼마나 도와줬는데, 배은망덕하긴!
	-- (mercy) 파티장소로 가실까요?
	choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_25', 'brutal' },
		{ 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_26', 'intellect' },
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'mad')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'jingak', count = 1, sfx_name = '02_hit_projectile_01' })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		-- 2번 은하 (right, attack, cast2) : 어쩌라고! 내 알 바 아니거든?!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_detect_01')
		self:play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, nil, 'cast2',
				{ name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_27')

		-- 2번 은하 (right, attack, attack 3회) : 바보! 멍청이!
		self:play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, nil, { name = 'attack', count = 3 },
				nil, 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_28')

		directing_game_over()
		return
	end

	-- (mercy) 파티장소로 가실까요?

	-- 플레이어 (left, smile, question 1회, 마지막프레임 유지) async
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'question', keep_anim = true })

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 2번 은하 (right, doyagao, cast) : 흐흥…
	self:play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, nil, 'cast',
			{ name = 'doyagao', keep = true }, 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_29')

	-- 2번 은하 (right, doyagao, nod 2회) : 너는 저 멍청이보다는 나은 녀석 같네.
	self:play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, nil, { name = 'nod', count = 2 },
			nil, 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_30')

	-- 2번 은하 (right, doyagao, release 2회) : 뭐, 이번 한 번만 어울려 줄게.
	self:play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, nil, { name = 'release', count = 2 },
			nil, 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_31')

	-- 2번 은하 (right, doyagao, idle)

	-- 흡수 가능 상태로 전환
	self.cur_state = self.state.step_3
	self:set_twinkle_effect()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function first_dokkaebi_event:absorb_dokkaebi(dokkaebi)
	self.is_complete = true
	self:dispose_twinkle_effect()

	-- 은하 흡수 연출 시작
	self.controller:absorb_dokkaebi(dokkaebi, self.index, nil, 'right')

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	-- 이벤트에서 사용한 은하 dispose
	self:dispose_dokkaebi()
end
--endregion 2번 은하 (index 15)

--region 17번 은하 (index 16)
function second_dokkaebi_event:init(main_section)
	self.super:init(main_section)
	self.index = 16
	self.is_complete = self.controller:is_search_dokkaebi(self.index)

	-- 이미 깬 상태라면 세팅하지 않는다.
	if self.is_complete then
		return
	end

	-- 은하 세팅
	-- 17번 은하 붉은 틴트 20% 상태
	-- 17번 은하 (left, smile, seat)
	self.super:set_dynamic_dokkaebi({
		emotion = 'smile', anim = 'seat',
		dir = 'left', pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_dokkaebi_event_pos_2')
	})

	-- 은하 상호작용 가능하도록
	local dokkaebi = self.super:get_dokkaebi()
	character_util.add_color(dokkaebi, dokkaebi.Name, unity_class.color.red, 0.3, 0)
	dokkaebi.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	dokkaebi.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.01)

	-- InteractEvent 구독
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
end

function second_dokkaebi_event:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.super:dispose()
end

function second_dokkaebi_event:on_event(e)
	local dokkaebi = self.super:get_dokkaebi()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, dokkaebi) then
		-- 첫번째 인터렉트 시
		if self.cur_state == self.state.step_1 then
			self.cur_state = self.state.step_2
			start_coroutine(self.first_interact_dokkaebi, self, dokkaebi)
		else
			sp_util.start_scene(self.absorb_dokkaebi, self, dokkaebi)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function second_dokkaebi_event:first_interact_dokkaebi(dokkaebi)
	dokkaebi.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	-- 17번 은하 (left, smile, seat) : 히끅… 여기는 공기가 매캐하고 어지러워요….
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_die_ant_01', play_pos = dokkaebi.Position })
	self:show_portrait_speech_async(dokkaebi, 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_33', false)

	-- 17번 은하 (left, smile, seat) : 히끅…!
	self:show_portrait_speech_async(dokkaebi, 'fw_sub_dokkaebi_s1_stage4_34', false)

	-- 흡수 가능 상태로 전환
	self:set_twinkle_effect()
	dokkaebi.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

function second_dokkaebi_event:absorb_dokkaebi(dokkaebi)
	self.is_complete = true
	self:dispose_twinkle_effect()

	-- 은하 흡수 연출 시작
	self.controller:absorb_dokkaebi(dokkaebi, self.index, nil, 'left', 'linear')

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	-- 이벤트에서 사용한 은하 dispose
	self:dispose_dokkaebi()
end
--endregion 17번 은하 (index 16)

--region 18번 은하 (index 17)
function third_dokkaebi_event:init(main_section)
	self.super:init(main_section)
	self.index = 17
	self.is_complete = self.controller:is_search_dokkaebi(self.index)

	-- 이미 깬 상태라면 세팅하지 않는다.
	if self.is_complete then
		return
	end

	-- 은하 세팅
	-- 18번 은하 (down, smile, idle)
	self.super:set_dynamic_dokkaebi({
		emotion = 'smile',
		dir = 'down', pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_dokkaebi_event_pos_3')
	})

	-- 은하 상호작용 가능하도록
	local dokkaebi = self.super:get_dokkaebi()
	dokkaebi.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	-- InteractEvent 구독
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
end

function third_dokkaebi_event:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.super:dispose()
end

---@class LaboseWorldScreenplayManager
local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldScreenplayManager')

function local_class:init()
	self.process_requester = {
		current_process_id = 0,
		next_process_id = 0,

		create_process_id = function(this)
			local id = this.next_process_id

			this.next_process_id = this.next_process_id + 1

			return id
		end,
		end_process = function(this, id)
			if id ~= this.current_process_id then
				logger_util.error('Ending screenplay Id [Value : ' .. id ..
						'] does not match with current processing Id [Value : ' .. this.current_process_id .. '')
				return
			end

			this.current_process_id = this.current_process_id + 1
		end,
		has_process = function(this)
			return this.next_process_id ~= this.current_process_id
		end,
		is_my_turn = function(this, id)
			return this.current_process_id == id
		end
	}
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:start_scene_delayed(func, ...)
	local id = self.process_requester:create_process_id()
	local args = { ... }

	-- FIXME : Finally를 쓰면 R키 눌러도 문제가 없나...?
	local coroutine = start_coroutine(function()
		while not self.process_requester:is_my_turn(id) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		local cached_leader = get_party_leader()

		sp_util.enter_scene()

		func(table.unpack(args))

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, cached_leader)
	end):Finally(function()
		self.process_requester:end_process(id)
	end)

	return coroutine
end

function local_class:try_start_scene(func, ...)
	if self.process_requester:has_process() then
		return false, nil
	end

	local id = self.process_requester:create_process_id()

	-- FIXME : Finally를 쓰면 R키 눌러도 문제가 없나...?
	local coroutine = sp_util.start_scene(func, ...):Finally(function()
		self.process_requester:end_process(id)
	end)

	return true, coroutine
end

function local_class:start_coroutine_delayed(func, ...)
	local id = self.process_requester:create_process_id()
	local args = { ... }

	-- FIXME : Finally를 쓰면 R키 눌러도 문제가 없나...?
	local coroutine = start_coroutine(function()
		while not self.process_requester:is_my_turn(id) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		func(table.unpack(args))

	end):Finally(function()
		self.process_requester:end_process(id)
	end)

	return coroutine
end

function local_class:try_start_coroutine(func, ...)
	if self.process_requester:has_process() then
		return false, nil
	end

	local id = self.process_requester:create_process_id()

	-- FIXME : Finally를 쓰면 R키 눌러도 문제가 없나...?
	local coroutine = start_coroutine(func, ...):Finally(function()
		self.process_requester:end_process(id)
	end)

	return true, coroutine
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldOtherSideBackgroundAttacher')

function local_class:init()
	self.res_holder = nil

	self.background_objects = {}

	self.grid_to_bg_key = {}
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WatchingCameraGridChangedEvent))

	if self.background_objects ~= nil then
		for _, obj in pairs(self.background_objects) do
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(obj)
		end

		self.background_objects = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

function local_class:load_async()
	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		return
	end

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local all_constants = require('Quest/Main/LaboseWorld/Common/OtherSideBackgroundAttacherConstants')
	local stage_constants = all_constants[stage.Name]
	local has_grid_condition = false

	for key, constants in pairs(stage_constants) do
		local obj = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder,
				constants.asset.path, constants.asset.name, stage_camera.Transform)

		obj.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		obj.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
		obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity

		if constants.active_grid_names ~= nil then
			for _, grid_name in pairs(constants.active_grid_names) do
				self.grid_to_bg_key[grid_name] = key
			end

			has_grid_condition = true
		end

		self.background_objects[key] = obj
	end

	if has_grid_condition then
		message_system:Subscribe(self,
				typeof(CS.Oak.WatchingCameraGridChangedEvent), 'on_watching_camera_grid_changed_event')
	end
end

function local_class:on_watching_camera_grid_changed_event(e)
	if e.CameraGrid == nil then
		return false
	end

	local target_key = self.grid_to_bg_key[e.CameraGrid.name]

	-- nil이면 전부 꺼질 것임
	self:switch_background(target_key)

	return true
end

function local_class:set_active(key, enabled)
	self.background_objects[key]:SetActive(enabled)
end

function local_class:switch_background(activate_target_key)
	for key, obj in pairs(self.background_objects) do
		obj:SetActive(activate_target_key == key)
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

function local_class:dispose()

	if not is_unity_null(self.tint_object) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.tint_object)

		self.tint_object = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

function local_class:load_async()
	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		return
	end

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	self.tint_object = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder,
			'ondemand/v2_75_civilwar/theatres/background', 's1_sky_black_tint_background')

	self.tint_renderer = self.tint_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer))

	self.tint_object.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 40
	self.tint_object:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:set_position(target_pos)
	self.tint_object.transform.position = target_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * 7
end

function local_class:fade_async(from, to, duration)
	self.tint_object:SetActive(true)

	if from == nil then
		from = self.tint_renderer.color.a
	else
		self.tint_renderer.color = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, from })
	end

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		self.tint_renderer.color = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, from * (1 - progress) + to * progress })

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.tint_renderer.color = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, to })

	if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
		self.tint_object:SetActive(false)
	end
end

function local_class:set_sorting_layer(layer, order)
	if layer ~= nil then
		self.tint_renderer.sortingLayerName = layer
	end

	if order ~= nil then
		self.tint_renderer.sortingOrder = order
	end
end

function local_class:sort_npc_to_upper(npc)
	npc.SpineController:SetSortingLayer(self.tint_renderer.sortingLayerName, self.tint_renderer.sortingOrder + 2)
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

	return field_util.get_marker_pos(self:get_name(postfix))
end

function local_class:get_battle_group_name(postfix)
	return self:get_name(postfix)
end

function local_class:close_battle_gates()
	for i = 1, self.battle_gate_count do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self:get_name('battle_gate_' .. i)))
	end
end

function local_class:get_battle_zone_name(postfix)
	if postfix ~= nil then
		return self:get_name('battle_' .. postfix)
	else
		return self:get_name('battle')
	end
end

function local_class:load_dynamic_npcs(spec_data)
	if self.dynamic_npcs ~= nil then
		return
	end

	local spec_data_with_prefix = {}

	for npc_name, npc_spec_name in pairs(spec_data) do
		spec_data_with_prefix[self:get_name(npc_name)] = npc_spec_name
	end

	self.dynamic_npcs = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(spec_data_with_prefix)

	for _, npc in pairs(self.dynamic_npcs) do
		self:fade_in_character(npc, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:get_dynamic_npc(npc_name)
	return self.dynamic_npcs[self:get_name(npc_name)]
end

function local_class:dispose_dynamic_npcs()
	if self.dynamic_npcs == nil then
		return
	end

	load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.dynamic_npcs)
	self.dynamic_npcs = nil
end

function local_class:enter_battle_room_routine()
	if self:is_cleared() then
		logger_util.error('cannot restart boss battle with [' .. self.boss_key .. '].')

		return
	end

	self:get_entrance().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	local knight = get_party_leader()

	--기사는 공주 바라보고 있는다.
	character_util.set_position(knight, self:get_marker_pos('knight_align'))
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'left')

	local princess = self:get_princess()

	--공주는 챔피언소드의 왼쪽 1칸 위치에.
	character_util.set_position(princess, knight.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')

	--카메라 포커스는 기사에게 있는 상태로 -> 리더에게 카메라가 붙어있는 상황일 것이라 추가 처리 필요하지 않음

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	if self.battle_controller_key ~= self.default_key_value then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, {
			self.battle_controller_key,
			'activate',
		}))
	end

	self.cs_controller.CurrentLuaSection:before_battle_scene()

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

function local_class:opening_start_scene(focus_target, fade_npcs, data)
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self:get_princess()
	local tint_controller = self:get_or_create_tint_controller_async()

	do
		local duration = 0.7

		for _, npc in pairs(fade_npcs) do
			self:fade_out_character(npc, duration)
		end

		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end

	self:fade_out_character(princess, 0)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.7, unity_class.color.white)

	--기사 몸에 FX_FireLv2Mega_proj_meshtype_bounce_blue 배치, 0.3초 대기, FX_FireLv2Mega_proj_meshtype_bounce_blue 재배치.
	--기사 이펙트 배치할 때마다 0.2초간 스파인 shake.
	do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_immune_01')
		self.fx.sword_fx():Instantiate(knight.Position)

		scene_util.shake(knight, 0.03, 0.2)

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_immune_01')
		self.fx.sword_fx():Instantiate(knight.Position)

		scene_util.shake(knight, 0.03, 0.2)

		wait_for_sec(0.3)
	end

	--기사 left, attack, idle, jump 1회
	--0.5초 대기
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(knight, '01_small_jump_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--기사 left, attack, eat 1초
	do
		local eat_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop =true, type_priority = 'event'
		})
		scene_util.play_wait_action(
				knight,
				self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				{name = 'eat'},
				'attack',
				1
		)

		music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_sound)
	end

	--기사 left, attack, staff_idle로 챔피언소드 손에 든다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_sword_short_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(knight, '[base]weapon1', 'champion_sword')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'staff_idle')

	--공주가 기사 옆에 깜빡 거리며 나타난다.
	--공주 right, attack, push로 기사가 든 챔피언소드와 닿아있는 형태로 등장.
	--공주 등장 완료한 후, 속도 1로 뒷걸음질 쳐 기사와 1칸 떨어진 거리에 선다.
	--이후에도 기사는 계속 챔피언소드 들고 있는 상태로.
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, 'push')

	princess.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)

	local princess_pos = knight.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_position(princess, princess_pos)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_champ_sword_06')
	do
		local duration = 0.5

		self:fade_in_character(princess, duration)
		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end

	--0.2초 대기후,
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--0.3초만에 알파 페이드 아웃으로 사라진다.
	do
		local duration = 0.3

		self:fade_out_character(princess, duration)
		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end

	--다시 0.3초 대기한 후,
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--0.5초만에 알파 0.6까지 페이드 인 된다.
	do
		local duration = 0.5

		self:fade_in_character(princess, duration)
		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

	local princess_move_pos = princess.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)

	wp_util.move_async(princess, princess_move_pos, 1, nil, { locked_dir = 'right' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--카메라 shake 1초간 하면서, 동시에 1초간 필드 0.7정도로 어둡게 틴트.
	do
		local tint_sorting_layer = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'tint_sorting_layer', 'Top Effects')
		local tint_sorting_order = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'tint_sorting_order', -100)

		tint_controller:set_sorting_layer(tint_sorting_layer, tint_sorting_order)
		tint_controller:set_position(knight.Position)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_priscilla_cast_02')
		camera_util.shake(0.15, 1)
		field_util.tint(self.tint_key, unity_color({ 0.55, 0.55, 0.55, 1 }), 1)

		tint_controller:fade_async(0, 0.7, 1)

		for _, npc in pairs(fade_npcs) do
			tint_controller:sort_npc_to_upper(npc)
		end
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--이후, 기사 공주 up 바라봄과 동시에
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'up', false)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(princess, 'up', false)

	do
		local duration = 1

		if data ~= nil and data.camera_size ~= nil then
			-- 볼트 연출에서 여러 카메라 해상도에서 상하 높이가 같도록 처리하기 위해 ratio 기능 사용하지 않음
			camera_util.resize_to(data.camera_size, duration)
		end

		camera_util.move_async(focus_target, duration)
	end

	do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')

		local duration = 0.7

		for _, npc in pairs(fade_npcs) do
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1, duration)
		end

		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end
end

function local_class:fade_out_character(character, duration)
	if duration == nil or duration == 0 then
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 0, 0)

		character.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.001)
	else
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 0, duration)
	end
end

function local_class:fade_in_character(character, duration)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 0.6, duration)
end

function local_class:activate_battle(boss, battle_group_prefix, battle_zone_name)

	self:start_battle(boss)

function local_class:create_champion_sword_on_floor(position, is_corrupted)

	local sword_id = is_corrupted and self.champion_sword_fallen_id or self.champion_sword_id
	local wait_callback = true

	local champion_sword = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = position,
		target = position,
		itemid = sword_id,
		notforinven = true,
		skip_text = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		bounce_callback = function()
			wait_callback = false
		end
	})

	while wait_callback do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	champion_sword.Position = position
	champion_sword.SpriteTransform.position = position + vector(-0.06, 1, 0.1)

---@param data table 세부 설정
---		characters		table		연출 중 레이어 변경해 줄 캐릭터
---		effect_pos		vector3		연출 이펙트(fx_champ_detect) 생성 위치
---		string_key		string		연출 나레이션 키 값
function local_class:detect_champion(data)
	local characters = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'characters', {})
	local effect_pos = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'effect_pos', stage_camera.LookAtPosition)
	local string_key = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'string_key', 'lw_main_s28_champ_narration')
	local show_narration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'show_narration', true)

	--characters

	end

	camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.05)

	end

--- 보간형 이동 함수
---@param fo character 이동할 대상
---@param position vector3 도착할 지점
---@param duration number 총 이동 시간(시간에 다른 속도 그래프를 사용할 거기 때문에 speed를 사용하지 않음)
---@param interpolation function 이동함수
-- 종류
--interpolations_constants = {
--	['linear'] = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear,
--	['ease_in_sine'] = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInSine,
--	['ease_out_sine'] = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine,
--	['ease_in_out_sine'] = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutSine,
--	['ease_in_quad'] = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad,
--	['ease_out_quad'] = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuad,
--	['ease_in_out_quad'] = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutQuad
--}
function local_class:interpolation_move_async(fo, position, duration, interpolation)
	local interpolation_func = interpolations_constants[lua_helper.get_or_default(interpolation, 'linear')]

	local start_pos = fo.Position
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = interpolation_func(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)
		fo.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, position, progress)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	fo.Position = position
end

-- 챕터18에서 사용 하는 기사의 무기를 활로 변경 하도록 요청
function local_class:change_knight_weapon_to_bow()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	-- 현재 배틀 스타일의 이름
	local battle_style_name = leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.BattleStyleSpec.Name

	-- 요청하는 배틀 스타일과 현재 배틀 스타일이 같으면 그냥 return
	if battle_style_name == 'lw_boss_knight2' then
		return
	end

	self:change_knight_weapon(leader, 'lw_knight_force_weapon_change_to_bow')

-- 챕터18에서 사용 하는 기사의 무기를 검으로 변경 하도록 요청

	-- 현재 배틀 스타일의 이름
	local battle_style_name = leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.BattleStyleSpec.Name

	-- 요청하는 배틀 스타일과 현재 배틀 스타일이 같으면 그냥 return
	if battle_style_name == 'lw_boss_knight' then

	self:change_knight_weapon(leader, 'lw_knight_force_weapon_change_to_sword')

function local_class:change_knight_weapon_to_champion_weapon()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	self:change_knight_weapon(leader, 'lw_knight_champion_weapon_change')
end

function local_class:change_knight_weapon(knight, custom_stage_key)
	local is_change_battle_action_or_stage_end = false

	-- 이벤트 리스너 세팅
	local event_listener = {
		on_battle_actions_changed_event = function(_, e)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, knight) then
				is_change_battle_action_or_stage_end = true
				return true
			end

			return false
		end,
		on_stage_end_event = function(_, _)
			is_change_battle_action_or_stage_end = true
		end
	}

	-- 배틀액션 변경 완료 이벤트와 스테이지 종료 이벤트 구독
	message_system:Subscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleActionsChangedEvent), 'on_battle_actions_changed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	-- 스위칭 기사 무기 변경 요청
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { custom_stage_key }))

	-- 변경 완료될 때까지 대기
	while is_change_battle_action_or_stage_end == false do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 완료 이후 구독 해제
	message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleActionsChangedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
end

function local_class:change_rooftop_effect_state(effect_on)
	field.RooftopManager:ForceVisible(effect_on)
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	-- 사용할 섹션 스크립트 정보. 주석 해제하고 사용
	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = true,
		NormalSectionCount = 6,
		HasPostSection = false
	}

	self.quest_marker_key = 'quest_demon_god'

	self.get_pre_radio_obj = function()
		return get_field_object('demon_god_radio')
	end

	self.get_demon_operator = function()
		return get_character('demon_operator')
	end

	self.get_demon_slayer = function()
		return get_character('demon_slayer')
	end

	self.get_demon_powergirl = function()
		return get_character('demon_powergirl')
	end

	---@type LaboseWorldDemonGodGimmickController
	self.gimmick_controller = nil

	---@type LaboseWorldScreenplayManager
	self.sp_manager = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/LaboseWorld/Common/LaboseWorldScreenplayManager')

	---@type LaboseWorldDemonGodLaboseCreatureManager
	self.creature_manager = nil

	-- 출구가 막혀있는지
	self.is_blocked_from_s3_creatures = false

	self.hacking_mini_game_name = 'EnemyBallDodgeGame'

	self.hacking_states = {
		none = 1,
		in_game = 2,
		succeed = 3,
		failed = 4
	}

	self.current_hacking_state = self.hacking_states.none

	self.hacking_fail = {
		data_key = 'seen_hacking_failed',
		target_value = 1,
		seen_once = function(this)
			local value = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, this.data_key)

			return value == this.target_value
		end,
		save_seen_async = function(this)
			quest_util.set_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, this.data_key, this.target_value)
		end
	}

	self.block_from_s3_creatures_fog_effects = {}

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		electric_ray_idle = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Tesla_Electric_Ray_Idle')
		end,
		strong_fog = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_virus_fog_strong')
		end,
		strong_fog_bug = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_virus_fog_strong_bug')
		end,
	}, {
		__index = {
			load_all = function(this)
				for _, func in pairs(this) do
					func()
				end

				yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
			end
		}
	})

	self.deactivate_gimmick_before_tutorial_request_key = 'before_gimmick_tutorial'

	self.pre_radio_coil_effect = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	self.fx:load_all()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent))

	self:dispose_block_from_s3_creatures_fogs()

	if self.pre_radio_coil_effect ~= nil then
		self.pre_radio_coil_effect:Dispose()
		self.pre_radio_coil_effect = nil
	end

	self.gimmick_controller = nil
	self.sp_manager = nil
	self.creature_manager = nil

	self.super:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	if stage.Name == 'lw_sub_demongod' then
		if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress == nil then
			return false
		end

		self.gimmick_controller = get_stage_event_controller('LaboseWorldDemonGodGimmickController')

		self:set_creature_by_progress()

		--섹션 2 이후에는 파이몬이 연출에서 사용하던 것들 세팅
		if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress > 1 or self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.IsComplete then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('s2_powergirl_door', true))

			do
				local truck = get_field_object('s2_truck')
				local wall_x = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_truck_move_end_wall_x').x
				local truck_x_offset_from_left = truck.Position.x - truck.Bounds.min.x
				local target_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(truck.Position, wall_x + truck_x_offset_from_left)

				truck.Position = target_pos
			end

			do
				local rock_count = 4

				for i = 1, rock_count do
					local rock = get_field_object('s2_truck_rock_' .. i)

					rock.ActiveState = active_state_type.disabled
				end
			end
		end

		-- 섹션 3 시작까지는 리더 스위칭 비활성화
		if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress < 3 and not self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.IsComplete then
			self.gimmick_controller:request_deactivate_button(self.deactivate_gimmick_before_tutorial_request_key)
		end

		-- 섹션 4 ~ 6까지 가는 길 막는 Strong 안개 생성
		if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress > 2 and
				not self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.IsComplete then
			self:spawn_block_from_s3_creatures_fogs()
		end
	elseif stage.Name == 'laboseworld_5' then
		if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress == nil then
			message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent), 'on_pre_tesla_coil_on_off_event')
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
end

function local_class:on_pre_tesla_coil_on_off_event(e)
	local radio_obj = self.get_pre_radio_obj()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(radio_obj, e.CoilObject) then
		if e.IsTurningOn then
			if self.pre_radio_coil_effect == nil then
				self.pre_radio_coil_effect = self.fx.electric_ray_idle()
						:Instantiate(radio_obj.Position + vector(0, 0.03, 0))
			end
		else
			if self.pre_radio_coil_effect ~= nil then
				self.pre_radio_coil_effect:Dispose()
				self.pre_radio_coil_effect = nil
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_s3_blocking_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.is_blocked_from_s3_creatures and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's3_block_from_creatures') then
		self.is_blocked_from_s3_creatures = true

		self.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.block_from_s3_creatures_scene, self, e.Zone):Then(function()
			self.is_blocked_from_s3_creatures = false
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.hacking_mini_game_name and self.current_hacking_state == self.hacking_states.in_game then
		if e.Success then
			self.current_hacking_state = self.hacking_states.succeed
		else
			self.current_hacking_state = self.hacking_states.failed
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

---@return LaboseWorldDemonGodLaboseCreatureManager
function local_class:get_creature_manager()
	if self.creature_manager == nil then
		self.creature_manager = get_or_create_global_table(
				'Quest/Main/LaboseWorld/DemonGod/Gimmick/LaboseCreatureManager')
	end

	return self.creature_manager
end

function local_class:set_creature_by_progress()
	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress == nil then
		return
	end

	local deactivate_creature = function(character)
		character_util.convert_to_npc(character)

		character_util.set_position(character, vector(999, 0, 999))
	end

	do
		local creature = get_character('s1_watching_creature')

		if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress < 1 and not self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.IsComplete then
			self:get_creature_manager():set_creature_with_marker(creature,
					nil,  's1_detected_reset')
		else
			deactivate_creature(creature)
		end
	end

	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress < 2 and not self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.IsComplete then
		local creature = get_character('s2_switch_labose_creature')

		self:get_creature_manager():set_creature_with_marker(creature,
				nil,  's2_detected_reset')
	else
		local creature_names = {
			's2_switch_labose_creature',
			's2_truck_labose_creature_1',
			's2_truck_labose_creature_2',
			's2_truck_labose_creature_3',
			's2_truck_labose_creature_4',
		}

		for _, name in pairs(creature_names) do
			local creature = get_character(name)

			deactivate_creature(creature)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start_host_talk(character)
	character_util.add_color(character, character.Name,
			unity_color({ 0.6, 0.6, 0.6, 1 }), 1, 0.3)
end

function local_class:end_host_talk(character)
	character_util.remove_color(character, character.Name, 0.3)
end

function local_class:talk_host_scope(character, action)
	self:start_host_talk(character)

	action()

	self:end_host_talk(character)
end

function local_class:add_quest_marker(target, key)
	key = lua_helper.get_or_default(key, self.quest_marker_key)

	self:remove_quest_marker(key)

	if lua_helper.type_compare(target, unity_class.vector3) then
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(key, self.cs_controller.QuestId, true, target)
	else
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(key, self.cs_controller.QuestId, true, target)
	end
end

function local_class:remove_quest_marker(key)
	key = lua_helper.get_or_default(key, self.quest_marker_key)

	quest_marker_util.remove(key)
end

function local_class:align_party_async(pivot, speed, duration, data, on_wait_action)
	local characters = {
		demon_slayer = self.get_demon_slayer(),
		demon_operator = self.get_demon_operator(),
		demon_powergirl = self.get_demon_powergirl(),
	}

	for key, character in pairs(characters) do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(character, pivot + data[key].offset,
				speed, duration, self, nil, { last_direction = data[key].last_dir })
	end

	if on_wait_action ~= nil then
		on_wait_action()
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
end

function local_class:spawn_block_from_s3_creatures_fogs()
	if #self.block_from_s3_creatures_fog_effects > 0 then
		return
	end

	local pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_encounter_creatures_fog_appear_center')
	local offsets = {
		vector(-0.5, 0, 1.5),
		vector(-0.5, 0, 0.5),
		vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5),
		vector(-0.5, 0, -1.5),
		vector(0.5, 0, 1.5),
		vector(0.5, 0, 0.5),
		vector(0.5, 0, -0.5),
		vector(0.5, 0, -1.5),
	}

	for _, offset in pairs(offsets) do
		local spawn_pos = pivot + offset
		local fog_effect = self.fx.strong_fog():Instantiate(spawn_pos)
		local bug_effect = self.fx.strong_fog_bug():Instantiate(spawn_pos)

		table.insert(self.block_from_s3_creatures_fog_effects, fog_effect)
		table.insert(self.block_from_s3_creatures_fog_effects, bug_effect)
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_s3_blocking_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:dispose_block_from_s3_creatures_fogs()
	if self.block_from_s3_creatures_fog_effects == nil then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_s3_blocking_zone_enter_event')

	for _, effect in pairs(self.block_from_s3_creatures_fog_effects) do
		effect:Dispose()
	end

	self.block_from_s3_creatures_fog_effects = nil
end

function local_class:block_from_s3_creatures_scene(zone)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	--빨간존 진입시 이벤트 재생 (해당 이벤트는 스테이지 마지막 섹션까지 유지)

	local demon_operator = get_character('demon_operator')

	--크로셀(tired): 제가 한 번 더 설명해드려야 할까요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, nil,
			nil, 'tired', 'lw_demon_god_s3_19')

	--리더 캐릭터가 해당 존에서 우측 0.5칸 떨어진 위치까지 0.5초간 이동 후 컨트롤 복귀
	local target_pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter(zone, leader, 'right')

	wp_util.move_async(leader, target_pos, 2.5)
end

function local_class:interact_console_scene(console, hackable_last_dir)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	hackable_last_dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(hackable_last_dir, 'up')

	--해킹콘솔에 인터랙트 시 정렬 후 이벤트 재생
	do
		local is_hackable = lua_helper.reference_equals(leader, self.get_demon_operator())
		local last_dir = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_hackable, hackable_last_dir, 'up')
		local console_center = vector_util.get_x0z(console.Bounds.center, console.Position.y)
		local offsets = {
			vector(0, 0, -1),
			vector(-0.5, 0, -2),
			vector(0.5, 0, -2),
		}

		for i, offset in pairs(offsets) do
			local member = user_party[i - 1]

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, console_center + offset,
					2, nil, self, nil, { last_direction = last_dir })
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(leader, self.get_demon_slayer()) then
		--안드라스로 인터랙트 시
		--안드라스(left,tired,bomb_idle): 이런 기름 냄새나는 흉물과는 가까이 있기도 싫구나.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
				'bomb_idle', nil, 'lw_demon_god_hacking_1')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
		--안드라스(left,smile,sing)(숙주): 맞아요! 안드라스 님께 이런 천한 일은 어울리지 않아요.
		self:talk_host_scope(leader, function()
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
					'sing', 'smile', 'lw_demon_god_hacking_2')
		end)

		return false

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(leader, self.get_demon_powergirl()) then
		--파이몬으로 인터랙트 시
		--파이몬(up,idle,release): 오오! 재밌어 보이는 버튼들이 잔뜩 있구나!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'up',
				'bomb_idle', nil, 'lw_demon_god_hacking_3')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_03')

		--파이몬(숙주): 아, 안돼! 그거 누르면 큰일 나!
		self:talk_host_scope(leader, function()
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, 'lw_demon_god_hacking_4')
		end)

		return false
	else
		return true
	end
end

---@return boolean|nil nil이면 선택지에서 그만 둔 상황, boolean이면 해킹 성공 여부
function local_class:play_hacking_routine(console, data_key, start_scene_cb, lose_scene_cb)
	if self.current_hacking_state ~= self.hacking_states.none then
		return nil
	end

	--선택지
	--해킹을 시작한다. (mercy)
	--그만둔다. (normal)
	local accepted = true

	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{
			'lw_demon_god_hacking_5',
			'mercy'
		},
		{
			'lw_demon_god_hacking_6',
			'normal',
			function()
				accepted = false
			end
		},
	})

	if not accepted then
		--그만둔다. (normal)
		--컨트롤 복귀
		return nil
	end

	self.current_hacking_state = self.hacking_states.in_game

	do
		local console_center = vector_util.get_x0z(console.Bounds.center, console.Position.y)
		local move_duration = 1
		local fade_delay = 0.5

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'muted' })

		camera_util.move(console_center, move_duration, { ignorecameragrids = true })
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2, move_duration)

		wait_for_sec(fade_delay)

		screen_util.fade_out_async(move_duration - fade_delay, unity_class.color.black)

		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0)
	end

	local party_origin_poses = {}

	for i = 1, user_party.Count do
		local member = user_party[i - 1]

		party_origin_poses[i] = member.Position
	end

	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false


	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.hacking_mini_game_name, data_key, function()
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local mini_game = mini_game_manager:GetMiniGameLuaScript(self.hacking_mini_game_name).MiniGameTable

	mini_game.scene_callbacks.on_start = start_scene_cb
	mini_game.scene_callbacks.on_lose = lose_scene_cb

	local gimmick_deactivate_request_key = 'hacking_acting'

	self.gimmick_controller:request_deactivate_button(gimmick_deactivate_request_key)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.hacking_mini_game_name)

	while self.current_hacking_state == self.hacking_states.in_game do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))

	mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.hacking_mini_game_name)

	self.gimmick_controller:request_activate_button(gimmick_deactivate_request_key)

	for i = 1, user_party.Count do
		local member = user_party[i - 1]

		character_util.set_position(member, party_origin_poses[i])
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.1)

	local result = true

	if self.current_hacking_state == self.hacking_states.succeed then
		result = true

	elseif self.current_hacking_state == self.hacking_states.failed then
		-- FIXME ; 페이드에 실행 조건이 있어, 이어받는 연출과의 종속성이 생김. 수정 요망
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

		--해당 이벤트는 이 후 다른 해킹 액팅에서 실패해도 나온다.
		--해당 이벤트는 유저가 단 한 번만 볼 수 있다.
		--예) 1번 해킹 액팅에서 실패 하지 않고 2번 해킹 액팅에서 실패했다면 2번 해킹 액팅에서 재생 이 후 3번 해킹 액팅에서 실패해도 재생X
		--2 번째 실패부터는 이벤트 없이 다시 콘솔앞에 크로셀로 복귀
		if not self.hacking_fail:seen_once() then
			--어차피 저장되려면 씬이 끝난 이후에 정상 종료해야하기 때문에,
			--여기서 저장한다고 해서 해당 연출을 다 보지 못했을 가능성은 없음
			self.hacking_fail:save_seen_async()

			local demon_slayer = self.get_demon_slayer()
			local demon_operator = self.get_demon_operator()
			local demon_powergirl = self.get_demon_powergirl()

			--첫 실패 이벤트
			--크로셀(up,idle,idle) 0.5초
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			-- 이때 크로셀(down,idle,idle)
			scene_util.set_direction(demon_operator, 'down', false)

			-- 파이몬(up,idle,release2회): 오오! 벌써 끝난건가?
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_powergirl, self, 'up',
					{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'lw_demon_god_hacking_7')

			-- 이때 안드라스(right,idle,idle)
			scene_util.set_direction_by_args(demon_slayer, 'right')

			-- 파이몬(left,tired,bomb_idle): 그런데 왜 아무일도 일어나지 않는거지?
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_powergirl, self, 'left',
					'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'lw_demon_god_hacking_8')

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			-- 크로셀(down,tired,idle): … 해킹에 실패했으니까요.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, 'down',
					nil, 'tired', 'lw_demon_god_hacking_9')

			-- 안드라스(right,doyagoa,bomb_idle): 잘난체는 있는대로 하더니 형편없는 실력이구나.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_slayer, self, 'right',
					'bomb_idle', 'doyagoa', 'lw_demon_god_hacking_10')

			-- 안드라스(right,sleep_deep,nod2회): 이런 녀석에게 지휘를 맡긴 리리스의 수준이 보이는구나.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_slayer, self, 'right',
					{ name = 'nod2회', count = 2 }, 'sleep_deep', 'lw_demon_god_hacking_11')

			-- 파이몬(left,smile,victory_get): 하하하! 크로셀 너도 헛똑똑이였나 보군!
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_powergirl, self, 'left',
					'victory_get', 'smile', 'lw_demon_god_hacking_12')

			-- 크로셀(down,attack,idle)(shake0.03)+(annoyed) 이모티콘 버블
			scene_util.shake(demon_operator, 0.03, 999)
			scene_util.play_emoticon_action(demon_operator, self, 'down',
					nil, 'attack', 'annoyed')

			character_util.stop_shake(demon_operator)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			-- 크로셀(down,mad,idle)(jump1회): 이 자식들이 진짜…!
			character_util.normal_jump(demon_operator, true)
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, 'down',
					nil, 'mad', 'lw_demon_god_hacking_13')

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_02')
			-- 크로셀(숙주)(down,tired,question): 크로셀 방금 뭐라고 했죠…?
			self:talk_host_scope(demon_operator, function()
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, 'down',
						'question', 'tired', 'lw_demon_god_hacking_14')
			end)

			-- 크로셀(down,surprise,idle)(jump1회) 1초
			character_util.normal_jump(demon_operator, true)
			scene_util.play_wait_action(demon_operator, self, 'down',
					nil, 'surprise', 1)

			-- 크로셀(up,idle,idle): … 됐어요! 서둘러 다시 시도할게요.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, 'up',
					nil, nil, 'lw_demon_god_hacking_15')
		end

		result = false
	else
		logger_util.error('Unexpected hacking state.')

		result = true
	end

	if result then
		console.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	self.current_hacking_state = self.hacking_states.none

	return result
end

function local_class:show_hacking_speech_async(key)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(get_party_leader(), key, nil, {
		viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.57),
		scale = 2,
		dialogue_sfx_name = '03_dialogue_02'
	})
end

return local_class

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'demon_god_receive_signal') then
		self.current_state = self.states.signal_received

		self.controller.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.receive_signal, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_radio_obj()) then
		local is_entered = self.controller.sp_manager:try_start_scene(self.interact_radio_scene, self)

		return is_entered
	end

	return false
end

--- 수신호 받음
function local_class:receive_signal()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	-- 가디언(right,idle,idle)(shake0.03/0.5초)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_buzzy_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	character_util.shake(leader, 0.03, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 가디언(right,surprise,idle)(jump1회) (notice) 이모티콘 버블
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, '01_small_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self, 'right', nil, 'surprise', 'notice')

	-- 가디언(right,idle,staff_idle) 1초
	-- electronic_terminal 스프라이트를 손에 든다.
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(leader, '[base]weapon1', 'electronic_terminal')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'staff_idle')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(leader, '[base]weapon1', 'empty')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 가디언(up,idle,idle) 0.5초
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 나레이션 박스
	-- 어딘가에서 크로셀의 신호가 오고있다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lw_demon_god_pre_1' })

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	-- 퍼즐 체크
	start_coroutine(function()
		local radio = self.get_radio_obj()

		while self.current_state ~= self.states.done do
			-- 2개 연결 됐으면
			if self.current_state == self.states.signal_received and radio.Electrocutable.PoweredSourcesCount > 1 then
				self.current_state = self.states.connecting_radio

				self.controller.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.connect_radio, self)

				return
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:interact_radio_scene()
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({
		key = 'lw_demon_god_pre_2'
	})
end

--- 라디오 연결
function local_class:connect_radio()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local radio_obj = self.get_radio_obj()
	radio_obj.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '02_lightning_strike_02',
		fade_out_time = 0.2,
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'object',
	})

	-- 라디오에게 1초간 카메라 이동
	camera_util.move_async(radio_obj.Position, 1)

	-- 라디오(shake0.03/1초)
	drop_item_util.shake(self.radio_item, nil, 0.03, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 가디언에게 카메라 1초간 카메라 복귀
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	-- 해당 대화에서 크로셀은 크로셀 UI 사용

	-- 이때 가디언(right,surprise,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, '01_small_jump_01')

	-- 크로셀 :아… 비상연락망이 다시 연결됐네요. 누구신가요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ui_operator_01')
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'lw_demon_god_pre_3')

	-- 선택지
	local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 거기 배달하나요? (brutal)
		{ 'lw_demon_god_pre_4', 'brutal' },
		-- -- 크로셀! 무사했구나! (mercy)
		{ 'lw_demon_god_pre_5', 'mercy' }
	})

	if player_choice == 1 then
		-- 가디언(right,smile,success 2회 )
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'success', count = 2 })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		-- 크로셀: 죄송합니다. 피자 하나는 정말 따뜻하게 배달하던 파이몬이 실종상태여서요.
		self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'lw_demon_god_pre_6')
	else
		-- 가디언(right,smile,sing) 1초
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'sing')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		-- 크로셀: 그 위치면… 언뜻봐도 당신이 더 위험한 위치인데 언제나 남 걱정이시군요.
		self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'lw_demon_god_pre_7')
	end

	-- 크로셀: 가디언 당신이 연결돼서 정말 다행이네요.
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'lw_demon_god_pre_8')

	-- 크로셀: 저와 안드라스는 현재 실종된 파이몬을 찾아 사울 근처까지 접근했습니다.
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'lw_demon_god_pre_9')

	-- 크로셀: 파이몬의 신호가 가까우니 곧 복귀할 것이라고 리리스에게 전해주세요.
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'lw_demon_god_pre_10')

	-- 서브 스테이지 오픈
	-- 크로셀이 자신의 위치를 통신기를 통해 알려줬다.
	stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({
		substage_name = 'lw_sub_demongod',
		substage_open_string_key = 'lw_demon_god_pre_11'
	})

	-- 크로셀: 통신기를 통해 위치도 공유해두었으니 잘 부탁해요.
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'lw_demon_god_pre_12')

	self.controller:activate_quest()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldDemonGodSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = LaboseWorldDemonGod @
		Comment = 안드라스 기믹 튜토리얼 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type LaboseWorldDemonGodController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'lw_sub_demongod'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		before_loaded = 1,
		opening = 2,
		before_encounter_fog = 3,
		encounter_fog = 4,
		done = 99,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_loaded

	self.get_opening_creature = function()
		return get_character('s1_opening_creature')
	end

	self.get_encounter_fog_align_center = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_encounter_fog_align_center')
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_state = self.states.opening

	sp_util.start_scene(function()
		self:opening_scene()

		--서브 스테이지 시작 연출 (제목 출력)
		screen_util.show_stage_title()

		--안드라스(victory_get)
		scene_util.set_anim_async(get_party_leader(), self, { name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
		character_util.remove_anim(get_party_leader())

		self.current_state = self.states.before_encounter_fog

		do
			local target_pos = self.get_encounter_fog_align_center()

			self.controller:add_quest_marker(target_pos)
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

function local_class:exit()

end

function local_class:dispose()

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_encounter_fog and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's1_encounter_fog') then
		self.controller:remove_quest_marker()

		self.current_state = self.states.encounter_fog

		sp_util.start_scene(self.encounter_fog_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:opening_scene()
	local demon_slayer = self.controller.get_demon_slayer()
	local demon_operator = self.controller.get_demon_operator()
	local creature = self.get_opening_creature()

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--최초배치
	--(A)(cw_labose_creature)(기믹으로 얼어있는 holdable 상태)
	--(B)(cw_labose_creature)(left,idle,prostrate)(안드라스가 인터랙트 하여 얼릴 수 있는 상태의 역병 괴물)
	--전방에 2칸길을 (B)시체가 막고 있다. 플레이어는 안드라스의 능력을 통해 (B)를 holdable로 바꾸고 지나가야 한다.

	--안드라스(right,idle,staff_idle)
	character_util.set_position(demon_slayer, creature.Position + unity_class.vector3.left)
	character_util.set_direction(demon_slayer, 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_slayer, self, 'staff_idle')

	--cwp_demonslayer_epic 을 들고 있다.
	scene_util.show_weapon(demon_slayer)

	--크로셀(right,idle,idle)
	character_util.set_position(demon_operator, demon_slayer.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 2)
	character_util.set_direction(demon_operator, 'right')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	--안드라스(right,tired): 지루하기 짝이 없는 일이구나.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_slayer, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'lw_demon_god_s1_0')

	--안드라스(right,idle,twohand_attack 1회)
	--기믹과 동일하게 역병 괴물 어는 연출
	--해당 애니메이션 시작 0.5초 후
	--괴물의 중앙 위치의 ice_flower 스프라이트가 50%크기로 생성된 후 100%크기까지 서서히 커진다.
	--이때 괴물의 검은 틴트가 0%에서 50%까지 커진다.
	--상단 두 이벤트는 1초간 재생
	self.controller.gimmick_controller:convert_creature_to_holdable_routine(creature)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--이 후 해당 괴물은 ice_flower 스프라이트와 함께 holdable 오브젝트로 변경된다.
	scene_util.hide_weapon(demon_slayer)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	-- 안드라스(right,damaged,bomb_idle): 이 쓰레기들은 왜 일일이 얼려두란 것이냐?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_slayer, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', 'damaged', 'lw_demon_god_s1_1')

	-- 이때 안드라스 (left,idle,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(demon_slayer, 'left')

	-- 크로셀(right,idle,idle): 리리스에게 이 괴물과 안개를 구성하는 박테리아에 대한 정보를 받았어요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'lw_demon_god_s1_2')

	-- 크로셀(right,sleep_deep,idle):그 괴물을 가만히 놔두면 박테리아를 뿜으며 폭발해요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, 'right',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'lw_demon_god_s1_3')

	-- 크로셀(right,idle,nod2회): 그리고 그 박테리아에 닿는 순간 몸이 가루가 돼버리죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'lw_demon_god_s1_4')

	-- 크로셀(right,idle,idle): 그래도 물리적인 방법이 어느정도 통해서 당신의 냉기로 억제하는 거에요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'lw_demon_god_s1_5')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	-- 안드라스(left,tired,bomb_idle): 네 입에서 나오는 건 역시 고리타분한 얘기 뿐이구나.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_slayer, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'lw_demon_god_s1_6')

	-- 안드라스(left,sleep_deep,idle): 이 몸의 흥미를 돋울 이야기는 없는 것이냐?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_slayer, self, 'left',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'lw_demon_god_s1_7')

	-- 크로셀(right,idle,idle): 재밌는 소식이 하나 있긴합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'lw_demon_god_s1_8')

function local_class:encounter_fog_scene()
	local demon_slayer = self.controller.get_demon_slayer()
	local demon_operator = self.controller.get_demon_operator()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--초록색 존 진입시 (walk)로 0.5 초간 정렬
	do

		local speed = 3

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(demon_slayer,

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(demon_operator,

	--(2)(크로셀)(right,idle,idle)

	do

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'lw_demon_god_s1_19')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	-- 안드라스(right,attack,staff_idle): 케이든 녀석은 이 몸과 맞선 것도 모자라 이젠 이 몸을 청소부로 전락시켰구나.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_slayer, self, 'right',

	-- 안드라스(right,tired,bomb_idle): 이것들이 비명이라도 질렀으면 조금은 즐거웠을 것을…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_slayer, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'lw_demon_god_s1_21')

	-- 크로셀(right,idle,idle): 숱한 전투로 더러워진 옷에 지금도 머릿속에서 모니카가 비명을 지르고 있어요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'lw_demon_god_s1_22')

	-- 크로셀(right,sleep_deep,bomb_idle): 원하신다면 들려드릴 수 있는데 어떠신가요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', 'sleep_deep', 'lw_demon_god_s1_23')

	-- 안드라스(right,tired,idle) : 그건 네 녀석이나 실컷 듣거라.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_slayer, self, 'right',
			nil, 'tired', 'lw_demon_god_s1_24')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	self.controller:talk_host_scope(demon_slayer, function()
		-- 안드라스(숙주)(right,tired,cast): 저, 저도 안드라스 님을 위해 비명을 지를 수 있어요!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_slayer, self, 'right',

local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldDemonGodSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = LaboseWorldDemonGod @
		Comment = 파이몬 조우 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type LaboseWorldDemonGodController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'lw_sub_demongod'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		before_loaded = 1,
		before_enter_powergirl_room = 2,
		enter_powergirl_room = 3,
		before_open_door = 4,
		door_opened = 5,
		done = 99,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_loaded

	self.powergirl_room_grid_name = 's2_powergirl'

	self.get_powergirl_room_align_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_powergirl_room_align')
	end

	self.get_truck = function()
		return get_field_object('s2_truck')
	end

	self.get_switch = function()
		return get_field_object('s2_powergirl_door_switch')
	end

	self.door = {
		name = 's2_powergirl_door',
		open = function(this)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(this.name, false))
		end
	}

	self.get_switch_labose_creature = function()
		return get_character('s2_switch_labose_creature')
	end

	self.labose_creature = {
		count = 4,
		get = function(number)
			return get_character('s2_truck_labose_creature_' .. number)
		end,
		foreach = function(this, action)
			for i = 1, this.count do
				action(i, this.get(i))
			end
		end
	}

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		smokescreen = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_smokescreen')
		end,
		obj_smoke = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_obj_smoke')
		end,
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, creator in pairs(this) do
					creator()
				end
			end
		}
	})
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self:set()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_state = self.states.before_enter_powergirl_room

	do
		local powergirl_room_center = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_powergirl_room_center')

		self.controller:add_quest_marker(powergirl_room_center)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))

	self.current_state = self.states.done
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_enter_powergirl_room and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_powergirl_room') then
		self.current_state = self.states.enter_powergirl_room

		self.controller:remove_quest_marker()

		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_powergirl_room_scene, self):Then(function()
			self.current_state = self.states.before_open_door
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_open_door and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.get_switch()) then
		local entered = self.controller.sp_manager:try_start_scene(function()
			self:door_open_scene()

			self.controller:progress_section()
		end)

		if entered then
			self.current_state = self.states.door_opened

			return true
		else

		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set()
	local truck = self.get_truck()

	do
		--우측에 파이몬은 (left,idle,idle) 상태
		local demon_powergirl = self.controller.get_demon_powergirl()
		local truck_right_center = vector(truck.Bounds.max.x, truck.Position.y, truck.Bounds.center.z)

		demon_powergirl.ActiveState = active_state_type.enabled
		demon_powergirl.Position = truck_right_center + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.5
		demon_powergirl.Direction = direction_constants.left
	end

	do
		local reset_marker_name = 's2_detected_reset'

		self.labose_creature:foreach(function(_, creature)
			self.controller:get_creature_manager():set_creature_with_marker(creature,
					nil, reset_marker_name)
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:enter_powergirl_room_scene()
	local demon_slayer = self.controller.get_demon_slayer()
	local demon_operator = self.controller.get_demon_operator()
	local demon_powergirl = self.controller.get_demon_powergirl()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--초록색 존 진입하면 이벤트 재생

	--화면 shake(0.1/0.3초)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_car_damaged_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	do
		local jump_duration = 0.3

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
		--동시에 안드라스 크로셀(right,attack,idle)(jump1회)
		party_util.set_direction('right')
		party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'attack' })
		party_util.jump(0.5, jump_duration)

		wait_for_sec(jump_duration)
	end

	--안드라스 크로셀(right,attack,idle)0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--1초간 카메라 파이몬 위치로 이동 (그리드 무시)
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(demon_powergirl, 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	--이동끝나면 크로셀 안드라스 상단 대열로 정렬 (right,idle,idle)
	do
		local align_center = self.get_powergirl_room_align_pos()
		local x_dist_from_center = 0.5

		character_util.set_position(demon_slayer, align_center + unity_class.vector3.right * x_dist_from_center)
		character_util.set_position(demon_operator, align_center + unity_class.vector3.left * x_dist_from_center)

		party_util.remove_emotion()
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	--파이몬(left,attack,bomb_idle): 이 트럭은 어째서 꼼짝도 하지 않는 것이냐!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_powergirl, self, nil,
			'bomb_idle', 'attack', 'lw_demon_god_s2_1')

	--파이몬 (attack) 애니메이션
	--해당 애니메이션 재생 0.3초 후 화면 shake0.1/0.3초
	self:powergirl_hit_routine()

	--파이몬 0.5초 대기 후
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--다시 (attack) 애니메이션
	--해당 애니메이션 재생 0.3초 후 화면 shake0.1/0.3초
	self:powergirl_hit_routine()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_03')
	--파이몬(숙주): 저기 파이몬… 이 쪽으로 가는 게 아닌가 봐…
	self.controller:talk_host_scope(demon_powergirl, function()
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_powergirl, 'lw_demon_god_s2_2')
	end)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	--파이몬(left,mad,release2회): 무슨 소리냐! 트럭만 따라가면 기지가 나온다고 들었다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_powergirl, self, nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'mad', 'lw_demon_god_s2_3')

	--파이몬 (attack) 애니메이션
	--해당 애니메이션 재생 0.3초 후 화면 shake0.1/0.3초
	self:powergirl_hit_routine()

	do
		local current_grid_info = nil

		for i = 0, field.CameraGrids.Count - 1 do
			local grid_info = field.CameraGrids[i]

			if grid_info.name == self.powergirl_room_grid_name then
				current_grid_info = grid_info

				break
			end
		end

		local cam_half_height = stage_camera.Size
		local cam_half_width = stage_camera.HalfWidth
		local camera_move_pos = current_grid_info:GetCameraPosInGrid(demon_slayer.Position, cam_half_width, cam_half_height)

		--카메라 안드라스에게 1초간 복귀
		camera_util.move_async(camera_move_pos, 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })

		stage_camera:SetTarget(demon_slayer)
	end

	--선택지
	--역시 파이몬이다. (mercy)
	--버리고 가자. (brutal)
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'lw_demon_god_s2_4', 'mercy' },
		{ 'lw_demon_god_s2_5', 'brutal' },
	})

	if result == 1 then
		--역시 파이몬이다. (mercy)

		-- 안드라스(right,sleep_deep,nod2회): 역시 파이몬이구나. 이 몸의 기대를 저버리지 않아.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_slayer, self, nil,
				{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'sleep_deep', 'lw_demon_god_s2_6')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		-- 안드라스(right,damaged,idle): 저 녀석은 500년전 부터 지금까지 자기가 죽었던 줄도 몰랐을 거다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_slayer, self, nil,
				nil, 'damaged', 'lw_demon_god_s2_7')
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		--버리고 가자. (brutal)
		-- 안드라스(right,damaged,bomb_idle): 저 바보는 그냥 여기 버리고가면 안되는 것이냐?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_slayer, self, nil,
				'bomb_idle', 'damaged', 'lw_demon_god_s2_8')

		-- 크로셀(right,tired,idle): 안돼요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, nil,
				nil, 'tired', 'lw_demon_god_s2_9')
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:powergirl_hit_routine()
	local demon_powergirl = self.controller.get_demon_powergirl()

	--파이몬 (attack) 애니메이션
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_powergirl, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1, sfx_name = '02_normal_slash_01' })

	--해당 애니메이션 재생 0.3초 후
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--화면 shake0.1/0.3초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_car_damaged_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	character_util.remove_anim(demon_powergirl)
end

function local_class:door_open_scene()
	local demon_operator = self.controller.get_demon_operator()
	local demon_slayer = self.controller.get_demon_slayer()
	local demon_powergirl = self.controller.get_demon_powergirl()
	local truck = self.get_truck()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	self.door:open()

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--파이몬에게 1초동안 카메라 이동 후
				camera_util.move_to_target_async(demon_powergirl, 1)

				--0.5초 대기
				wait_for_sec(0.5)
			end,
			function()
				--이때 리더 캐릭터 z(-22)로 정렬
				local truck_min_z = truck.Bounds.min.z

				for i = 1, user_party.Count do
					local member = user_party[i - 1]
					local target_pos = vector_util.get_xy0(member.Position, truck_min_z - 1.5)

					wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, target_pos, 3, nil,
							self, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })
				end

				wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
			end
	)

	--파이몬 (attack) 애니메이션
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_powergirl, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--파이몬 (attack) 애니메이션
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_powergirl, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

	--해당 애니메이션 재생 0.3초 후
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--화면 shake0.1/0.3초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_car_damaged_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	do
		--shake 시작과 동시에 트럭 오브젝트 1초간 좌측 끝까지 이동
		local wall_x = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_truck_move_end_wall_x').x
		local truck_x_offset_from_left = truck.Position.x - truck.Bounds.min.x

		local duration = 1

		local camera_move_pos = target_pos + camera_offset

		camera_util.move(camera_move_pos, duration)

		local rocks = {}

	--파이몬(left,smile,victory_get): 하하하! 드디어 교통 체증이란 걸 해결한 건가!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_powergirl, self, nil,
			'victory_get', 'smile', 'lw_demon_god_s2_11')

	--파이몬(up,idle,idle)(question) 이모티콘 버블
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(demon_powergirl, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'question')

	--파이몬(up,idle,release2회): 오! 너희들도 아직 여기 있었군!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_powergirl, self, nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'lw_demon_god_s2_12')

	--파이몬(right,attack,cast2): 레이나 보거라! 우린 전혀 늦지 않았다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_powergirl, self, 'right',
			'cast2', 'attack', 'lw_demon_god_s2_13')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_03')
	--파이몬(숙주): 너무 늦어서 찾으러 온 거야. 파이몬…
	self.controller:talk_host_scope(demon_powergirl, function()
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_powergirl, 'lw_demon_god_s2_14')
	end)

	--이때 파이몬 (up,idle,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_powergirl, 'up', false)

	--안드라스(down,attack,release2회): 네 녀석 때문에 낭비한 시간이 얼만지나 아느냐?!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_slayer, self, nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'lw_demon_god_s2_15')

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_operator, 'lw_demon_god_s2_16')

	--크로셀(down,idle,nod2회): 당신이 왔던 길 반대편에 통로가 있으니 그 곳으로 향하죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, nil,

	--컨트롤 해제
end
