local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldDemonGodSection3')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = LaboseWorldDemonGod @
		Comment = 3마신 기믹 튜토리얼 @
		Index = 2 @
		NextSections = 3 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type LaboseWorldDemonGodController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'lw_sub_demongod'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		before_loaded = 1,
		before_encounter_creatures = 2,
		encounter_creatures = 3,
		before_encounter_truck = 4,
		encounter_truck = 5,
		done = 99
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_loaded

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		virus_fog = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_virus_fog_strong')
		end,
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, creator in pairs(this) do
					creator()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	self.battle = {
		states = {
			before_battle = 1,
			in_battle = 2,
			after_battle = 3,
		},
		current_state = nil,

		monster_count = 8,

		get_monster = function(number)
			return get_character('s3_battle_labose_creature_' .. number)
		end,

		foreach_monster = function(this, action)
			for i = 1, this.monster_count do
				local monster = this.get_monster(i)

				action(i, monster)
			end
		end,

		group_name = 's3_battle',
		zone_name = 's3_battle',

		battle_gate_prefix = 's3_battle_gate_',
		battle_gate_count = 3,

		close_gate = function(this)
			for i = 1, this.battle_gate_count do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(this.battle_gate_prefix .. i))
			end
		end,

		open_gate = function(this)
			for i = 1, this.battle_gate_count do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(this.battle_gate_prefix .. i))
			end
		end
	}

	self.battle.current_state = self.battle.states.before_battle
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self:set()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_state = self.states.before_encounter_creatures

	do
		local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_encounter_creatures_room_center')

		self.controller:add_quest_marker(target_pos)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	self.current_state = self.states.done
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_encounter_creatures and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's3_encounter_creatures') then
		self.current_state = self.states.encounter_creatures

		self.controller:remove_quest_marker()

		sp_util.start_scene(self.encounter_creatures_scene, self):Then(function()
			self.current_state = self.states.before_encounter_truck

			--메인 마커 위치 변경
			do
				local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_encounter_truck_room_center')

				self.controller:add_quest_marker(target_pos)
			end
		end)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.before_encounter_truck and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's3_encounter_truck') then
		self.current_state = self.states.encounter_truck

		self.controller:remove_quest_marker()

		self.controller.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(function()
			self:encounter_truck_scene()

			self:gimmick_tutorial_routine()

			self.controller:progress_section()
		end)
	end

	if self.battle.current_state == self.battle.states.before_battle and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.battle.zone_name) then
		self.battle.current_state = self.battle.states.in_battle

		self:start_battle()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.battle.current_state == self.battle.states.in_battle and e.BattleGroupName == self.battle.group_name then
		self.battle.current_state = self.battle.states.after_battle

		self:end_battle()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set()
	self.battle:foreach_monster(function(index, monster)
		local position = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_battle_labose_creature_' .. index)

		character_util.set_position(monster, position)
		character_util.set_direction(monster, 'left')

		character_util.convert_to_monster(monster, self.battle.group_name, self.battle.zone_name)

		character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'visible')
	end)
end

function local_class:start_battle()
	self.battle:foreach_monster(function(_, monster)
		character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'enabled')

		command_util.publish_monster_notice(monster, get_party_leader(), 'battle')
	end)

	self.battle:close_gate()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
end

function local_class:end_battle()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.battle:open_gate()
end

function local_class:encounter_creatures_scene()
	local demon_slayer = self.controller.get_demon_slayer()
	local demon_operator = self.controller.get_demon_operator()
	local demon_powergirl = self.controller.get_demon_powergirl()
	local align_center = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_encounter_creatures_align_center')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--메인 마커 위치 초록색 존 진입시 이벤트 재생
	--안드라스(안) 크로셀(크) 파이몬(파) 1초간 해당 대열로 정렬 (left,idle,idle)
	do
		self.controller:align_party_async(align_center, 3.5, nil, {
			demon_slayer = {
				offset = vector(0.5, 0, -0.5),
				last_dir = 'left'
			},
			demon_operator = {
				offset = vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
				last_dir = 'left'
			},
			demon_powergirl = {
				offset = vector(0.5, 0, 0.5),
				last_dir = 'left'
			},
		})
	end

	local party_grid_index = field:GetCameraGridIdxOrMinusOne(demon_operator.Position)
	local party_grid = field.CameraGrids[party_grid_index]

	-- 크로셀(left,idle,release2회): 이 방향으로 지나가면 될 거에요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'lw_demon_god_s3_1')

	-- 파이몬(left,smile,idle): 하하하! 역시 크로셀만 따라가면 길이 나오는 군!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_powergirl, self, nil,
			nil, 'smile', 'lw_demon_god_s3_2')

	-- 파이몬(left,smile,victory_get): 좋다! 한 번 제대로 달려보겠다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_powergirl, self, nil,
			'victory_get', 'smile', 'lw_demon_god_s3_3')

	-- 크로셀(left,tired,question) (question) 이모티콘 버블
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(demon_operator, self, nil,
			{ name = 'question', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' }, 'tired', 'question')

	-- 크로셀(left,attack,idle)(jump1회): 잠시만요. 멈춰보세요.
	character_util.normal_jump(demon_operator, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, nil,
			nil, 'attack', 'lw_demon_god_s3_4')

	--0.5초 대기 후
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--(cw_labose_creature)(right,idle,idle)( 8 체 )

	local creature_fog_effects = {}
	local creature_origin_poses = {}
	local fog_loop_sfx = nil
	local bug_loop_sfx = nil

	--카메라 도착 후 해당 8 체의 NPC들이 속도 1 로 우측으로 2초간 이동 한 후 정지
	do
		local npc_count = 8

		for i = 1, npc_count do
			local npc = get_character('s3_encounter_creatures_creature_' .. i)

			creature_origin_poses[npc] = npc.Position

			npc.Position = npc.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 2.5

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, npc.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 4,
					1, nil, self)
		end

		--2초에 걸쳐 좌측 다음 방 그리드 끝까지 이동
		do
			local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_encounter_creatures_panning_center')

			camera_util.move_async(target_pos, 2)
		end

		--카메라 도착 0.5초 후
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		do
			--좌측 1번 부터 fx_lw_virus_fog_strong 가 5번까지 0.7초 간격으로 순서대로 생성된다.
			do
				local spawn_count = 4
				local spawn_offsets = {
					vector(0.5, 0, 0.5),
					vector(-0.5, 0, 0.5),
					vector(0.5, 0, -0.5),
					vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5),
				}

				local spawn_fog = function(index)
					local pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_encounter_creatures_panning_fog_pivot_' .. index)

					for _, spawn_offset in pairs(spawn_offsets) do
						local effect = self.fx.virus_fog():Instantiate(pivot + spawn_offset)

						table.insert(creature_fog_effects, effect)
					end
				end

				fog_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
					sfx_name = '01_fly_loop_01',
					loop = true,
					type_priority = 'loop',
					player_priority = 'object',
					volume = 0.3
				})

				bug_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
					sfx_name = '01_bugs_loop_01',
					loop = true,
					type_priority = 'loop',
					player_priority = 'object',
					volume = 0.6
				})

				for i = 1, spawn_count do
					spawn_fog(i)

					wait_for_sec(0.7)
				end

				for i = spawn_count + 1, spawn_count + 4 do
					spawn_fog(i)

			end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

	--[5번] 안개가 생긴 후 0.5초 대기

local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldDemonGodSection4')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = LaboseWorldDemonGod @
		Comment = 파이몬 및 크로셀 기믹 튜토리얼 @
		Index = 3 @
		NextSections = 4 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type LaboseWorldDemonGodController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'lw_sub_demongod'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		before_loaded = 1,
		before_tesla_explanation = 2,
		in_tesla_explanation = 3,
		before_open_key_door = 4,
		before_interact_console = 5,
		before_start_hacking = 6,
		interacting_console = 7,
		before_retry_hacking = 8,

		done = 99
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_loaded

	self.is_first_interact_console = true

	self.get_console = function()
		return get_field_object('s4_hacking_console')
	end

	self.key_door = {
		name = 's4_key_door',
		get = function(this)
			return get_field_object(this.name)
		end
	}
end

function local_class:enter()
	do
		local console = self.get_console()

		console.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent), 'on_door_opened_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_state = self.states.before_tesla_explanation

	do
		local marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_tesla_explanation_align_pivot')

		self.controller:add_quest_marker(marker_pos)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.current_state = self.states.done
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_tesla_explanation and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's4_tesla_explanation') then
		self.current_state = self.states.in_tesla_explanation

		self.controller:remove_quest_marker()

		self.controller.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(function()
			self:tesla_explanation_scene()

			do
				local key_door = self.key_door:get()

				self.controller:add_quest_marker(key_door)
			end

			self.current_state = self.states.before_open_key_door
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_door_opened_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_open_key_door and e.DoorHandleName == self.key_door.name then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_interact_console

		local console = self.get_console()

		self.controller:add_quest_marker(console)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if (self.current_state == self.states.before_interact_console or
			self.current_state == self.states.before_start_hacking or
			self.current_state == self.states.before_retry_hacking) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_console()) then

		-- 첫 인터랙트인지
		local is_first_interact = self.current_state == self.states.before_interact_console
		-- 첫 해킹 시도인지
		local is_first_try = self.current_state == self.states.before_interact_console or
				self.current_state == self.states.before_start_hacking
		local prev_state =  self.current_state

		local is_entered = self.controller.sp_manager:try_start_scene(function(console)
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

			local can_hack = self.controller:interact_console_scene(console)

			if can_hack then
				local succeed = self:interact_console_routine(console, is_first_interact, is_first_try)

				-- nil이면 인터랙트만 하고 해킹 실행은 안한 것으로 간주
				if succeed == nil then
					self.current_state = self.states.before_start_hacking

					self.controller:add_quest_marker(console)

				elseif succeed then
					self:after_hacking_scene()

					self.controller:progress_section()

				else
					self.current_state = self.states.before_retry_hacking

					self.controller:add_quest_marker(console)
				end
			else
				self.current_state = prev_state

				self.controller:add_quest_marker(console)
			end

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		end, e.Target)

		if is_entered then
			self.current_state = self.states.interacting_console

			self.controller:remove_quest_marker()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:tesla_explanation_scene()
	local demon_operator = self.controller.get_demon_operator()
	local demon_slayer = self.controller.get_demon_slayer()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--빨간 존 진입시 해당 대열로 0.5초간 정렬 (right,idle,idle)
	do
		local align_pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_tesla_explanation_align_pivot')

		self.controller:align_party_async(align_pivot, 2.5, nil, {
			demon_operator = {
				offset = vector(0.5, 0, 0),
				last_dir = 'right'
			},
			demon_slayer = {
				offset = vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5),
				last_dir = 'right'
			},
			demon_powergirl = {
				offset = vector(-0.5, 0, 0.5),
				last_dir = 'right'
			},
		})
	end

	-- 크로셀(right,idle,cross_arm) : 전력을 이용한 조잡한 보안 장치네요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, nil,
			'cross_arm', nil, 'lw_demon_god_s4_1')

	-- 이때 크로셀(left,idle,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_operator, 'left', false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	-- 안드라스(right,doyagao,bomb_idle): 잘난 체하는 꼴을 보니 뾰족한 수라도 있나 보구나.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_slayer, self, nil,
			'bomb_idle', 'doyagao', 'lw_demon_god_s4_2')

	-- 크로셀(left,idle,nod2회): 사울의 기계 장치들은 어느정도 구조를 파악해 두었어요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, nil,
			'nod', nil, 'lw_demon_god_s4_3')

	-- 크로셀(right,idle,idle): 제가 약간의 충격만 가해도 전력을 차단시킬 수 있죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, nil,
			nil, nil, 'lw_demon_god_s4_4')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

function local_class:interact_console_routine(console, is_first_interact, is_first_try)
	--크로셀로 인터랙트 시 이벤트 재생
	local demon_operator = self.controller.get_demon_operator()

	if is_first_interact then
		local eat_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_typing_01', loop = true })
		--크로셀(right,idle,eat) 1초
		scene_util.play_wait_action(demon_operator, self, 'right',
				'eat', nil, 1)

		eat_loop_sfx:FadeOut()
		eat_loop_sfx = nil

		--크로셀(up,idle,idle): 정말 반가운 콘솔 장치로군요.
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(demon_operator, 'up')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_operator, 'lw_demon_god_s4_5')

		--크로셀(up,idle,idle): 작동 원리는 인베이더의 장치와 유사해보이니 다행이에요.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_operator, 'lw_demon_god_s4_6')

		--크로셀(right,idle,idle): 서둘러 해킹하고 보안 장치를 해제하도록 하죠.
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(demon_operator, 'right')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_operator, 'lw_demon_god_s4_7')

		--크로셀(up,idle,idle)
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(demon_operator, 'up')
	end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_tipsy_01')

	local demon_slayer = self.controller.get_demon_slayer()
	local demon_powergirl = self.controller.get_demon_powergirl()

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_powergirl, self, { dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'mad', 'lw_demon_god_s4_15')

	-- 파이몬(left,smile,victory_get): 오오! 그 기술 내게도 가르쳐 주면 안되겠나?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_powergirl, self, 'left',
			'victory_get', 'smile', 'lw_demon_god_s4_16')

	-- 안드라스(right,smile,nod2회): 좋은 생각이구나. 이 몸은 벨리알과의 식사를 준비하겠다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_slayer, self, 'right',
			'nod', 'smile', 'lw_demon_god_s4_17')

	-- 안드라스(right,damaged,bomb_idle): 네 교육이 끝날 쯤이면 벨리알이 돌아오고도 남을테니 말이다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_slayer, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', 'damaged', 'lw_demon_god_s4_18')

	-- 크로셀(down,tired,idle): 잡담은 그만하고 어서 움직이시죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_operator, self, nil,
			nil, 'tired', 'lw_demon_god_s4_19')

end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldDemonGodSection5')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = LaboseWorldDemonGod @
		Comment = 트럭에 숨어있던 생존자 조우 @
		Index = 4 @
		NextSections = 5 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type LaboseWorldDemonGodController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'lw_sub_demongod'

	self.states = {
		before_loaded = 1,
		before_push_hiding_truck = 2,
		hiding_truck_pushed = 3,
		before_enter_coil_room = 4,
		in_coil_room = 5,
		before_interact_console = 6,
		before_start_hacking = 7,
		interacting_console = 8,

		done = 99,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_loaded

	self.get_hiding_truck = function()
		return get_field_object('truck_6')
	end

	self.get_saul_citizens = function(number)
		return get_character('s5_truck_citizen_' .. number)
	end

	self.get_saul_truck_npc_pos = function(number)
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_saul_truck_npc_pos_' .. number)
	end

	self.get_saul_landing_npc_pos = function(number)
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_saul_truck_npc_align_pos_' .. number)
	end

	self.get_console = function()
		return get_field_object('s5_hacking_console')
	end

	self.tesla_coils = {
		vfo_container = {},
		fo_names = {
			'tesla_coil_7',
			'tesla_coil_8',
		},

		turn_off = function(this)
			for i = 1, #this.fo_names do
				local fo = get_field_object(this.fo_names[i])

				if this.vfo_container[i] == nil then
					this.vfo_container[i] = field_object_util.create_virtual_field_object(fo.Position, {
						hitbox = fo.Hitbox,
					})
				else
					this.vfo_container[i].ActiveState = active_state_type.enabled
				end

				message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOffEvent.Create(fo))
				fo.ActiveState = active_state_type.visible
			end
		end,
		turn_on = function(this)
			for i = 1, #this.fo_names do
				local fo = get_field_object(this.fo_names[i])

				if this.vfo_container[i] ~= nil then
					this.vfo_container[i].ActiveState = active_state_type.disabled
				end

				fo.ActiveState = active_state_type.enabled
				message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent.Create(fo))
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this)
			for i = 1, #this.vfo_container do
				this.vfo_container[i]:Dispose()
				this.vfo_container[i] = nil
			end
		end,
	}
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self:field_setting()

	self.controller.gimmick_controller:add_interact_ignore_truck(self.get_hiding_truck())

	do
		local truck = self.get_hiding_truck()

		local truck_bottom_pos = vector(truck.Bounds.center.x, truck.Position.y, truck.Bounds.min.z + 1)

		self.controller:add_quest_marker(truck_bottom_pos)
	end

	self.current_state = self.states.before_push_hiding_truck
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.tesla_coils:dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_push_hiding_truck and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_hiding_truck()) then

		local is_entered = self.controller.sp_manager:try_start_scene(function()
			self:truck_open_scene()

			do
				local truck_npc_1 = self.get_saul_citizens(1)
				local marker_pos = truck_npc_1.Position + unity_class.vector3.left

				self.controller:add_quest_marker(marker_pos)
			end

			self.current_state = self.states.before_enter_coil_room
		end)

		if is_entered then
			self.current_state = self.states.interact_truck

			self.controller:remove_quest_marker()

			return true
		end

	elseif (self.current_state == self.states.before_interact_console or
			self.current_state == self.states.before_start_hacking) and
		type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_console()) then

		local is_first_interact = self.current_state == self.states.before_interact_console
		local prev_state = self.current_state

		local is_entered = self.controller.sp_manager:try_start_scene(function(console)
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

			local can_hack = self.controller:interact_console_scene(console)

			if can_hack then

				local succeed = self:interact_console_routine(console, is_first_interact)

				if succeed then
					self:hacking_success_scene()

					self.controller:progress_section()
				else
					self.current_state = self.states.before_start_hacking

					self.controller:add_quest_marker(console)
				end
			else
				self.current_state = prev_state

				self.controller:add_quest_marker(console)
			end

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		end, e.Target)

		if is_entered then
			self.current_state = self.states.interacting_console

			self.controller:remove_quest_marker()

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_enter_coil_room and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's5_saul_coil_scene') then
		self.current_state = self.states.in_coil_room

		self.controller:remove_quest_marker()

		self.controller.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.coil_zone_enter_scene, self):Then(function()
			self.current_state = self.states.before_interact_console

			self.controller:add_quest_marker(self.get_console())
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:truck_open_scene()
	local npcs = {}
	local npc_count = 2
	local slayer = self.controller.get_demon_slayer()
	local operator = self.controller.get_demon_operator()

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				local truck = self.get_hiding_truck()

				self.controller.gimmick_controller:move_truck_routine(truck)

				music_player_util.play_sfx({
					sfx_name = '02_car_crashed_01',
					parent = truck,
					type_priority = 'event'
				})

				self.controller.gimmick_controller:remove_interact_ignore_truck(truck)
			end,
			function()
				wait_for_sec(0.3)

				--트럭 움직이기 시작하면 (1)(2) (damaged) 표정 마리오 점프로 우측 지점에서 알파페이드로 좌측 지점까지 이동

					local jump_position = self.get_saul_landing_npc_pos(index)

					character_util.set_position(npc, set_position)
					scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'damaged')

					character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, 1, truck_duration)

					character_util.mario_jump_new(npc, 'left', truck_duration, 1)

					wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, jump_position, nil, truck_duration, self, key_name)

					table.insert(npcs, npc)
				end

				--이때 카메라 트럭따라 이동
				local truck_camera_pos = get_party_leader().Position + vector(0, 0, 2)

	character_util.reset_locked_dir(npcs[2])

	scene_util.set_direction(npcs[2], 'right')

	scene_util.set_emotion(npcs[1], self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_emotion(npcs[2], self, 'scared')

	--(1)(여)(right,scared,cast): 트, 트럭 안은 안전할거라 생각했는데…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(

			nil,

	--(2)(남)(right,scared,idle)(shake0.03): 도대체 무슨 일이 일어난거지?!
	scene_util.shake(npcs[2], 0.03, 0.3)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[2],

	--3마신 해당 경로로 정렬 후 (left,idle,idle)
	do

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(

			operator,
			self,
			'up',
			'idle',
			'tired',
			'lw_demon_god_s5_9'
	)

	--크로셀(left,sleep_deep,idle): 민간인들을 건드려서 좋을 건 없으니까요.

			operator,
			self,
			'left',
			'idle',
			'sleep_deep',
			'lw_demon_god_s5_10'

			slayer,
			self,
			'left',
			'staff_idle',
			'sleep_deep',
			'silence'
	)

	--안드라스(left,damaged,bomb_idle): 그래… 알겠다.

			self,
			'left',
			'bomb_idle',

			'lw_demon_god_s5_12'
	)

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent), 'on_door_opened_event')

	self:field_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_state = self.states.before_rescue_battle

	do
		local rescue_zone = field_util.get_zone(self.rescue_battle.zone_name)
		local marker_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(rescue_zone.Bounds.center)

		self.controller:add_quest_marker(marker_pos)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent))

	self.current_state = self.states.done
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_rescue_battle and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.rescue_battle.zone_name) then
		self.current_state = self.states.in_before_rescue

		self.controller.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(function()
			self:rescue_npc_before_scene()
			self:activate_rescue_battle()

			self.current_state = self.states.in_rescue_battle
		end)

		return true

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.before_creature_battle and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.creature_battle.zone_name) then
		self.current_state = self.states.in_creature_battle

		self:activate_creature_battle()

		return true

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.before_exit and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's6_stage_exit') then
		self.current_state = self.states.exiting

		self.controller:remove_quest_marker()

		self.controller.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.stage_clear_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.in_rescue_battle and
			e.BattleGroupName == self.rescue_battle.group_name then
		self.current_state = self.states.after_rescue_battle

		self.rescue_battle:open_battle_gate()

		self.controller.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(function()
			self:rescue_npc_after_scene()

			do
				local bottom_puzzle_entrance_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_bottom_puzzle_entrance')

				self.controller:add_quest_marker(bottom_puzzle_entrance_pos)
			end

			self.current_state = self.states.before_enter_bottom_puzzle
		end)

		return true

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.in_creature_battle and
			e.BattleGroupName == self.creature_battle.group_name then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_interact_console

		self.creature_battle:open_battle_gate()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_enter_bottom_puzzle and
			type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 's6_bottom_puzzle') then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_clear_bottom_puzzle

		do
			local door = get_field_object(self.bottom_puzzle_door_name)

			self.controller:add_quest_marker(door)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_door_opened_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_clear_bottom_puzzle and
			e.DoorHandleName == self.bottom_puzzle_door_name then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_creature_battle

		do
			local console = self.get_console()

			self.controller:add_quest_marker(console)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if (self.current_state == self.states.before_interact_console or
			self.current_state == self.states.before_start_hacking) and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_console()) then

		local is_first_interact = self.current_state == self.states.before_interact_console
		local prev_state = self.current_state

		local is_entered = self.controller.sp_manager:try_start_scene(function(console)
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

			local can_hack = self.controller:interact_console_scene(console)

			if can_hack then

				local succeed = self:interact_console_routine(console, is_first_interact)

				if succeed then
					self.current_state = self.states.after_hacking

					self:hacking_success_scene()

					self.controller:dispose_block_from_s3_creatures_fogs()

					do
						local marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_exit_quest_marker')

						self.controller:add_quest_marker(marker_pos)
					end

					self.current_state = self.states.before_exit
				else
					self.current_state = self.states.before_start_hacking

					self.controller:add_quest_marker(console)
				end
			else
				self.current_state = prev_state

				self.controller:add_quest_marker(console)
			end

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		end, e.Target)

		if is_entered then
			self.current_state = self.states.interacting_console

			self.controller:remove_quest_marker()

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:field_setting()
	do
		local npc_count = 3

		--( 1 )(left,scared,cast) cw_saul#cw_saul_civilian_male_a
		--( 2 )(left,scared,cast)cw_saul#cw_saul_civilian_female_b
		--( 3 )(left,scared,idle)cw_saul#cw_saul_oldman
		for index = 1, npc_count do
			local npc = self.get_saul_citizens(index)

			character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')

			character_util.set_position(npc,
					field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_rescue_npc_pos_' .. index))

			character_util.set_direction(npc, 'left')
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'scared')
		end
	end

	self.rescue_battle:foreach_monster(function(index, monster)
		local position = field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_rescue_monster_pos_' .. index)

		character_util.set_position(monster, position)
		character_util.set_direction(monster, 'right')
	end)

	self.creature_battle:foreach_monster(function(index, monster)
		local position = field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_creature_battle_labose_creature_' .. index)

		character_util.set_position(monster, position)
		character_util.set_direction(monster, 'right')

		-- 전투 대기 상태로 세팅
		character_util.convert_to_monster(
				monster,
				self.creature_battle.group_name,
				self.creature_battle.zone_name
		)

		character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'visible')
	end)

	do
		local console = self.get_console()

		console.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.mana_cannon_door_name .. 1, true))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.mana_cannon_door_name .. 2, true))
end

	--해당 방 들어가면 이벤트 재생 (빨간존 진입시)

		table.insert(npcs, npc)
	end

			npcs[2],
			self,

			nil,

	)

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[1],
			self,
			'left',
			'idle',
			nil,
			'lw_demon_god_s6_2'
	)

	--(3)(left,scared,idle):하이고… 내 인생아.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[3],
			self,
			'left',
			nil,
			nil,
			'lw_demon_god_s6_3'
	)

	--0.5초간 카메라 플레이어에게 복귀 후 8체의 역병 괴물과 전투
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

function local_class:interact_console_routine(console, is_first_interact)
	local slayer = self.controller.get_demon_slayer()
	local power_girl = self.controller.get_demon_powergirl()
	local operator = self.controller.get_demon_operator()

	if is_first_interact then
		--(1)(크로셀)(2)(안드라스)(3)(파이몬)(left,idle,idle) 0.5초
		scene_util.set_direction(slayer, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(operator, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(power_girl, 'left', false)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--카메라 1초간 마나대포 중앙으로 이동
		camera_util.move_async(field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_mana_cannon_pos'), 1)

		--1초 대기 후 0.5초간 다시 크로셀에게 복귀
		wait_for_sec(1)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

		scene_util.set_direction(operator, 'right', false)
		local eat_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_typing_01', loop = true })
		--크로셀(right,idle,eat) 1초
		scene_util.play_wait_action(
				operator,
				self,
				nil,
				'eat',
				'idle',
				1
		)

		eat_loop_sfx:FadeOut()
		eat_loop_sfx = nil

		--파이몬(left,attack,cast2): 언제 나를 해적선까지 데려온거냐! 크로셀!

				self,

				'cast2',
				'attack',
				'lw_demon_god_s6_22'
		)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		--안드라스(left,damaged,bomb_idle): 파이몬 여기는 해적선이…

				slayer,

				'bomb_idle',

				'lw_demon_god_s6_23'
		)

		--안드라스(left,tired,idle)(annoyed) 이모티콘 버블
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')

				self,
				nil,
				'idle',

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(

				nil,
				'bomb_idle',
				'tired',
				'lw_demon_god_s6_24'

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(

				{ name = 'release', count = 2 },

				'lw_demon_god_s6_25'

				'idle',
				'lw_demon_god_s6_26'

		local eat_loop_sfx_2 = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_typing_01', loop = true })

	--3번째 해킹
	-- 해킹 액티비티 진행
	local result = self.controller:play_hacking_routine(console, 'lw_sub_demongod_s6', function()

		self.controller:show_hacking_speech_async('lw_demon_god_s5_33')
	end, function()
		--… 귀찮게 하네요.
		self.controller:show_hacking_speech_async('lw_demon_god_s5_34')
	end)

	return result
end

function local_class:hacking_success_scene()
	local slayer = self.controller.get_demon_slayer()
	local power_girl = self.controller.get_demon_powergirl()
	local operator = self.controller.get_demon_operator()

	scene_util.set_direction(slayer, 'up', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(power_girl, 'up', false)

	--크로셀 카메라로 복귀
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--나레이션 박스
	--제어 콘솔을 해킹해 대포의 제어권을 얻었다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lw_demon_god_s6_27' })

	--크로셀(left,idle,idle): 좋아요. 준비는 끝났어요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			operator,
			self,
			'left',
			'nod',
			'idle',
			'lw_demon_god_s6_28'
	)

	scene_util.set_direction(slayer, 'left')
	scene_util.set_direction(power_girl, 'left')

	--카메라 1초간 대포로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_mana_cannon_pos'), 1)

	--대포앞에 2개의 도어 개방 애니메이션 재생
	do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.mana_cannon_door_name .. 1, false))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.mana_cannon_door_name .. 2, false))

		wait_for_sec(2)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	--애니메이션 재생 끝나면 QTE(UP) 발생 (실패X)
	qte_util.swipe('up')
	--입력시

	--오브젝트 애니메이션 재생
	--mana_cannon_45
	local cannon = get_field_object('s6_mana_cannon')
	animator_util.play(cannon,'on_45')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_cannon_move_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--페이드 아웃 후 좌측 끝 라보스 안개깔려있는 곳으로 카메라 이동 페이드 인
	local creature_fog_effects = {}

	do
		local duration = 1

		screen_util.fade_out_async(duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		camera_util.move_async(field_util.get_marker_pos(
				's3_encounter_creatures_panning_center'), 0)

		do
			local spawn_count = 4
			local spawn_marker_table  = {
				1, 2, 5, 8
			}
			local spawn_offsets = {
				vector(0.5, 0, 0.5),
				vector(-0.5, 0, 0.5),
				vector(0.5, 0, -0.5),
				vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5),
			}

			local spawn_fog = function(index)
				local pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_encounter_creatures_panning_fog_pivot_' .. index)
				local effect_set = {}

				for _, spawn_offset in pairs(spawn_offsets) do
					local effect = self.fx.virus_fog():Instantiate(pivot + spawn_offset)

					table.insert(effect_set, effect)
				end

				table.insert(creature_fog_effects, effect_set)
			end

			for i = 1, spawn_count do
				spawn_fog(spawn_marker_table[i])
			end

		end

		screen_util.fade_in_async(duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end

	--페이드 인 후 1초 대기 후 화면 중앙 상단에 말꼬리 없는 말풍선으로 대사
	wait_for_sec(1)

	do
		local screen_offset = vector(0.5, 0.85)

		--크로셀 : 에너지 리미트를 해제합니다.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(
				operator,
				'lw_demon_god_s6_29',
				true,
				{
					viewport_pos = screen_offset
				})

		--크로셀 : 전탄 포격 개시.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(
				operator,
				'lw_demon_god_s6_30',
				true,
				{
					viewport_pos = screen_offset
				})
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	--QTE(LEFT)(실패X)
	qte_util.swipe('left')

	local function saturation_routine(end_pos, height, duration, monster_table, fog_table)
		local start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(end_pos, height)
		local attack_range = attack_range_util.create_circle(end_pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0),
				2, nil, nil, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

		local range_duration = 1

		attack_range_util.show(attack_range, range_duration)

		wait_for_sec(range_duration)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_lockon_01',
			play_pos = end_pos
		})
		--어택레인지는 1초동안 차오르고 다 차오른 순간에 fx_cw_mana_canon_red_missile_proj 가 어택레인지 중앙으로 낙하.
		local fx_bombing_proj = self.fx.cw_mana_canon_red_missile_proj():Instantiate(start_pos)
		local missile_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_missile_loop_01',
				loop = true, play_pos = end_pos })

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
			local change_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

			fx_bombing_proj.transform.position = change_pos
		end)

		attack_range_util.hide(attack_range)

		missile_loop_sfx:FadeOut()
		missile_loop_sfx = nil
		fx_bombing_proj:Dispose()
		fx_bombing_proj = nil

		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '02_fire_explosion_03',
			play_pos = end_pos
		})

		--이 후 해당 자리에 fx_cw_mana_canon_red_missile_proj_explosion 가 생성된다.
		local explosion = self.fx.cw_mana_canon_red_missile_proj_explosion():Instantiate(end_pos)

		explosion.transform.localScale = explosion.transform.localScale * 2

		for index = 1, table_util.get_size(monster_table) do
			character_util.air_spin(monster_table[index])
		end

		for _, effect in pairs(fog_table) do
			effect:Dispose()
		end

		camera_util.shake(0.2, 1)
	end
	--입력시 하단 연출 재생
	--[1]번 부터 [4]번까지 어택레인지가 0.5초 간격으로 생성
	--어택레인지 다 찬 순간과 해당 이펙트 재생이 같도록
	--해당 이펙트 처음 생성될 때 shake 0.2 마지막 4번째 이펙트 재생 후 1초간 유지 (총 3초 지속)
	--해당 이펙트 범위내에 역병괴물과 안개는 사라짐

	do
		local wait_duration = 0.5
		local drop_duration = 1
		local drop_height = 10

		local labose_creatures = {}
		local monster_count = 8

		for index = 1, monster_count do
			local monster = self.get_cannon_clear_monster(index)

			table.insert(labose_creatures, monster)
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bombard_range_01')
		start_coroutine(
				saturation_routine,
				field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_encounter_creatures_panning_fog_pivot_8'),
				drop_height,
				drop_duration,
				{
					labose_creatures[7],
					labose_creatures[8]
				},
				creature_fog_effects[4]
		)

		wait_for_sec(wait_duration)

		start_coroutine(
				saturation_routine,
				field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_encounter_creatures_panning_fog_pivot_5'),
				drop_height,
				drop_duration,
				{
					labose_creatures[5],
					labose_creatures[6]
				},
			creature_fog_effects[3]
		)

		wait_for_sec(wait_duration)

		start_coroutine(
				saturation_routine,
				field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_encounter_creatures_panning_fog_pivot_2'),
				drop_height,
				drop_duration,
				{
					labose_creatures[3],
					labose_creatures[4]
				},
				creature_fog_effects[2]
		)

		wait_for_sec(wait_duration)

		start_coroutine(
				saturation_routine,
				field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_encounter_creatures_panning_fog_pivot_1'),
				drop_height,
				drop_duration,
				{
					labose_creatures[1],
					labose_creatures[2]
				},
				creature_fog_effects[1]
		)
	end

	wait_for_sec(2)

	--마지막 이펙트 재생 2초 후 페이드 아웃 크로셀 카메라로 페이드 인
	do
		local duration = 1

		screen_util.fade_out_async(duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

		animator_util.play(cannon, 'idle')

		screen_util.fade_in_async(duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--크로셀(left,idle,nod2회): 좋아요. 이제 여길 빠져나갈 수 있겠네요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			operator,
			self,
			'left',
			'nod',
			'idle',
			'lw_demon_god_s6_31'
	)

	--파이몬(left,smile,victory_get): 하하하! 드디어 출항이구나!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			power_girl,
			self,
			'left',
			'victory_get',
			'smile',
			'lw_demon_god_s6_32'
	)

	--안드라스(left,damaged,bomb_idle): 돌아가면 오늘 받은 치욕의 대가는 제대로 청구할 것이다…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			slayer,
			self,
			'left',
			'bomb_idle',
			'damaged',
			'lw_demon_god_s6_33'
	)

	--컨트롤 해제 메인 마커 위치 변경
end

function local_class:stage_clear_scene()
	local npcs = {}

	local slayer = self.controller.get_demon_slayer()
	local power_girl = self.controller.get_demon_powergirl()
	local operator = self.controller.get_demon_operator()

	do
		local npc_count = 2

		for index = 1, npc_count do
			local npc = self.get_s5_saul_citizens(index)

			character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

			table.insert(npcs, npc)
		end
	end

	do
		local npc_count = 3

		for index = 1, npc_count do
			local npc = self.get_saul_citizens(index)

			table.insert(npcs, npc)
		end
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--안드라스 파이몬 크로셀 해당 대열로 2초간 정렬 (run)모션
	do
		local move_key = 'parse_1'
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(
				slayer,
				field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_slayer_clear_pos_1'),
				7,
				nil,
				self,
				move_key,
				{ run = true }
		)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(
				power_girl,
				field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_power_girl_clear_pos_1'),

				nil,
				self,
				move_key,
				{ run = true }
		)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(
				operator,
				field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_operator_clear_pos_1'),
				7,
				nil,
				self,
				move_key,
				{ run = true }

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	scene_util.set_direction(operator, 'right')
	scene_util.set_direction(power_girl, 'right')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(
			operator,
			'lw_demon_god_s6_33_1',
			true,
			{ viewport_pos = vector(0.7, 0.8) })

	camera_util.move(operator.Position, 0.5)

	--우측 그리드 밖에서 부터 해당 5명이 1초간 (run)으로 정렬

		local npc_count = 5
		local move_key = 'npcs_move'
		local move_offset = vector(-8,0,0)

			character_util.set_position(npcs[index],
					field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_npc_clear_pos_' .. index))

			npcs[index].SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(
					npcs[index],
					npcs[index].Position + move_offset,
					7,
					nil,
					self,
					move_key,
					{ run = true,
					  last_direction = 'left',
					  play_sfx = true }
			)
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
	end

	--(1)cw_saul#cw_saul_worker
	--(2)cw_saul#cw_saul_civilian_female_a
	--(3)cw_saul#cw_saul_civilian_female_b
	--(4)cw_saul#cw_saul_civilian_male_a
	--(5)cw_saul#cw_saul_oldman

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[1],
			self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'tired',
			'lw_demon_god_s6_34'
	)

	--크로셀(right,idle,bomb_idle): 여러분들은 사울의 주민 아니신가요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			operator,
			self,
			nil,
			'bomb_idle',
			'idle',
			'lw_demon_god_s6_35'
	)

	--크로셀(right,idle,idle): 저희는 지금 리리스의 진영으로 가고 있답니다?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			operator,
			self,
			nil,
			'idle',
			'idle',
			'lw_demon_god_s6_36'
	)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	--(2)(left,tired,cast): 아, 알아요… 하지만.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[2],
			self,
			nil,
			'cast',
			'tired',
			'lw_demon_god_s6_37'
	)

	--(3)(left,scared,idle): 어차피 주변에 괴물들 때문에 사울로 돌아가지도 못한다고요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[3],
			self,
			nil,
			'idle',
			'scared',
			'lw_demon_god_s6_38'
	)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_03')
	--파이몬(숙주): 마, 맞아요. 안전한 도심부까지 가려면 꽤 걸릴거에요.
	self.controller:talk_host_scope(power_girl, function()
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(power_girl, self, nil,
				'idle', 'idle', 'lw_demon_god_s6_39')
	end)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	--(4)(left,smile,cast2): 그리고 당신들 곁에 있으면 무조건 안전할 거 아니에요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[4],
			self,
			nil,
			'cast2',

local controller_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Base/QuestControllerBase')

---@class LaboseWorldDemonQueenController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldDemonQueenController', controller_base)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	-- 사용할 섹션 스크립트 정보. 주석 해제하고 사용
	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = true,
		NormalSectionCount = 5,
		HasPostSection = false
	}

	-- 퀘스트 아이디
	self.quest_id = self.cs_controller.QuestId

	-- 퀘스트 마커 이름
	self.quest_marker_name = 'lw_demon_queen'

	-- 리리스
	self.get_demon_queen = function() return get_character('demon_queen') end

	-- 모리안
	self.get_demon_governor = function() return get_character('demon_governor') end

	self.fx = {
		virus_death_explosion = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lilithtower_virus_death_explosion')
		end,
		black_liquid = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_black_liquid')
		end,
		cracked_space_start = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_cracked_space_start')
		end,
		cracked_space = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_cracked_space')
		end,
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,

		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	self.is_stage_end = false

	self.is_show_crash_event = false
	self.crash_state_save_key = 'is_show_crash_event'

	self.cracked_space_count = 4

	self.cached_black_liquid_effects = {}
	self.cached_cracked_space_effects = {}
	self.cached_light_loop_sfx_list = {}

	self.is_s4_door_hitting_ghoul = false

	self.s4_cracked_space_effect = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	if stage.Name ~= 'lw_sub_lilith' then
		return
	end

	self.fx:load_all()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WatchingCameraGridChangedEvent))

	self:dispose_black_liquid()
	self:dispose_cracked_space()
	self:dispose_light_loop_sfx()

	if self.s4_cracked_space_effect ~= nil then
		self.s4_cracked_space_effect:Dispose()
		self.s4_cracked_space_effect = nil
	end

	self.super:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.is_show_crash_event == false and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'cracked_space_event_zone_1') then
		self.is_show_crash_event = true
		local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('event_cracked_space_pos_1')
		start_coroutine(self.enter_event_cracked_zone, self, target_pos)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_watching_camera_grid_changed_event(_)
	self:set_light_loop_sfx()

	return true
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	-- 리리스 서브스테이지가 아니면 return
	if stage.Name ~= 'lw_sub_lilith' then
		return
	end

	-- 퀘스트 섹션이 4이하 일 때 리리스 기본 표정 tired
	if self.cs_controller.StartingInnerProgress < 4 then
		local demon_queen = self.get_demon_queen()
		demon_queen.SpineController:SetCustomDefaultEmotion('tired')
		character_util.remove_emotion(demon_queen)
	end

	local is_first_section = self.cs_controller.StartingInnerProgress < 1
	if is_first_section == false then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WatchingCameraGridChangedEvent), 'on_watching_camera_grid_changed_event')
		self:set_s1_liquid_effect()
	else
		self:set_light_loop_sfx()
	end

	local quest_progress = self.cs_controller.QuestProgress
	self.is_show_crash_event = quest_util.get_custom_state(quest_progress, self.crash_state_save_key) > 0

	if self.is_show_crash_event == false then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	else
		local cracked_space_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('event_cracked_space_pos_1')

		table.insert(self.cached_cracked_space_effects, {
			effect = self.fx.cracked_space():Instantiate(cracked_space_pos),
			pos = cracked_space_pos,
		})
	end

	self:set_default_cracked_space()

	if quest_progress and quest_progress.IsComplete then
		self:s5_ending_setting()
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
	self.is_stage_end = true
end

function local_class:set_s1_liquid_effect()
	local liquid_count = 10

	for i = 1, liquid_count do
		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_liquid_pos_' .. i)
		self:set_black_liquid_effect(pos)
	end
end

-- L-박테리아 폭발 연출 진행
function local_class:labose_explosion(npc, is_camera_shake)
	is_camera_shake = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_camera_shake, false)

	-- NPC shake 0.03 세기로 지속 출력
	character_util.shake(npc, 0.03, 9999)

	-- NPC 0.5초에 걸쳐 스파인 0.7배로 줄어든다.
	character_util.add_color(npc, npc.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.8, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_scale(npc, vector(0.7, 0.7, 0.7), 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if is_camera_shake then
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
	end

	-- 이후 fx_lilithtower_virus_death_explosion와 함께 사라짐
	local explosion_pos = npc.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fly_explosion_02', loop = false, play_pos = explosion_pos })
	self.fx.virus_death_explosion():Instantiate(explosion_pos)

	character_util.stop_shake(npc)
	character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
	character_util.remove_color(npc, npc.Name, 0)

	-- 폭발한 스파인 자리에 fx_cw_black_liquid 이펙트 배치
	self:set_black_liquid_effect(explosion_pos)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

function local_class:set_black_liquid_effect(pos)
	local black_liquid_effect = self.fx.black_liquid():Instantiate(pos)
	table.insert(self.cached_black_liquid_effects, black_liquid_effect)
end

function local_class:set_default_cracked_space()
	for i = 1, self.cracked_space_count do
		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('cracked_space_pos_' .. i)

		local cracked_space = {}
		cracked_space.effect = self.fx.cracked_space():Instantiate(pos)
		cracked_space.pos = pos

		table.insert(self.cached_cracked_space_effects, cracked_space)
	end
end

function local_class:enter_event_cracked_zone(pos)
	do
		--TODO: 일단 한 구역만 있는거 같아서 안에 넣음, 만약 다른 구역 에서도 이러한 연출이 관리 되어야 한다면 수정 필요
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.crash_state_save_key, 1)
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	end

	self:set_cracked_space(pos)
end

function local_class:set_cracked_space(pos, is_start_effect)
	is_start_effect = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_start_effect, true)

	if is_start_effect then
		--카메라 shake(0.2, 0.1)
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)

		-- start 이팩트 재생 후
		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '02_lightning_strike_01', loop = false,
			type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc',
			play_pos = pos
		})
		self.fx.cracked_space_start():Instantiate(pos)

		-- 1초 뒤 일그러짐 이팩트 재생
		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(1, function(_)
			return not self.is_stage_end
		end)

		-- 카메라 shake(0.4, 0.25)
		camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.25)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_break_window_01', play_pos = pos })
	end

	local cracked_space = {}
	cracked_space.effect = self.fx.cracked_space():Instantiate(pos)
	cracked_space.pos = pos

	table.insert(self.cached_cracked_space_effects, cracked_space)

	self:set_light_loop_sfx()
end

function local_class:dispose_black_liquid()
	if self.cached_black_liquid_effects == nil then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.cached_black_liquid_effects do
		self.cached_black_liquid_effects[i]:Dispose()
	end

	self.cached_black_liquid_effects = nil
end

function local_class:dispose_cracked_space()
	if self.cached_cracked_space_effects == nil then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.cached_cracked_space_effects do
		self.cached_cracked_space_effects[i].effect:Dispose()
		self.cached_cracked_space_effects[i].pos = nil
	end

	self.cached_cracked_space_effects = nil
end

function local_class:start_s4_door_hit_ghoul(character, first_delay)
	self.is_s4_door_hitting_ghoul = true

	start_coroutine(self.s4_door_hit_ghoul_routine, self, character, first_delay)
end

function local_class:stop_s4_door_hit_ghoul_routines()
	self.is_s4_door_hitting_ghoul = false
end

-- FIXME : 루틴 하나에서 돌리는게 제일 좋지만, 애니메이션 콜백이 추가되면 해당 루틴이 필요없어질 수도 있어서 일단 패스
function local_class:s4_door_hit_ghoul_routine(character, first_delay)
	local hit_delay = 0.3
	local time_passed = hit_delay - first_delay
	local hit_pos = character.Position + vector(-0.35, 0.6, 0)

	while not self.is_stage_end and self.is_s4_door_hitting_ghoul do
		if time_passed >= first_delay then
			time_passed = time_passed - hit_delay

			if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(character.Position, get_party_leader().Position) then
				self.fx.hit():Instantiate(hit_pos)

				music_player_util.play_sfx({
					sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01',
					max_distance = 8,
					play_pos = character.Position,
					type_priority = 'event',
					player_priority = 'npc',
				})
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end
end

function local_class:s5_ending_setting()
	local battle_center = field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_battle_center')
	local passage_center = field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_passage_center')

	local effect_pos = {
		passage_center + vector(-1.5, 0, -3),
		passage_center + vector(-1, 0, -1),
		passage_center + vector(0.5, 0, -1),
		passage_center + vector(-1.5, 0, 0.5),
		passage_center + vector(1, 0, 1),
		passage_center + vector(-0.5, 0, 2),
		passage_center + vector(1.5, 0, 2),
		passage_center + vector(-1.5, 0, 3),
		passage_center + vector(0, 0, 3),
		passage_center + vector(1.5, 0, 4),
		battle_center + vector(0.5, 0, 1.5),
		battle_center + vector(-0.5, 0, -2.5),
		battle_center + vector(1.5, 0, -4),
		battle_center + vector(-1.5, 0, -4.5),
		battle_center
	}

	for i = 1, #effect_pos do
		self:set_black_liquid_effect(effect_pos[i] + vector(0, 0.03, 0))
	end

	-- 모리안 무기
	drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = battle_center + vector(-1.5, 0, 1.5),
		itemid = 21172,
		sprscale = 0.8,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
	})

	-- 모리안 꽃
	drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = battle_center + vector(2.5, 0, -1),
		itemid = 21173,
		sprscale = 0.6,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
	})
end

function local_class:set_light_loop_sfx(max_distance)
	if self.cached_cracked_space_effects == nil then
		return
	end

	max_distance = lua_helper.get_or_default(max_distance, 10)

	self:reset_light_loop_sfx()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	for i = 1, #self.cached_cracked_space_effects do
		local effect_pos = self.cached_cracked_space_effects[i].pos

		if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(effect_pos, leader.Position) then
			local sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '02_light_loop_04',
				type_priority = 'loop',
				play_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(effect_pos, 1),
				max_distance = max_distance,
				loop = true,
			})

			table.insert(self.cached_light_loop_sfx_list, sfx)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_light_loop_sfx()
	if self.cached_light_loop_sfx_list == nil then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.cached_light_loop_sfx_list do
		self.cached_light_loop_sfx_list[i]:Stop()
	end

	self.cached_light_loop_sfx_list = nil
end

function local_class:reset_light_loop_sfx()
	self:dispose_light_loop_sfx()
	self.cached_light_loop_sfx_list = {}
end

return local_class

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)

	if quest_progress.InnerProgress > 8 then
		local queen = self.get_demon_queen()

		character_util.add_listener(queen, self.cs_controller)

		quest_icon_util.set_substage_icon(queen)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)

	if quest_progress.InnerProgress > 7 and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_demon_queen()) then

		local queen = self.get_demon_queen()

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

		character_util.remove_relate_event(queen, self.cs_controller)
		quest_icon_util.remove(queen)

		self.sp_manager:try_start_scene(self.stage_open_scene, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params[0] == 'demon_queen_sub_stage_active' then
		local queen = self.get_demon_queen()

		character_util.add_listener(queen, self.cs_controller)

		quest_icon_util.set_substage_icon(queen)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:stage_open_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local queen = self.get_demon_queen()
	local engineer = self.get_demon_engineer()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--9섹션 연출 이후 아래와 같이 정렬됐을 때 리리스 인터렉트 하면 진행 가능
	--리리스 인터렉트 시 컨트롤 뺏으며, 기사와 비네트. 리리스 오른쪽으로 1.5타일 간격으로 정렬
	do
		local leader_offset = vector(1.5,0,0)
		local engineer_offset = vector(2.5,0,0)
		local move_key = 'align_move'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, queen.Position + leader_offset,
				4, nil, self, move_key, {
					last_direction = 'left'
				})

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(engineer, queen.Position + engineer_offset,
				4, nil, self, move_key, {
					last_direction = 'left'
				})
		--정렬 완료되면 (left, idle, idle) 출력

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
	end

	--카메라는 리리스, 기사, 비네트 중심으로 정렬
	do
		local camera_pos = leader.Position + vector(-0.75, 0, 0)

		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0.5)
	end
	--정렬 완료되면 대사 진행

	--리리스(right, tired, idle): 비네트, 장막 안쪽에는 뭐가 있는 거지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			queen,
			self,
			'right',
			'idle',
			{name = 'tired', keep = true},
			'lw_sub_dq_pre1_1'
	)

	--비네트(left, idle, idle): 균열의 중심부니까… 아마 더 많은 괴물들이 있을 거야.
	--위 대사 출력 시 리리스 (right, tired, idle) 지속 출력
	scene_util.set_emotion(queen, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			engineer,
			self,
			'left',
			'idle',
			'idle',
			'lw_sub_dq_pre1_2'
	)

	--리리스 (right, tear, idle) 선 출력 이후 1초 뒤 대사 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(queen, self, 'tear')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--리리스(right, tear, idle): 에리나…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			queen,
			self,
			'right',
			'idle',
			nil,
			'lw_sub_dq_pre1_3'
	)

	--비네트 (left, sleep_deep, cross_arm) 상태에서 (slience) 버블 이모티콘 출력
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(
			engineer,
			self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false },
			'sleep_deep',
			'silence'
	)

	--비네트(left, idle, idle): 리리스, 여기저기 혼란에 빠진 병력들이 많으니까, 먼저 그들을 모아.
	scene_util.set_emotion(queen, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			engineer,
			self,
			'left',
			'idle',
			'idle',
			'lw_sub_dq_pre1_4'
	)

	--비네트(left, idle, idle): 체계적인 방어선을 구축하지 못하면…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			engineer,
			self,
			'left',
			'cross_arm',
			'sleep_deep',
			'lw_sub_dq_pre1_5'
	)

	--비네트(left, idle, idle): 마계는 정말 끝날지도 몰라.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			engineer,
			self,
			'left',
			'idle',
			'idle',
			'lw_sub_dq_pre1_6'
	)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--비네트(left, idle, idle): 너만이 할 수 있는 일이야, 알고 있지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			engineer,
			self,
			'left',
			'idle',
			'idle',
			'lw_sub_dq_pre1_7'
	)

	--리리스(right, tired, idle) 상태에서 (slience) 버블 이모티콘 출력
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(
			queen,
			self,
			'right',
			'idle',
		nil,
			'silence'
	)

	--리리스(right, idle, idle): 알겠어, 내가 어떻게든 병력을 모아볼게.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			queen,
			self,
			'right',
			'idle',
			'attack',
			'lw_sub_dq_pre1_8'
	)

	character_util.set_direction(queen, 'right')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--이후 스테이지 오픈
	--잔류 병사들이 있는 전장의 위치를 찾았다.
	stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({
		substage_name = 'lw_sub_lilith',
		substage_open_string_key = 'lw_sub_demon_queen_pre_1'
	})

	self.controller:activate_quest()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldDemonQueenSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = LaboseWorldDemonQueen @
		Comment = 프리실라와 대화 후 모리안 풀어준 뒤 전투하는 씬 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type LaboseWorldDemonQueenController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'lw_sub_lilith'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		enter_demon_governor_zone = 2,
		show_saul_soldier_talk = 3,
		show_explosion_event = 4,
		event_battle_start = 5,
		ending = 6,
	}
	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.fx = {
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		proj_contrail = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_symptom_ghost_liquid_proj_contrail')
		end,
		proj_explosion = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_ghost_liquid_proj_explosion')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	self.get_demon_queen = function() return self.controller.get_demon_queen() end
	self.get_demon_governor = function() return self.controller.get_demon_governor() end
	self.get_police = function(index) return get_character('s1_police_' .. index) end

	self.get_labose_creature = function(index) return get_character('s1_labose_creature_' .. index) end

	self.creature_count = 7

	self.police_count = 4
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:load_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	local demon_governor = self.get_demon_governor()

	scene_util.set_direction(demon_governor, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_governor, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_governor, self, 'seat')

	character_util.set_active_state(demon_governor, 'enabled')
	demon_governor.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_demon_governor_1')

	for i = 1, self.police_count do
		local police = self.get_police(i)

		police.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'rifle_idle'
		police.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'rifle_walk'
		police.CustomRunAnimationName = 'rifle_run'
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(police)
		scene_util.set_anim(police, self, 'rifle_idle')
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(self.start_scene, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.is_exit = true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_state <= self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's1_event_zone_1') then
		self.current_state = self.states.enter_demon_governor_zone
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_demon_governor_scene, self)
		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.enter_demon_governor_zone and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's1_event_zone_2') then
		self.current_state = self.states.show_saul_soldier_talk
		start_coroutine(self.show_saul_soldier_talk_event, self)
		return true
	elseif self.current_state <= self.states.show_saul_soldier_talk and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's1_event_zone_3') then
		self.current_state = self.states.show_explosion_event
		sp_util.start_scene(self.show_explosion_event_scene, self)
		return true
	elseif self.current_state <= self.states.show_explosion_event and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's1_event_zone_4') then
		self.current_state = self.states.event_battle_start
		sp_util.start_scene(self.event_battle_start_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 's1_event_battle' then
		start_coroutine(self.event_battle_end_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_scene()
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	screen_util.fade_out(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')

	local dynamic_npc_list = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async({
		half_vampire = 'lw_half_vampire',
		s1_dynamic_police_1 = 'lw_demon_police_female',

		s1_dynamic_police_3 = 'lw_demon_police_male',
	})

	local demon_queen = self.get_demon_queen()
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_queen, 'right', false)

	character_util.set_position(demon_queen, field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_demon_queen_pos_1'))
	character_util.set_active_state(demon_queen, 'enabled')

	local half_vampire = dynamic_npc_list['half_vampire']

	for i = 1, police_count do

	-- 카메라는 리리스와 병사 사이를 포커스로 위치

	-- fade in 완료되고 1초 후 대사 출력

	-- 리리스(right, attack, idle) : 그곳에서 내가 직접 진영을 가다듬고 사태를 수습할 것이다.

	-- A, B, C NPC (left, attack, salute 1회 출력 후 마지막에 정지 상태) [shout]: 네! 알겠습니다!

	character_util.remove_emotion(half_vampire)

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_queen, 'lw_sub_dq_s1_45')

	-- B NPC (up, rifle_idle): 네 알겠습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(police_list[2], 'lw_sub_dq_s1_46')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(police_list[2], self, { name = 'throw', loop = false })

	-- B NPC (up, attack 1회) 모션으로 위의 위치에 모리안 무기 스프라이트(cwp_demongovermor_epic)를 모리안에게 투척
	local cwp_demon_governor = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = police_list[2].Position + vector(0, 0, 0.2),
		target = demon_governor.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
		itemid = 21172, notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		spr_scale = 0.65,
	})

	cwp_demon_governor.SpriteTransform.localScale = vector(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
	cwp_demon_governor.ShadowTransform.localScale = vector(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_anim(police_list[2], self, 'rifle_idle')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 모리안은 습득 연출 바로 진행
	-- 알라우네
	eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_governor, self, 'eat')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim(demon_governor)

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	cwp_demon_governor.ConsumeTarget = demon_governor
	cwp_demon_governor:Fly()
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 이후 대화 진행
	-- 리리스 (right, idle, idle): 이동하지.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_queen, 'lw_sub_dq_s1_47')

	character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(demon_governor, user_party, true)

	-- A NPC (right, idle, rifle_idle): 리리스 각하, 괜찮으시겠지?
	-- B NPC (right, idle, rifle_idle): 다 생각이 있으시겠지… 어서 이동 준비나 하자고.
	-- C NPC (down, idle, rifle_idle): 밖엔 대체 무슨 일이 일어난 거야?
	-- D NPC (up, rifle_idle):심상치 않은데… 이동해도 괜찮겠지?
	local emotion_list = { 'tired', nil, nil, 'tired' }
	local dir_list = { 'down', 'right', 'down', 'left' }

	for i = 1, self.police_count do
		local police = self.get_police(i)

		if emotion_list[i] ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(police, self, emotion_list[i])
		end

		scene_util.set_direction(police, dir_list[i], false)
		police.Interactable.Talk = 'lw_sub_dq_s1_interact_' .. i
	end

	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.controller.quest_marker_name,
			self.controller.quest_id, true, vector(-22.5, 0, -29))

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end
