		character_util.remove_anim(innuit)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(innuit,
				innuit.Position + vector(-1.25, 0, 0),
				2,
				nil,
				self,
				move_key)

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_100', skip = true })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
		scene_util.set_anim(innuit, self, 'idle')
	end


	-- 코코(sleep_deep,idle): 나쁜 얘기든 좋은 얘기든… 이제 남의 시선따윈 신경쓰지 않을래.
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(innuit, self,
			nil,
			'idle',
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_101', skip = true })

	-- 코코(idle,idle)(silence) 이모티콘 버블
	character_util.remove_emotion(innuit)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(innuit, nil, 'silence')

	do
		local move_key = 'innuit_move_key'
		character_util.remove_anim(innuit)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(innuit,
				innuit.Position + vector(1.25, 0, 0),
				2,
				nil,
				self,
				move_key)

		-- 코코(right,sleep_deep,idle): 그래도 나에 대한 감사라면… 받아주는 게 예의겠지.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self,
				{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
				nil,
				{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
				{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_102', skip = true })

		-- 해당 대사와 동시에 속도 2로 우측 1칸 (walk)로 이동
		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
		scene_util.set_anim(innuit, self, 'idle')
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 원라인 전환
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
	self.controller:tanker_and_innuit_setting_clear()
	self.controller:save_custom_state(
			self.controller.interact_event_info_table.tanker_and_innuit.interact_event_id)
end

function local_class:interact_maiden()
	local maiden = self.controller.get_maiden()
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	local pivot_pos = self.controller.get_maiden_pos()
	local knight_pos = pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, -1)
	local princess_pos = pivot_pos

	-- 로레인 (down,idle,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(maiden, 'down', false)

	-- 대화걸면 로레인 우측으로 정렬
	party_util.align_party(pivot_pos, 'right', 0.5)

	-- 로레인(right,idle,idle)(jump 1회): 아, 오셨네요!
	character_util.normal_jump(maiden, '01_small_jump_01')
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(maiden, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_103', skip = true })

	-- 로레인(doyagao,bomb_idle): 뭐, 제 정체가 다 밝혀져서 조금은 어색하실지 모르겠지만…
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(maiden, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			{ name = 'doyagao' },
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_104', skip = true })

	-- 로레인(smile,sing): 어차피 우리가 정말 서로 믿고 따르던 사이는 아니였잖아요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(maiden, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'sing' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_105', skip = true })

	-- 선택지
	do

		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'lw_main_epilogue_106', 'mercy' },
			{ 'lw_main_epilogue_107', 'brutal' },
		})
		if choose_result == 1 then

			-- 난 널 믿었는데… (mercy)

			-- 가디언(tired,cast)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
			scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')
			scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'cast' })

			wait_for_sec(1)

			-- 로레인(right,tired,bomb_idle): 정말… 불쌍한 척 하나만큼은 일류 라니까요.
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
			self:custom_normal_speech_action(maiden, self,
					{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
					{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
					{ name = 'tired' },
					{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_108', skip = true })
		else
			-- 그렇긴 해! (brutal)

			-- 가디언(smile,nod2회)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
			scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')
			scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

			-- 로레인(smile,nod2회): 후후… 인정이 참 빨라서 좋네요.
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
			self:custom_normal_speech_action(maiden, self,
					nil,
					{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
					{ name = 'smile' },
					{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_109', skip = true })
		end

	end

	-- 로레인(idle,idle): 이제 주인도 사라졌고, 제 민낯도 다 보셨으니 남은 건 없죠?
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(maiden, self,
			nil,
			'idle',
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_110', skip = true })

	-- 로레인(smile,bomb_idle): 보다시피 전 이제 목적이라곤 하나도 남아있지 않답니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(maiden, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_111', skip = true })

	-- 로레인(idle,question): 그래서 말이에요. 그냥 당신과 공주랑 같이 지내기로 결정했어요.
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(maiden, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'question' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_112', skip = true })

	-- 로레인(idle,nod 2회): 왜냐면… 그 쪽이 더 편하고 재밌으니까요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(maiden, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_113', skip = true })

	wp_util.move_async(maiden, maiden.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 1)

	-- 로레인(smile,sing): 받아주실거죠?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(maiden, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'sing' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_114', skip = true })

	-- 선택지
	local choose_result_kick = -1

	while choose_result_kick ~= 1 do

		choose_result_kick = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'lw_main_epilogue_115', 'mercy' },
			{ 'lw_main_epilogue_116', 'brutal' },
		})

		if choose_result_kick == 1 then
			-- 받아들인다. (mercy)

			-- 가디언(left,smile,nod2회)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')
			scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
		else
			-- 걷어찬다. (brutal)

			-- 가디언(attack, gauntlet_kick 1회)
			scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
			scene_util.set_anim(knight, self,
					{ name = 'gauntlet_kick', count = 1, sfx_name = '02_normal_slash_01' })

			-- 이때 로레인 속도4로 좌측 1칸 뒷걸음질
			character_util.remove_anim(maiden)
			wp_util.move_async(maiden,
					maiden.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
					4,
					nil,
					{ locked_dir = 'right' })

			--CODE
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			-- 가디언(surprise,idle)(jump 1회)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
			scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'surprise')
			character_util.normal_jump_async(knight, '01_small_jump_01')

			-- 로레인 속도 1로 우측 1칸 이동(walk)
			character_util.remove_anim(maiden)
			wp_util.move_async(maiden,
					maiden.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
					1,
					nil,
					{ locked_dir = 'right' })

			-- 로레인(mad,bomb_idle): 후후, 저도 학습이란 걸 한답니다?
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_03')
			self:custom_normal_speech_action(maiden, self,
					nil,
					{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
					{ name = 'mad' },
					{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_117', skip = true })

			-- 받아들인다. 누를 때 까지 선택지 반복
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

		end

	end

	-- 로레인(smile,clap): 좋아요! 역시 말이 좀 통하시는 분이시군요?
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(maiden, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'clap' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_118', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(maiden)
	wp_util.move_async(maiden,
			maiden.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			1, nil,
			{ locked_dir = 'right' })

	-- 로레인(idle,idle): 그럼, 빨리 돌아가 또 식사를 준비해야겠네요.
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(maiden, self,
			nil,
			'idle',
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_119', skip = true })

	-- 로레인(idle,idle): 그동안 심심해서 공주 님을 위한 피망요리 레시피 몇십가지나 만들었답니다?
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(maiden, self,
			nil,
			'idle',
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_120', skip = true })

	-- 공주(left,surprise,idle)(jump 1회) 이 후 공주 (tired) 표정 유지
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(princess, '01_player_jump_01')

	-- 로레인(idle,bomb_idle): 모르죠, 그 안에 공주님이 좋아할만한 피망요리가 있을지도.
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(maiden, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_121', skip = true })

	do
		-- 공주 속도 1로 좌측 0.5칸 이동
		local move_key = 'princess_move'
		character_util.remove_anim(princess)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, princess.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 1,
				nil, self, move_key, { locked_dir = 'left' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

		-- 공주(left,tired,cast): 기사… 아무래도 다른 흑막이 있는 걸지도 몰라…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		self:custom_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'cast' },
				{ name = 'tired' },
				{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_122', skip = true })

		-- 공주 속도 1로 우측 0.5칸 이동 이때 표정 해제
		character_util.remove_anim(princess)
		wp_util.move_async(princess, princess.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 1)
	end

	-- 원라인 전환
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	self.controller:save_custom_state(self.controller.interact_event_info_table.maiden.interact_event_id)

	if self.controller.quest_info_table.civilwar_letter_from_maiden.is_complete then
		-- 17챕터 로레인의 카드키 퀘스트 클리어 시 추가 대화
		-- 클리어한 상태라면 원라인 전환 전에 해당 이벤트 출력
		self:interact_maiden_additional(false)

	else
		-- 원라인 전환
		self.controller:maiden_additional_setting_clear()
	end
end

			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_126', skip = true })

	-- 로레인(idle,question): 비네트 님이 멀쩡히 계셨으면 더 좋았을 거예요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(maiden, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'question' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_127', skip = true })

	-- 로레인(idle,bomb_idle): …조금의 답답함은 풀 수 있으셨을테니까요.
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(maiden, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_128', skip = true })

	-- 해당 스테이지 내부로 진입 가능

	-- 원라인 전환
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
	self.controller:maiden_additional_setting_clear()
	self.controller:save_custom_state(
			self.controller.interact_event_info_table.maiden_additional.interact_event_id)
end

			{ name = 'question' },
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_131', skip = true })

	-- 안드라스(idle,idle): 어디 방에 들어가더니 이 몸이 무안할 정도로 서글프게 울더구나.

			nil,

			1)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self:custom_wait_action(knight, self,

			{ name = 'seat' },

	self:custom_wait_action(knight, self,

	local goat_girl = self.controller.get_goat_girl()
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	local pivot_pos = self.controller.get_sheep_girl_pos()
	local knight_pos = pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, -1)
	local princess_pos = pivot_pos

	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.set_anim_async(sheep_girl, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
		scene_util.set_anim(sheep_girl, self, { name = 'idle' })

	self:custom_normal_speech_action(sheep_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },

	-- 흑염소(sleep_deep,cross_arm): 저렇게 착한 애가 어떻게 그 난폭한 양반한테서 나왔을까?
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(goat_girl, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cross_arm' },
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_225', skip = true })

	-- 흑염소(idle,idle): 클로드 그사람… 가족한테는 정이 참 많았을지도 모르겠다.
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(goat_girl, self,
			nil,
			'idle',
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_226', skip = true })

	-- 레이(left,smile,idle)(jump1회): 아, 니 왔나?
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(sheep_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			'idle',
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_227', skip = true })

	-- 흑염소(idle,release 2회): 이 사람은 누군데?
	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.set_anim_async(goat_girl, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
		scene_util.set_anim(goat_girl, self, { name = 'idle' })
	end)

	self:custom_normal_speech_action(goat_girl, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_228', skip = true })

	scene_util.set_anim(goat_girl, self, { name = 'idle' })

	-- 레이(right,idle,idle): 아! 니는 갇혀있느라 잘 모르제?
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(sheep_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			'idle',
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_229', skip = true })

	-- 레이(idle,release 2회): 그 데몬샤이어와 마계를 구해낸 가디언이 바로 야다.
	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.set_anim_async(sheep_girl, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
		scene_util.set_anim(sheep_girl, self, { name = 'idle' })
	end)

	self:custom_normal_speech_action(sheep_girl, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_230', skip = true })

	scene_util.set_anim(sheep_girl, self, { name = 'idle' })

	-- 흑염소(attack,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(goat_girl, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(goat_girl,'01_jump_01')

	-- 흑염소(sleep_deep,nod 끝에 정지): 반갑습니다. 레이의 친우입니다.

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
			self:custom_wait_action(knight, self,

			self:custom_normal_speech_action(sheep_girl, self,
					nil,
					{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
					{ name = 'smile' },
					{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_234', skip = true })

			-- 가디언(right,tired,bomb_idle) 1초
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
			self:custom_wait_action(knight, self,
					{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
					{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
					{ name = 'tired' },
					1)

			-- 레이(tired,cross_arm): 그거는… 다 사연이 있다.
			self:custom_normal_speech_action(sheep_girl, self,
					nil,
					{ name = 'cross_arm' },
					{ name = 'tired' },
					{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_235', skip = true })

		end

	end

	-- 레이(idle,idle): 내는 이제 가족들도 다 끌고온김에 바깥구경이나 할란다.
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(sheep_girl, self,
			nil,
			'idle',
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_236', skip = true })

	-- 레이(idle,bomb_idle): 쪼매 할 일도 있고.
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(sheep_girl, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_epilogue_237', skip = true })

	-- 흑염소(sleep_deep,salute_china): 그럼, 다음에 보도록 하시죠. 가디언 님.

			nil,

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	-- 흑염소(left,idle,idle): 흠… 대충 보기로는 없었던 거 같은데.
	self.controller:sheep_and_goat_setting_clear()
	self.controller:save_custom_state(
			self.controller.interact_event_info_table.sheep_and_goat.interact_event_id)
end

function local_class:start_host_talk(character)
	character_util.add_color(character, character.Name,
			unity_color({ 0.6, 0.6, 0.6, 1 }), 1, 0.3)
end

function local_class:end_host_talk(character)
	character_util.remove_color(character, character.Name, 0.3)
end

function local_class:talk_host_scope(character, action)
	self:start_host_talk(character)

	action()

	self:end_host_talk(character)
end

function local_class:custom_normal_speech_action(character, version_holder, dir_args, anim_args, emotion_args, speech_args)
	self:custom_start_action(character, version_holder, dir_args, anim_args, emotion_args)

	-- 스트링 키로 넣은 경우면 skippable로 간주하고 기본 args 구성
	if type_util.is_string(speech_args) then
		speech_args = {
			key = speech_args,
			skip = true,
		}
	end

	-- 항상 일반 말풍선이 출력되도록 말풍선 타입 비워줌
	speech_args.bubble_type = nil

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(character, speech_args)

	self:custom_end_action(character, version_holder, anim_args, emotion_args)
end

function local_class:custom_wait_action(character, version_holder, dir_args, anim_args, emotion_args, duration)
	self:custom_start_action(character, version_holder, dir_args, anim_args, emotion_args)

	wait_for_sec(duration)

	self:custom_end_action(character, version_holder, anim_args, emotion_args)
end

function local_class:custom_start_action(character, version_holder, dir_args, anim_args, emotion_args)
	if dir_args ~= nil then
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(character, dir_args)
	end

	if anim_args ~= nil then
		scene_util.set_anim(character, version_holder, anim_args)
	end

	if emotion_args ~= nil then
		scene_util.set_emotion(character, version_holder, emotion_args)
	end
end

function local_class:custom_end_action(character, version_holder, anim_args, emotion_args)
	local keep_anim = lua_helper.get_value(anim_args, 'keep', false)
	local upper_anim = lua_helper.get_value(anim_args, 'upper', false)

	local keep_emotion = lua_helper.get_value(emotion_args, 'keep', false)

	if anim_args ~= nil and not keep_anim then
		--커스텀을 쓰는 가장 큰 이유!
		--무기 숨겼을 때, 무기_idle로 돌아가지 않게 하기 위함!
		scene_util.set_anim(character, version_holder, 'idle')
	end

	if emotion_args ~= nil and not keep_emotion then
		character_util.remove_emotion(character)
	end
end

return local_class

local controller_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Base/QuestControllerBase')

---@class LaboseWorldFindInfectedPersonController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldFindInfectedPersonController', controller_base)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	-- 사용할 섹션 스크립트 정보. 주석 해제하고 사용
	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = false,
		NormalSectionCount = 1,
		HasPostSection = false
	}

	-- characters
	self.characters = {
		demon_engineer = function()
			return get_character('demon_engineer')
		end,
		demon_queen = function()
			return get_character('demon_queen')
		end
	}

	self.align_all_npc_info = nil

	-- field objects
	self.field_objects = {
		door = function(number)
			return get_field_object('infected_person_door_' .. number)
		end,
		diary = function()
			return get_field_object('infected_person_diary')
		end,
		paper = function()
			return get_field_object('infected_person_paper')
		end,
		badge = function()
			return get_field_object('infected_person_badge')
		end,
		black_liquid = function()
			return get_field_object('infected_person_black_liquid')
		end
	}

	-- items
	self.items = {
		data = nil,
		add_item = function(this, item_id, pos, scale)
			if this.data == nil then
				this.data = {}
			end

			local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = pos,
				itemid = item_id,
				notforinven = true,
				sprscale = scale,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
			})

			table.insert(this.data, item)
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.data ~= nil then
				for i = 1, #this.data do
					this.data[i]:ConsumeComplete()
					this.data[i] = nil
				end

				this.data = nil
			end
		end
	}

	-- fx
	self.fx = {
		twinkle = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
		end,
		black_liquid = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_black_liquid')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	self.twinkle_fxs = nil
	self.black_liquid_fx = nil

	self.quest_end_state = {
		none = 1,
		quest_clear = 2,
		zone_out = 3
	}

	self.current_quest_end_state = self.quest_end_state.none
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	self.fx:load_all()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.super:dispose()

	self.align_all_npc_info = nil

	self.items:dispose_all()
	self:dispose_fxs()

	if self.black_liquid_fx ~= nil then
		self.black_liquid_fx:Dispose()
		self.black_liquid_fx = nil
	end
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_quest_end_state >= self.quest_end_state.quest_clear and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.field_objects.door(2)) then
		start_coroutine(function()
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(get_character('infected_person_1'),
					'lw_find_infected_person_s1_164', false)
		end)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_quest_end_state >= self.quest_end_state.quest_clear and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.field_objects.door(4)) then
		start_coroutine(function()
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(get_character('infected_person_3'),
					'lw_find_infected_person_s1_165', false)
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_quest_end_state == self.quest_end_state.quest_clear and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'infected_person_zone') then
		self.current_quest_end_state = self.quest_end_state.zone_out
		self:reset_party_member()

		return true
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	self:item_setting()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
end

function local_class:item_setting()
	local diary = self.field_objects.diary()
	local paper = self.field_objects.paper()
	local badge = self.field_objects.badge()
	local black_liquid = self.field_objects.black_liquid()

	self.items:add_item(21147, diary.Position, 1)
	self.items:add_item(21148, paper.Position, 1)
	self.items:add_item(21169, badge.Position + vector(-0.2, 0, -0.1), 0.5)
	self.items:add_item(21169, badge.Position + vector(0.2, 0, 0.1), 0.5)

	self.black_liquid_fx = self.fx.black_liquid():Instantiate(black_liquid.Position)

	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.cs_controller.QuestId)

	if quest_progress == nil or not quest_progress.IsComplete then
		self.twinkle_fxs = {}

		table.insert(self.twinkle_fxs, self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(black_liquid.Position))
		table.insert(self.twinkle_fxs, self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(diary.Position))
		table.insert(self.twinkle_fxs, self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(paper.Position))
		table.insert(self.twinkle_fxs, self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(badge.Position))
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_fxs()
	if self.twinkle_fxs ~= nil then
		for _, fx in pairs(self.twinkle_fxs) do
			if fx ~= nil then
				fx:Dispose()
				fx = nil
			end
		end

		self.twinkle_fxs = nil
	end
end

function local_class:align_all_npcs()
	self.align_all_npc_info = {}
	local align_marker_name = {
		'sub_event_1_align_leader_1',
		'sub_event_1_align_demon_engineer_1',
		'sub_event_1_align_demon_queen_1',
		'sub_event_1_align_s7_police_1',
		'sub_event_1_align_s7_police_2',
		'sub_event_1_align_s7_police_3',
		'sub_event_1_align_s7_police_4',
		'sub_event_1_align_s7_police_5',
		'sub_event_1_align_s7_police_6',
	}

	-- 들어오는 npc 정리
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local npc =  user_party[i]
		local marker = nil
		for j = 1, #align_marker_name do
			if string.find(align_marker_name[j], i == 0 and 'leader' or user_party[i].Name) then
				marker = field_util.get_marker(align_marker_name[j])
				break
			end
		end

		if marker ~= nil then
			local pos = marker.position
			local dir = marker.direction

			table.insert(self.align_all_npc_info, { npc = npc, pos = pos, dir = dir })
		end
	end

	local wp_key = 'align_party'
	for i = 1, #self.align_all_npc_info do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.align_all_npc_info[i].npc, self.align_all_npc_info[i].pos,
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = self.align_all_npc_info[i].dir })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
end

	local wp_key = 'align_party_member'

	for i = 1, #self.align_all_npc_info do
		local npc = self.align_all_npc_info[i].npc

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(npc, self.characters.demon_engineer()) then
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc,
					field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_event_1_align_demon_engineer_2'),

function local_class:reset_party_member()
	if self.align_all_npc_info == nil then
		return
	end

function local_class:quest_accept_talk()

		self:star_piece_fx_dispose()

			else

				scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast2')

				wait_for_sec(0.5)
			end

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		end

		--S : 도… 도우러 와주신 건가요?
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat, 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_4')

		--S(cast) : 아! 벨레누스여, 감사합니다!

				'cast',
				nil,
				'lw_find_infected_person_s1_5')

				{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
				nil,
				'lw_find_infected_person_s1_6')

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
				'right',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
				nil,
				'lw_find_infected_person_s1_10')

		do
			--가디언 선택지

				{ 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_11', 'mercy' },

			})

			if choose_result == 1 then
				--가디언 tired, bomb_idle 1초
				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
				scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'bomb_idle', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01' })
				wait_for_sec(1)

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
				--S(bomb_idle) : 감염자가 있는 건 확실합니다.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,

						'cast',

						'lw_find_infected_person_s1_12')

			nil,
			'lw_find_infected_person_s1_27')

	--S(cast) : 혹시나 더 많은 피해자가 발생하면 안 되니까요….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
			'right',
			'cast',
			nil,
			'lw_find_infected_person_s1_28')

	--비네트(left, tired, bomb_idle) : 도움이 필요한 사람을 무시할 수는 없겠지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			'left',
			'bomb_idle',
			'tired',
			'lw_find_infected_person_s1_29')

	--비네트(left, attack, bow_idle) : 금방 해결하고 와, $name. 기다리고 있을게.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			'left',
			'bow_idle',
			'attack',
			'lw_find_infected_person_s1_30')

	self.controller:align_party_member()

	-- 파티원 모두 npc 처리
	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
		local character = user_party[i]
		character_util.convert_to_npc(character)
	end

	--S attack 1회
	scene_util.set_anim_async(swat, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

	--앞의 도어가 fullopening으로 내려간다.
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(door.Name, false))

	wait_for_sec(3)

	--문이 완전히 내려간 후, S는 위쪽으로 0.5초간 1칸 이동.
	wp_util.move(swat, swat.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			nil, 1, { locked_dir = 'down', last_direction = 'down' })

	--기사 1초간 왼쪽으로 3칸 이동.
	wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0),
			nil, 1)

	--S right, attack 1회
	scene_util.set_direction(swat, 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(swat, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

	--기사 right로.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

	--도어가 다시 닫힌다.
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(door.Name, false))

	--S(left, release 2회) : 자, 이쪽으로 오시면 됩니다.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up', false)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			nil,
			'lw_find_infected_person_s1_31')

	self:swat_move_lever()
end

--- 다시 문에 인터랙트 하면, 이벤트 진행.
function local_class:quest_out_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local swat = self.characters.swat()
	local door = self.field_objects.door(1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.6)

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--정렬 시작과 동시에 S가 왼쪽 그리드 너머에서 속도 6으로 이동해 들어온다.
				local run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true, parent = swat })
				character_util.stop(swat)
				character_util.set_position(swat, door.Position + vector(-13, 0, 1))
				wp_util.move_async(swat, door.Position + vector(-1, 0, 1),
						6, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true, last_direction = 'down' })

				music_player_util.stop_sfx(run_sfx)
			end,
			{
				--가디언 1초간 위치에 정렬.
				party_util.align_party, door.Position, 'left', 1, 'linear'
			}
	)

	--S(down, bomb_idle) : 다시 나가실 건가요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
			'down',
			'bomb_idle',
			'tired',
			'lw_find_infected_person_s1_32')

	do
		--가디언 선택지
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--나가겠다.(빨강)
			{ 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_33', 'brutal' },
			--나가지 않겠다.(초록)
			{ 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_35', 'mercy' }
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			self.current_state = self.states.not_accept
			--가디언 idle, nod 1회
			scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })

			--S(down, idle, idle) : 어쩔 수 없죠… 다시 문을 열어드릴게요.
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat, 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_34')

			--S right, attack 1회
			scene_util.set_direction(swat, 'right', false)
			scene_util.set_anim_async(swat, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

			--문이 열린다.
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(door.Name, false))

			wait_for_sec(3)

			wp_util.move(swat, swat.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5),
					1, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

			--가디언 오른쪽으로 1초간 3칸 이동.
			wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(3.5, 0, 0),
					nil, 1)

			--S right, attack 1회
			scene_util.set_anim_async(swat, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

			--도어가 다시 닫힌다.
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(door.Name, false))
			--이후 파티원들 + 팔로우 모두 복귀하면서 컨트롤 해제.
			self.controller:reset_party_member()
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
		else
			self.current_state = self.states.find_infected

			--S : 아직 도와주시는 거군요! 감사합니다.
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat, 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_36')

			--S(left, release 2회) : 다시 이쪽으로 오시죠!
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
					'left',
					{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
					nil,
					'lw_find_infected_person_s1_37')

			self:swat_move_lever()
		end
	end
end

--- 경찰(남)과 대화
function local_class:infected_person_1_talk()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local infected_person = self.characters.infected_person(1)
	local door = self.field_objects.door(2)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.6)
	party_util.align_party(door.Position + vector(1, 0, 0.5), 'right', 1, 'linear')

	--1번 : 저는… 그냥 지쳐서 몸이 안 좋을 뿐이예요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(infected_person, 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_50')

	--1번 : L-박테리아같은 건…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(infected_person, 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_51')

	--1번 : 상관 없다고요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(infected_person, 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_52')

	while true do
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--이름과 소속을 묻는다.(초록)
			{ 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_53', 'mercy' },
			--수행중이었던 작전에 대해 묻는다.(보라)
			{ 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_63', 'forced' },
			--가족관계에 대해 묻는다.(노랑)
			{ 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_66', 'intellect' },
			--더 물을 것이 없다.(흰색)
			{ 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_69', 'normal' }
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--가디언 선택지1
			--1번(right, tired, idle) : 20번 구역 3소대… 경장 폴…
			scene_util.set_emotion(infected_person, self, 'tired')
			scene_util.set_anim(infected_person, self, 'idle')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(infected_person, 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_54')

			--right, scared, idle, shake 0.3초
			scene_util.shake(infected_person, 0.02, 0.3)
			scene_util.set_emotion(infected_person, self, 'scared')
			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			--1번(right, scared, release 2회) : 아… 아니… 경장 매튜입니다.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
					'right',
					{ name = 'release', count = 2, next_anim = 'idle' },
					{ name = 'scared', keep = true },
					'lw_find_infected_person_s1_55')

			--가디언 선택지2 - 경찰배지 인터랙트 이후에만 등장
			local choose_list = {}

			--이름은 매튜구나.(초록)
			table.insert(choose_list, { 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_62', 'mercy' })

			if self.check_option[1].fo_check then
				--이름도 제대로 모르는 거야?(빨강)
				table.insert(choose_list, { 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_56', 'brutal' })
			end

			local choose_second = choose_util.play_choose_event(choose_list)

			if choose_second == 1 then
				--가디언 smile, nod 2회
				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
				scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, 'nod')

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
			else
				self.check_option[1].reasoning = true
				--가디언 eyelight, dagger_idle 1초
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_03')
				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'eyelight')
				scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'dagger_idle')
				wait_for_sec(1)

				--1번 damaged, cast 1초
				scene_util.set_emotion(infected_person, self, 'damaged')
				scene_util.set_anim(infected_person, self, 'cast')
				wait_for_sec(1)

				--1번 damaged, embarrassed 1초
				scene_util.set_anim(infected_person, self, 'embarrassed')
				wait_for_sec(1)

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
				--1번(right, sleep_deep, nod 1회) : 알겠어요… 저는 매튜가 아니예요.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
						'right',
						{ name = 'nod', count = 1 },
						'sleep_deep',
						'lw_find_infected_person_s1_57')

				--1번(right, tired, release 2회) : 우연히 매튜라는 사람 배지를 주었는데…
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
						'right',
						{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
						'tired',
						'lw_find_infected_person_s1_58')

				--1번(right, tired, bomb_idle) : 그 사람 행세를 하다보니 밥 먹고 사는 걱정은 없어지더라고요.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
						'right',
						'bomb_idle',
						'tired',
						'lw_find_infected_person_s1_59')

				--1번(right, tired, cast2) : 하지만 이건 L-박테리아 감염이랑은 아무런 상관 없잖아요!
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
						'right',
						'cast2',
						'tired',
						'lw_find_infected_person_s1_60')

				--1번(right, tired, cast) : 의심하지 말아주세요…
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
						'right',
						{ name = 'cast', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },
						'tired',
						'lw_find_infected_person_s1_61')
			end
		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			--1번(right, tired, idle) : 저는 최후방의 기지 경비였어요. 항상 맡는 업무죠.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
					'right',
					'idle',
					'tired',
					'lw_find_infected_person_s1_64')

			--1번(right, tired, release 2회) : 아마 여기 있는 사람들 중에 제가 가장 안전한 곳에 있었을 거예요.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
					'right',
					{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
					'tired',
					'lw_find_infected_person_s1_65')
		elseif choose_result == 3 then
			--1번(right, tired, bomb_idle) : 없어요, 날때부터 길거리 하수도에서 전전했으니까.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
					'right',
					'bomb_idle',
					'tired',
					'lw_find_infected_person_s1_67')

			--1번(right, tired, bow_idle) : 놀리려고 물은 거예요?
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
					'right',
					{ name = 'bow_idle', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },
					'tired',
					'lw_find_infected_person_s1_68')
		else
			break
		end

		scene_util.set_emotion(infected_person, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(infected_person, self, 'idle')
	end

	--1번(right, attack, release 2회) : 이런 조사 같은 건 다 필요 없어요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
			'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'attack',
			'lw_find_infected_person_s1_70')

	--1번(attack, bomb_idle) : 누가 감염되었을 지는 뻔하잖아요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
			'right',
			'bomb_idle',
			'attack',
			'lw_find_infected_person_s1_71')

	--1번(attack, bow_idle) : 이 모든 일들의 원흉인 사울 놈이겠죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
			'right',
			'bow_idle',
			'attack',
			'lw_find_infected_person_s1_72')
	--컨트롤 해제.
	scene_util.set_emotion(infected_person, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(infected_person, self, 'idle')
	self.check_option[1].talk_check = true
	self.current_state = self.states.find_infected
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)
end

			{ 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_75', 'mercy' },

					'idle',

			scene_util.set_anim(infected_person, self, 'cast')

			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			--넘어간다.(초록)
			table.insert(choose_list, { 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_84', 'mercy' })

			--가디언 선택지2 - 작전기록 인터랙트 이후에만 등장.
			if self.check_option[2].fo_check then
				--특이사항… 있었을텐데?(빨강)
				table.insert(choose_list, { 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_78', 'brutal' })
			end

			local choose_second = choose_util.play_choose_event(choose_list)

			if choose_second == 2 then
				self.check_option[2].reasoning = true
				--가디언 eyelight, dagger_idle 1초
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_03')
				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'eyelight')
				scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'dagger_idle')
				wait_for_sec(1)

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
				--2번(right, tired, idle, shake 0.3초) : …저 때문에 부대원들이 모두 저 괴물들에게 당했어요.
				scene_util.shake(infected_person, 0.02, 0.3)
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
						'right',
						'idle',
						'tired',
						'lw_find_infected_person_s1_79')

				--2번(right, tired, cast) : 제가… 최전방에 남고 싶다고 고집을 부리는 바람에…
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
						'right',
						'cast',
						'tired',
						'lw_find_infected_person_s1_80')

				--2번(right, tired, idle) : 그깟 공훈이 뭐라고…
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
						'right',
						'idle',
						'tired',
						'lw_find_infected_person_s1_81')

				--2번(right, tired, release 2회) : 동료들이 모두 눈 앞에서 터져나갔어요…!
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
						'right',
						{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
						'tired',
						'lw_find_infected_person_s1_82')

				--2번(right, sleep_deep, nod 고개 숙인 채 유지) : 아직도 그 피가 제 얼굴에 묻어있는 것 같아요.
				wait_all_lua(
						function()
							character_util.remove_emotion(infected_person)
							scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(infected_person, 'nod')
							wait_for_sec(0.3)
							infected_person.SpineController.TimeScale = 0
						end,
						function()
							scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
									'right',
									nil,
									'sleep_deep',
									'lw_find_infected_person_s1_83')
						end
				)

				infected_person.SpineController.TimeScale = 1
			end
		elseif choose_result == 3 then
			--2번(right, idle, idle) : 아버지와 여동생이 있습니다.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
					'right',
					'idle',
					'idle',
					'lw_find_infected_person_s1_86')

			--2번(right, tired, bomb_idle) : 이 질문이 감염자 색출이랑 관련이 있는 건가요?
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
					'right',
					'bomb_idle',
					'tired',
					'lw_find_infected_person_s1_87')
		else
			break
		end

		scene_util.set_emotion(infected_person, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(infected_person, self, 'bow_idle')
	end

	--2번(right, sleep_deep, cast) : …감염자라고 꼭 죽어야 되는 건 아니라고 생각합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
			'right',
			{ name = 'cast', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },
			'sleep_deep',
			'lw_find_infected_person_s1_89')

	--2번(right, tired, idle) : 물론… 이성적으로는 그래야할 지도 모른다고 생각하지만…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person, self,
			'right',
			'idle',
			'tired',
			'lw_find_infected_person_s1_90')

	--컨트롤 해제
	scene_util.set_emotion(infected_person, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(infected_person, self, 'bow_idle')
	self.check_option[2].talk_check = true
	self.current_state = self.states.find_infected
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)

function local_class:select_infected_person()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local swat = self.characters.swat()
	local infected_person_1 = self.characters.infected_person(1)

	--1초간 S의 오른쪽 1칸 떨어진 위치로 정렬.
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.6)
	party_util.align_party(swat, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	self.current_state = self.states.find_infected

	--방에 들어와서 아무와도 인터랙트하지 않은 경우
	if not self.check_option[1].talk_check and
			not self.check_option[2].talk_check and
			not self.check_option[3].talk_check then
		--S : 아직 아무런 조사도 하지 않으셨군요.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat, 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_104')

		--S : 우선 저기 있는 부상자들과 대화를 나눠보시죠.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat, 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_105')

		--컨트롤 해제.
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)
		return
	end

	--S : 누가 감염자인지 알아내셨나요?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat, 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_106')

	local choose_list = {}

	--가디언 선택지2 - 작전기록 인터랙트 이후에만 등장.
	if not self.check_option[1].reasoning then
		--매튜(노랑) - 추리 성공 이전에만 등장.
		table.insert(choose_list, { 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_107', 'intellect' })
	else
		--폴.(노랑)
		table.insert(choose_list, { 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_113', 'intellect' })
	end

	--사라.(초록)
	table.insert(choose_list, { 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_124', 'mercy' })

	--사울 병사.(보라)
	table.insert(choose_list, { 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_126', 'forced' })

	--감염자는 없다.(노랑)
	table.insert(choose_list, { 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_127', 'intellect' })

	--모두 감염되었다.(빨강)
	table.insert(choose_list, { 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_131', 'brutal' })

	--조금 더 고민이 필요하다.(흰색)
	table.insert(choose_list, { 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_136', 'normal' })

	:: continue ::

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(choose_list)

	if choose_result == 1 and not self.check_option[1].reasoning then
		--S(question 1회) : 매튜요…?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
				'right',
				{ name = 'question', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },
				nil,
				'lw_find_infected_person_s1_108')

		--S(cast) : 이런 말씀 드리기는 죄송한데…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
				'right',
				'cast',
				nil,
				'lw_find_infected_person_s1_109')

		--S(bomb_idle) : 매튜는 한번도 최전방에 나선 적이 없어요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
				'right',
				'bomb_idle',
				nil,
				'lw_find_infected_person_s1_110')

		--S(releease 2회) : 지금도 혹시나 하는 마음에 가둬두기는 했지만 꾀병이 분명해요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
				'right',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
				nil,
				'lw_find_infected_person_s1_111')

		--S(bow_idle) : 조금 더 조사해보시는 건 어떠실까요?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
				'right',
				'bow_idle',
				nil,
				'lw_find_infected_person_s1_112')
		--컨트롤 해제.
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)
		return
	end

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--S(right, tired, question 1회) : 폴…? 그게 누구…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
				'right',
				{ name = 'question', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },
				nil,
				'lw_find_infected_person_s1_114')

		--카메라 포커스 0.5초간 1번에게로 이동.
		camera_util.move_to_target_async(infected_person_1, 0.5)

		--1번(right, tired, idle) : 나야…
		scene_util.set_direction(swat, 'left')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person_1, self,
				'right',
				'idle',
				'tired',
				'lw_find_infected_person_s1_115')

		--1번(right, damaged, release 2회) : 물론 제가 그 동안 먹고 살려고 사칭을 하기는 했어요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person_1, self,
				'right',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
				'damaged',
				'lw_find_infected_person_s1_116')


		--1번(right, tired, cast) : 그치만 저는 작전 때도 숨기만 하고 앞으로 나선 적은 없었다고요!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person_1, self,
				'right',
				'cast',
				'tired',
				'lw_find_infected_person_s1_117')

		--카메라 포커스 기사에게로 0.5초간 이동.
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

		--S : 그동안 거짓말을 줄곧…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
				'right',
				'idle',
				nil,
				'lw_find_infected_person_s1_118')

		if not self:swat_select() then
			return
		end
	end

	if choose_result == 2 or choose_result == 3 then
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(swat, nil, 'silence')

		if not self:swat_select() then
			return
		end
	end

	if choose_result == 4 then
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(swat, nil, 'silence')

		--S : 하지만 명백한 증거가 있었습니다.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat, 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_128')

		if not self:swat_select() then
			return
		end

		--S : 저도 더 이상 동료들을 의심하고 싶진 않습니다.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat, 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_130')
	end

	if choose_result == 5 then
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(swat, nil, 'silence')

		--S(right, bomb_idle) : 죄송하지만 지금은 그런 장난하실 때가 아닙니다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
				'right',
				'bomb_idle',
				nil,
				'lw_find_infected_person_s1_132')

		local choose_second = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--감염자는 정화한다!(빨강)
			{ 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_133', 'brutal' },
			--농담이었다.(흰색)
			{ 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_135', 'normal' }
		})

		if choose_second == 1 then
			--가디언 mad, jingak 2회
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'mad')
			scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'jingak', count = 2, sfx_name = '01_jingak_01' })

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
			--S : 다… 다 죽이려드는 겁니까!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat, 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_134')
		else
			goto continue
		end
	end

	if choose_result == 6 then
		--S : 조금 더 조사해보시고 얘기해주세요.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat, 'lw_find_infected_person_s1_123')

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)
		return
	end

	--region 엔딩 라인
	self.current_state = self.states.quest_end

	self.field_objects.door(1).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.field_objects.door(2).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.field_objects.door(3).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.field_objects.door(4).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.field_objects.diary().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.field_objects.paper().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.field_objects.badge().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.field_objects.black_liquid().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	if choose_result == 1 then
		self:police_male_ending()
	end

	if choose_result == 2 then
		self:police_female_ending()
	end

	if choose_result == 3 then
		self:saul_soldier_ending()
	end

	if choose_result == 4 then
		self:not_find_infected_person_ending()
	end

	if choose_result == 5 then
		self:all_dead_ending()
	end

	--endregion
end

function local_class:swat_select()

	--S(right, bomb_idle) : …정말 확실하신건가요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
			'right',

	local infected_person_1 = self.characters.infected_person(1)
	local infected_person_2 = self.characters.infected_person(2)
	local infected_person_3 = self.characters.infected_person(3)

	--S left, attack 1회.
	self:show_lever_anim()

	--레버 작동되며 문이 모두 열린다.
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('infected_person_door_2', false))
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('infected_person_door_3', false))
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('infected_person_door_4', false))
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('infected_person_door_5', false))
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('infected_person_door_6', false))
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(infected_person_1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(infected_person_2)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(infected_person_3)
	local wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(infected_person_1,
			infected_person_1.Position + vector(6, 0, -2), true)
	wp_util.move(infected_person_1, wp, 4)
	wp_util.move(infected_person_2, infected_person_2.Position + vector(4, 0, 0), 4)
	wp_util.move(infected_person_3, infected_person_3.Position + vector(6, 0, 0), 4)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--S(right, nod 1회 0.5배속) : 모두… 의심해서 미안했어…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
			'right',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 1, scale = 0.5 },
			'idle',
			'lw_find_infected_person_s1_161')

	--S(right, tired, bomb_idle) : 이제… 다들 어떻게 할 거지…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
			'right',
			'bomb_idle',
			'tired',
			'lw_find_infected_person_s1_143')

	self:saul_soldier_move()
	self:police_male_move()

	--2번(down, tired, cast) : 나도… 더 이상 싸우고 싶지 않아.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(infected_person_2, self,
			'down',
			'cast',
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			'lw_find_infected_person_s1_145')

	self:swat_move()
	self:police_female_move()

	--카메라 포커스는 1초간 기사에게로 이동.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	--아래 문 다시 닫힌다.
	self:door_close_quest_end()
end

--- 전투 엔딩
function local_class:all_dead_ending()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local swat = self.characters.swat()
	local infected_person_1 = self.characters.infected_person(1)
	local infected_person_2 = self.characters.infected_person(2)
	local infected_person_3 = self.characters.infected_person(3)

	self:show_lever_anim()

	--레버 작동되며 문이 모두 열린다.
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('infected_person_door_2', false))
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('infected_person_door_3', false))
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('infected_person_door_4', false))
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--S(right, cast2, jump 1회) : 이래도 저래도 죽을 거면!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
			'right',
			'cast2',
			nil,
			'lw_find_infected_person_s1_162')

	--S(right, dagger_idle) : 다같이 살고 다같이 죽는다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
			'right',
			'dagger_idle',
			nil,
			'lw_find_infected_person_s1_163')

	local battle_group = {
		infected_person_1,
		infected_person_2,
		infected_person_3,
		swat
	}

	local battle_zone_name = 'infected_person_battle_zone'

	for i = 1, #battle_group do
		character_util.convert_to_monster(battle_group[i], 'infected_battle', battle_zone_name)
		character_util.set_death_type(battle_group[i], 'prostrate')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(battle_group[i])
		character_util.set_death_type(battle_group[i], 'prostrate')
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(battle_group[i], leader, 'battle')
	end

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('infected_person_battle_gate_1', false))
end

--- 전투 엔딩 전투 클리어 후
function local_class:battle_end_event()
	local swat = self.characters.swat()
	local infected_person_1 = self.characters.infected_person(1)
	local infected_person_2 = self.characters.infected_person(2)
	local infected_person_3 = self.characters.infected_person(3)

	swat.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	infected_person_1.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	infected_person_2.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	infected_person_3.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.add_color(swat, swat.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.7, 1)
	character_util.add_color(infected_person_1, infected_person_1.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.7, 1)
	character_util.add_color(infected_person_2, infected_person_2.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 1)
	character_util.add_color(infected_person_3, infected_person_3.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.7, 1)

	--전투 끝나면 S 쓰러진 곳에서 스타피스가 떨어진다.
	--스타피스는 방 한가운데로 떨어지도록 처리.
	local star_piece = get_field_object('infected_person_star_piece')

	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, swat.Position)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--시체들은 모두 prostrate, 검게 틴트된 상태, 충돌 처리 없도록.
	--다만 사라의 시체는 쓰러지고 나면 fx_lilithtower_virus_death_explosion 와 함께 사라진다.
	character_util.spine_scale(infected_person_2, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--2번 경찰 fx_lilithtower_virus_death_explosion와 함께 폭발한다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fly_explosion_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
	self.fx.virus_death_explosion():Instantiate(infected_person_2.Position)
	character_util.set_position(infected_person_2, vector(999, 0, 999))

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('infected_person_door_1', false))
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('infected_person_battle_gate_1', false))

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	self.controller:dispose_fxs()
	self.controller.current_quest_end_state = self.controller.quest_end_state.quest_clear
	self.controller:complete_hidden_quest_default()
end

return local_class

	local interact_wall_pos = self.get_interact_pos(1)

	interact_wall.Position = interact_wall_pos
	interact_wall.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	quest_icon_util.set_substage_icon(interact_wall)
end

function local_class:open_stage_scene()
	local fireballs = {
		self.get_fireball(1).FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable(),
		self.get_fireball(2).FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable(),
		self.get_fireball(3).FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable(),
		self.get_fireball(4).FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable()
	}

	local changed_fireball = {}

	for idx = 1, #fireballs do
		if fireballs[idx].is_activate then
			local target = fireballs[idx]
			table.insert(changed_fireball, target)

			target:turn_off()
		end
	end

	--서브스테이지 오픈 연출.
	--안드로이드 연구소에 대한 정보를 얻었다.

	})
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	wait_for_sec(1)

	quest_icon_util.remove(self.get_interact_wall(1))

	for idx = 1, #changed_fireball do
		local target = changed_fireball[idx]

		target:turn_on()
	end

	self.controller:activate_quest()
end
--endregion custom

return local_class

	self.cw_card_key_quest_id = 372

	--region Etc

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		first = 2,
		second = 3,
		done = 99,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	self:pre_setting()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_state = self.states.first
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.first and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_interact_door(1)) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.first_door_open_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.second and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_interact_door(2)) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.second_door_open_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return true
end
--endregion event

--region custom
function local_class:pre_setting()
	local interact_wall_1 = self.get_interact_door(1)
	local interact_wall_2 = self.get_interact_door(2)

	interact_wall_1.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	interact_wall_2.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

function local_class:door_open(number)
	local door = self.get_interact_door(number)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')
	animator_util.play_async(door, 'open')

	door.ActiveState = active_state('visible')
	door.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
end

function local_class:interact_door_open(number)
	if number == 1 then
		self:door_open(number)

		self.current_state = self.states.second
	elseif number == 2 then
		self:door_open(number)

		self.current_state = self.states.done
	end

end

function local_class:first_door_open_scene()
	--빨간색 표시한 도어 오브젝트에 인터랙트 시
	if not user_progress:ClearedQuest(self.cw_card_key_quest_id) then
		--퀘스트 미클리어
		--나레이션 박스
		--카드키가 필요해보인다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lw_sub_heavenhold_test_room_s1_38' })

		return
	end

	--퀘스트 클리어
	--나레이션 박스
	--로레인이 건네준 카드키를 사용할 수 있을 것 같다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lw_sub_heavenhold_test_room_s1_39' })

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--예 (normal)
		{ 'lw_sub_heavenhold_test_room_s1_40', 'normal' },
		--아니오 (normal)
		{ 'lw_sub_heavenhold_test_room_s1_41', 'normal' }
	})

	if choose_result == 2 then
		--아니오 (normal)
		--아니오 선택시 컨트롤 복귀
		return
	end
	--예 선택시
	--도어 open 애니메이션 재생 후 도어가 있던 자리에 exit 가 생긴다.
	--해당 exit 를 통해 내부 방으로 진입할 수 있다.
	self:interact_door_open(1)
end

function local_class:second_door_open_scene()
	--에필로그 이벤트 감상 전 인터랙트 시 나레이션 박스
	if not self:check_second_card_key() then
		--챕터 18 종료 후 얻을 수 있는 에필로그 카드 키를 가지고 있지 않을 때

		--로레인이 건네준 카드키를 사용할 수 있을 것 같다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lw_sub_heavenhold_test_room_s1_42' })

		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--예 (normal)
			{ 'lw_sub_heavenhold_test_room_s1_43', 'normal' },
			--아니오 (normal)
			{ 'lw_sub_heavenhold_test_room_s1_44', 'normal' }
		})

		if choose_result == 2 then
			--아니오 (normal)
			--아니오 선택시 컨트롤 복귀
			return
		end

		--예 (normal)
		--나레이션 박스
		--카드키가 하나 더 필요한 것 같다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lw_sub_heavenhold_test_room_s1_45' })

		return
	end
	--에필로그 이벤트 감상 후 인터랙트 시 나레이션 박스
	--로레인이 건네준 두 개의 카드키 모두 사용할 수 있을 것 같다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'lw_sub_heavenhold_test_room_s1_46' })

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--예 (normal)
		{ 'lw_sub_heavenhold_test_room_s1_47', 'normal' },
		--아니오 (normal)
		{ 'lw_sub_heavenhold_test_room_s1_48', 'normal' }
	})

	if choose_result == 2 then
		--아니오 (normal)
		--아니오 선택시 컨트롤 복귀
		return
	end

	--예 (normal)
	--도어 open 애니메이션 재생 유저는 문을 넘어 갈 수 있음
	self:interact_door_open(2)

	--퀘스트 클리어
	self.controller:complete_hidden_quest_default()
end

function local_class:check_second_card_key()
	--lw_epilogue
	local epilogue_quest_id = 405
	local epilogue_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(epilogue_quest_id)

	--퀘스트 받지 않았다면 false값 리턴.
	if epilogue_quest == nil then
		return false
	end

	--에필로그의 대화 이벤트
	local epilogue_custom_state_key = 'epilogue_interact_npc'
	--로레인 대화 이벤트 (두 번째 카드키 넘겨받는 이벤트)
	local epilogue_maiden_event_id = 13
	--로레인 대화 이벤트 - 비트 연산 비교를 위해 변환
	local epilogue_maiden_event_bit_id = 1 << epilogue_maiden_event_id

	--에필로그의 대화 이벤트 커스텀 스테이트.
	local epilogue_custom_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(epilogue_quest, epilogue_custom_state_key)
	epilogue_custom_state = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(
			epilogue_custom_state ~= -1,
			epilogue_custom_state,
			0)

	--로레인 대화 이벤트 (두 번째 카드키 넘겨 받는 이벤트) 를 받는지 넘겨 줌
	return (epilogue_custom_state & epilogue_maiden_event_bit_id) == epilogue_maiden_event_bit_id
end
--endregion custom

return local_class

	end

	self.creature_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_creature_22', parent = creature, loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })

	creature.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true

	character_util.set_direction(creature, 'left')

	creature.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(
		creature, self.creature_detect_key, 3.5, 120)

	start_coroutine(self.labose_creature_big_routine, self)
end

-- 라보스 괴물 루틴
function local_class:labose_creature_big_routine()
	local creature = self.get_labose_creature_big()
	local wp = {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('labose_creature_big_wp_1'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('labose_creature_big_wp_2'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('labose_creature_big_wp_3'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('labose_creature_big_wp_4'),
	}

	local speed = 3.5
	local duration = {
		vector_util.magnitude(wp[1] - wp[4]) / speed,
		vector_util.magnitude(wp[2] - wp[1]) / speed,
		vector_util.magnitude(wp[3] - wp[2]) / speed,
		vector_util.magnitude(wp[4] - wp[3]) / speed,
	}

	local cur_idx = 1
	local start_pos = creature.Position
	local cur_duration = vector_util.magnitude(wp[1] - creature.Position) / speed
	local progress = 0
	local time_passed = 0

	character_util.set_direction(creature, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(creature, { name = 'walk' })
	while not self.stage_ended and not self.is_detected_by_creature do
		progress = time_passed / cur_duration

		if progress < 1 then
			creature.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, wp[cur_idx], progress)
		else
			creature.Position = wp[cur_idx]
			start_pos = wp[cur_idx]

			local next_idx = cur_idx < #wp and cur_idx + 1 or 1
			cur_duration = duration[next_idx]
			local dir = vector_util.to_direction(wp[next_idx] - wp[cur_idx])
			creature.Direction = dir

			time_passed = 0
			cur_idx = next_idx
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_detected_by_creature then
		if self.has_buff then
			stage:SetGameOver(CS.Oak.UIGameOver.UIGameOverButtonType.LobbyWithWaypoint, false, false)
		end

		if self.creature_sfx ~= nil then
			self.creature_sfx:FadeOut()
			self.creature_sfx = nil
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_21')
		character_util.remove_anim(creature)
		character_util.convert_to_monster(creature, self.battle_zone_name)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		command_util.publish_monster_notice(creature, get_party_leader(), 'battle')
		self:close_battlegate()
	end
end

-- 배틀게이트 닫기
function local_class:close_battlegate()
	local count = 7
	for i = 1, count do
		local key = 'labose_creature_battlegate_' .. i
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(key, true))
	end

	end
end

function local_class:clear_robot_battle_1()
	local lilith = self.get_lilith()
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local knight_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('robot_battle_clear_pos')
	local lilith_pos = knight_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 0)
	local amplification_machine = self.get_amplification_machine(1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('labose_creature_battlegate_1_1', true))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('labose_creature_battlegate_1_2', true))

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.util:change_knight_weapon_to_bow()
	scene_util.show_weapon(knight)

	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(lilith, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion(lilith, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'bow_idle')
	character_util.set_position(knight, knight_pos)
	character_util.set_position(lilith, lilith_pos)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if self.cur_machine_2_state ~= self.machine_event_states.clear then
		-- $name! 어서 저 장치를 부숴버려!!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lilith, self, nil, 'release', nil, 'lw_labose_creature_big_12')
	else
		-- 지금이야, $name!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lilith, self, nil, 'release', nil, 'lw_labose_creature_big_12_1')
	end
	character_util.set_direction(lilith, 'up')
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.7)
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'up')
	local knight_center = knight.Position + knight.SpineController.SpineTotalOffset
	local target_pos = amplification_machine.Position
	local bow_dir = (target_pos - knight.Bounds.center).normalized
	local bow_pos = knight_center + bow_dir

	knight.SpineController.AimPoint = CS.Oak.IKSupportUtil.GetAimPointInSpineSpace(bow_pos, knight_center)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bow_shot_02')
	character_util.set_anim(knight, {
		name = 'bow_attack_ready_start',
		loop = false,
		next_anim = 'bow_attack_ready_loop'
	})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.2)
	local rad = math.atan(amplification_machine.Position.x - knight.Position.x,
		amplification_machine.Position.z - knight.Position.z)
	local deg = math.deg(rad)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bow_shot_04')
	self.fx:knight_projectile_fire():Instantiate(knight.Position + vector(0.2, 0, 0.3))
	character_util.set_anim(knight, { name = 'bow_attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'bow_idle' })
	knight.SpineController.AimPoint = nil

	local arrow = self.fx:knight_projectile():Instantiate(knight.Position + vector(0.2, 0, 0.3))
	local trail = self.fx:knight_projectile_trail():Instantiate(knight.Position + vector(0.2, 0, 0.3))
	arrow.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, deg, 0)
	trail.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -deg)
	trail.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0, 0)

	local duration = 0.2
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = arrow.transform.position
	local end_pos = amplification_machine.Position
	local progress = 0
	while progress < 1 do
		progress = time_passed / duration

		local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		trail.transform.position = pos
		arrow.transform.position = pos

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	arrow:Dispose()
	arrow = nil

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_03')
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 1)
	self.fx:smoke():Instantiate(amplification_machine.Position)
	amplification_machine.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	character_util.remove_emotion(lilith)
	if self.cur_machine_2_state ~= self.machine_event_states.clear then
		-- 잘했어, $name.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lilith, self, 'left', { name = 'nod', count = 2, sfx_name = false }, nil, 'lw_labose_creature_big_18')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(lilith, self, 'question')
		scene_util.set_emotion(lilith, self, 'tired')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 아까 우릴 공격했던 그 로봇들은 대체 뭐였을까…?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lilith, self, nil, nil, nil, 'lw_labose_creature_big_12_2')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_02')
		-- 꽤 익숙한 외형의 로봇이었는데… 어쩌면…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lilith, self, nil, nil, nil, 'lw_labose_creature_big_12_3')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		character_util.remove_anim(lilith)
		-- …안타깝지만, 지금은 길게 생각할 여유가 없네.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lilith, self, nil, nil, nil, 'lw_labose_creature_big_12_4')

		character_util.remove_emotion(lilith)
		-- 놈을 감싸고 있던 보호막은 두개 였었지…?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lilith, self, nil, nil, nil, 'lw_labose_creature_big_13')
		-- 어쩌면 장치가 하나 더 있을 수 도 있겠어.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lilith, self, nil, nil, nil, 'lw_labose_creature_big_14')

		self:remove_immune_physic_effect()
	else
		-- 이제 그 괴물놈한테 돌아가보자.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lilith, self, 'left', nil, 'attack', 'lw_labose_creature_big_15')
		character_util.remove_emotion(lilith)

		self:remove_creature_buff()
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	self.cur_machine_1_state = self.machine_event_states.clear
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.amplification_machine_1_clear_key, 1)
end

-- 라보스 괴물 버프 세팅
function local_class:set_creature_buff()
	local creature = self.get_labose_creature_big()

	self.controller.has_buff = true

	buff_manager:AddBuff(creature, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, creature,
		self.buff_melee_immune, self.buff_level, false, false)
	buff_manager:AddBuff(creature, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, creature,
		self.buff_projectile_immune, self.buff_level, false, false)
	buff_manager:AddBuff(creature, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, creature,
		self.buff_attack_scale, 100, false, false)
end

function local_class:set_immune_physic_effect()
	local creature = self.get_labose_creature_big()
	local offset = vector(0, 0.9, 0)
	self.immune_physic_effect = self.fx:immune_physic():Instantiate(creature.Position + offset)
	self.immune_physic_effect.transform.localScale = vector(0.8, 0.8, 0.8)
	self.immune_physic_effect_parent = self.immune_physic_effect.transform.parent

local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldLoraineCloneSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = LaboseWorldLoraineClone @
		Comment = 로레인 클론 구출 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type LaboseWorldLoraineCloneController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	self.get_lilith = function()
		return get_character('demon_queen')
	end

	self.get_creature = function(idx)
		return get_character('loraine_clone_creature_' .. idx)
	end

	self.get_clone = function(idx)
		return get_character('loraine_clone_npc_' .. idx)
	end

	self.fx = {
		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	self.sp_manager = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/LaboseWorld/Common/LaboseWorldScreenplayManager')

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		entered_move_zone = 2,
		entered_appear_zone = 3,
		entered_help_zone = 4,
		entered_battle_zone = 5,
		cleared_battle = 6,
	}
	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.battle_zone_name = 'loraine_clone_battle'

	self.star_piece_name = 'loraine_clone_star_piece'

	self.util = nil
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:load_all()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	self.util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/LaboseWorld/Common/Util')
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil

	self.sp_manager = nil
	self.util = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'loraine_clone_event_1') and
		self.current_state == self.states.none then
		self.current_state = self.states.entered_move_zone
		start_coroutine(self.loraine_clone_move, self)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'loraine_clone_event_2') and
		self.current_state == self.states.entered_move_zone then
		self.current_state = self.states.entered_appear_zone
		self.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.loraine_clone_appear_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'loraine_clone_event_3') and
		self.current_state == self.states.entered_appear_zone then
		self.current_state = self.states.entered_help_zone
		self.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.loraine_clone_help_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.battle_zone_name) and
		self.current_state == self.states.entered_help_zone then
		self.current_state = self.states.entered_battle_zone
		self.sp_manager:start_coroutine_delayed(self.start_battle, self)
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_zone_name and
		self.current_state == self.states.entered_battle_zone then
		self.current_state = self.states.cleared_battle
		self.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.cleared_loraine_clone_battle_scene, self)
	end
end

	scene_util.set_anim_async(clone_1, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
	scene_util.set_anim_async(clone_2, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })

	wp_util.move(clone_1, clone_1.Position + vector(-12, 0, 0), 4, nil, {
		callback = function(waypoint_index)
			if waypoint_index == 0 then
				character_util.set_active_state(clone_1, 'disabled')
			end
		end
	})

	wp_util.move(clone_2, clone_2.Position + vector(-12, 0, 0), 4, nil, {
		callback = function(waypoint_index)
			if waypoint_index == 0 then
				character_util.set_active_state(clone_2, 'disabled')
			end
		end

	wait_for_sec(2.5)
