		--기사 피격시 fx_hit 지속 출력되며 기사 shake 0.03세기로 지속 출력
		--기사 (up, push) 모션 출력
		scene_util.shake(knight, 0.03, 9999)
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'up', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'push')

		wait_for_sec(sword_attack_duration * 0.6)

		start_coroutine(function()
			while true do
				wait_for_sec(sword_attack_duration * 0.4)

				if not is_attack then
					break
				end

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
				self.fx.hit():Instantiate(knight.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0.25))

				wait_for_sec(sword_attack_duration * 0.57)
			end
		end)

		pre_wait_attack_duration = 0

		--가 NPC (down, mad, sword_attack 지속 출력)[shout]: 미확인 생물체를 배제합니다!
		--동시에 화면 shake 0.1세기로 0.3초간 출력
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
		scene_util.set_anim(android, self, 'sword_attack')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
		scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(android, self,
				nil,
				{ name = 'mad', keep = true },
				nil,
				{ key = 'lw_main_s12_16_1', skip = true })

		--가 NPC(down, mad, sword_attack 지속 출력)[shout]: 배제! 배제! 배제! 배제! 배제!!!
		--동시에 화면 shake 0.1세기로 0.3초간 출력
		camera_util.cancel_shake()
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
		scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(android, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'lw_main_s12_16_2', skip = true })

		--가 NPC 대화가 끝나면 sowrd_attack 2회 후 가 NPC(down, mad, sowrd_attack)의 정지 상태에서  QTE 추가 진행
		scene_util.set_anim_async(android, self, { name = 'sword_attack', count = 2 })

		is_attack = false

		scene_util.set_anim(android, self, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false })

		wait_for_sec(sword_attack_duration * 0.2)

		android.SpineController.TimeScale = 0

		--QTE (→)
		--제한 시간 1초

		local is_qte_result = qte_play_util.swipe('right', { duration = 1 })

		if is_qte_result then
			--성공 연출
			--0.3초 뒤 가 NPC(down, mad, sword_attack)으로 때리는 모션 진행되며 공격 후 아래와 같이 유지 (0.3초)
			start_coroutine(function()
				wait_for_sec(0.3)

]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)

	end

	self.get_fireball_room_event_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('s13_fireball_room_event_pos')
	end

	self.get_core_room_event_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('s13_core_room_event_pos')
	end

	self.get_center_warp_room_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('center_warp_room_pos')
	end

	self.mini_game_loaded = false
	self.mini_game_name = 'PacMan'
	self.mini_game = nil

	self.quest_marker_name = 's13_main_quest_marker'

	self.fx = {
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,

			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_teleportsphere_red')
		end,
		dead = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end,

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:load_all()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')

	local target_pos = self.get_core_room_event_pos()
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.quest_marker_name, self.cs_controller.QuestId, true, target_pos)
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(function()
		self.dynamic_npcs = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async({
			demon_engineer = 'lw_demon_engineer',
			researcher = 'lw_cw_male_researcher_1'
		})

		self.is_loaded_dynamic_npc = true
	end)

	animator_util.play(self.get_heavenhold_core(), 'off')
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_demon_engineer(), self.controller)

	if self.mini_game then
		mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
		self.mini_game = nil
	end

	if self.dynamic_npcs then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.dynamic_npcs)
		self.dynamic_npcs = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.fail_activity and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_demon_engineer()) then

		self.current_state = self.states.restart_activity

		start_coroutine(self.restart_activity, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's13_entrance_fireball_zone') then

		self.current_state = self.states.entrance_fireball_room

		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_fireball_room, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.entrance_fireball_room and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's13_entrance_core_room_zone') then

		self.current_state = self.states.entrance_core_room

		start_coroutine(self.enter_core_room, self)
		return true
	end
end

--- InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.success_activity and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_warp()) then

		self.current_state = self.states.interacting_warp

		start_coroutine(self.interact_warp, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- MiniGameEndEvent
function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name ~= self.mini_game_name then
		return false
	end

	if e.Success then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.success_activity, self)
		return true
	else
		start_coroutine(self.fail_activity, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 미니게임 실행
function local_class:start_mini_game_routine()
	self.mini_game = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.mini_game_name)

	if not self.mini_game_loaded then
		mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, 'pack_man_main', function()
			self.mini_game_loaded = true
		end)
	end

	while not self.mini_game_loaded do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
end

--- 중앙 워프 인터렉트
function local_class:interact_warp()
	sp_util.enter_scene()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local demon_engineer = user_party[1]

	local center_warp_room_pos = self.get_center_warp_room_pos()

	local warp_y_offset = 0.3

	-- 기사, 비네트 아래와 같은 동선으로 이동
	-- 기사, 비네트(right, idle, jump)
	-- Y 축 최대 0.4까지 상승하며 포물선으로 이동
	-- 4의 속도
	do
		local move_duration = 0.5
		local move_key = 'warp_move'

		-- 카메라는 워프 중앙 포커스
		camera_util.move(center_warp_room_pos, move_duration)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.jump(leader, 0.4, move_duration)
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'idle')

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, center_warp_room_pos + vector(0.5, warp_y_offset, 0),
				nil, move_duration, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		character_util.jump(demon_engineer, 0.4, move_duration)
		scene_util.set_anim(demon_engineer, self, 'idle')

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(demon_engineer, center_warp_room_pos + vector(-0.5, warp_y_offset, 0),
				nil, move_duration, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
	end

	if self.re_interact then
		-- 비네트(right, idle, idle): 조종실로 갈 준비 됐어?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self, 'right',
				nil, nil, 'lw_main_s13_35')
	else
		-- 이동 완료 후 비네트(right, idle, demon_engineer/attack_support) 출력 후 정지
		scene_util.set_anim(demon_engineer, self, { name = 'demon_engineer/attack_support', loop = false })
		wait_for_sec(1.6)

		-- 비네트(right, idle, demon_engineer/attack_support 정지된 상태): : 좋아, 워프 신호는 정상이야. 준비 됐어?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glitch_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self, 'right',
				nil, nil, 'lw_main_s13_31')
	end

	-- 기사 선택지
	local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 잠시… 아직 할 일이 남았어. (brutal)
		{ 'lw_main_s13_32', 'brutal' },
		-- 이제 공주 님을 구하러 가보자고! (mercy)
		{ 'lw_main_s13_33', 'mercy' }
	})

	character_util.remove_anim(demon_engineer)

	if player_choice == 1 then
		-- 기사(left, tired, release 3회)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 3 })

		-- 비네트(right, idle, idle): 알겠어. 대신 시간이 많이 없다는 것만 알아둬.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self, 'right',
				nil, nil, 'lw_main_s13_34')

		do
			local move_duration = 0.5
			local move_key = 'exit_move'

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
			character_util.jump(leader, 0.4, move_duration)
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'idle')

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, vector_util.get_x0z(leader.Position) + vector(0, 0, -1.5),
					nil, move_duration, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

			character_util.jump(demon_engineer, 0.4, move_duration)
			scene_util.set_anim(demon_engineer, self, 'idle')

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(demon_engineer, vector_util.get_x0z(demon_engineer.Position) + vector(0, 0, -1.5),

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupWaveClearEvent), 'on_battle_group_wave_clear_event')

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupWaveClearEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	if self.fx_nanomachine_mode then
		self.fx_nanomachine_mode:Dispose()
		self.fx_nanomachine_mode = nil
	end

	if self.fx_nanomachine_mind_uploading then
		self.fx_nanomachine_mind_uploading:Dispose()
		self.fx_nanomachine_mind_uploading = nil
	end

	if self.fx_nanomachine_mode_hologram then
		self.fx_nanomachine_mode_hologram:Dispose()
		self.fx_nanomachine_mode_hologram = nil
	end

	if self.fx_black_liquid then
		for i = 1, #self.fx_black_liquid do
			if self.fx_black_liquid[i] then
				self.fx_black_liquid[i]:Dispose()
				self.fx_black_liquid[i] = nil
			end
		end

		self.fx_black_liquid = nil
	end

	if self.champion_sword then
		self.champion_sword:ConsumeComplete()
		self.champion_sword = nil
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.white_tint_obj) == false then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.white_tint_obj)
	end
	self.white_tint_obj = nil

	if self.resholder ~= nil then
		self.resholder:Dispose()
		self.resholder = nil
	end

	self.operator_ui = nil

	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose_all()
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

			and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.princess_zone_name) then
		self.current_state = self.states.meet_princess

		quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

		sp_util.start_scene(self.meet_princess_scene, self)

		return true
	end

end

--웨이브 배틀 종료
function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	-- 3번 전투가 끝났을 때
	if self.current_battle_state == self.battle_states.wave_3 and
			e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		self.current_battle_state = self.battle_states.wave_end

		sp_util.start_scene(self.end_battle_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return true
end

--웨이브 배틀
function local_class:on_battle_group_wave_clear_event(e)
	local current_wave = e.CurrentWave
	local max_wave = e.MaxWaveCount

	local has_next_wave = current_wave < max_wave

	-- 다음 웨이브가 있다면, 소환 후 탈출
	if has_next_wave then
		--message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGroupSpawnNextWaveEvent.Create('s14_battle_group'))
		self.current_wave = self.current_wave + 1

		self:start_wave_battle()
	end

	return true
end
--endregion event

--region wave_battle
--웨이브 배틀 순서
function local_class:start_wave_battle()
	if self.current_wave == 1 then
		start_coroutine(self.second_battle, self)

	elseif self.current_wave == 2 then
		start_coroutine(self.third_battle, self)
	end
end

--커스텀 wait_for_sec (스테이지 종료시 코루틴 종료 용)
function local_class:custom_wait_for_sec(duration)
	local end_time = unity_class.time.time + duration

	while not self.stage_ended and unity_class.time.time < end_time do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	return self.stage_ended
end

--등장하는 라보스 괴물 웨이브 배틀 세팅용
function local_class:appear_labose_creature(creatures, creature_data_list, duration, battle_group_name)
	local knight = self.get_knight()

	local count = 0

	for group_idx = 1, #creatures do
		count = count + 1

		for idx = 1, #creatures[group_idx] do
			if self.stage_ended then
				return
			end
			if group_idx == 1 then
				start_coroutine(function()
					local target = creatures[group_idx][idx]
					local dir = creature_data_list[group_idx].dir[idx]
					local pos = creature_data_list[group_idx].pos[idx]

					if self.stage_ended then
						return
					end

					wait_for_sec(1)

					self.fx.dead():Instantiate(pos)
					character_util.set_position(target, pos)
					character_util.set_direction(target, dir)

					if self.stage_ended then
						return
					end

					target.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false

					character_util.set_active_state(target, 'enabled')
					character_util.convert_to_monster(target, battle_group_name, 's14_battle_zone')
					command_util.execute_monster_notice(target, knight, 'battle')
					character_util.set_death_type(target, 'airspin')
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)
					scene_util.show_weapon(target)
				end)
			else
				start_coroutine(function()
					local target = creatures[group_idx][idx]
					local dir = creature_data_list[group_idx].dir[idx]
					local pos = creature_data_list[group_idx].pos[idx]

					if self.stage_ended then
						return
					end
					character_util.set_active_state(target, 'enabled')
					character_util.convert_to_monster(target, battle_group_name, 's14_battle_zone')

					self:hero_landing_copy_not_emo_anim(
							target,
							dir,
							pos,
							10,
							0.3,
							nil,
							{ is_hit = true,
							  is_active = false })

					if self.stage_ended then
						return
					end

					target.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false

					command_util.execute_monster_notice(target, knight, 'battle')
					character_util.set_death_type(target, 'airspin')
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)
					scene_util.show_weapon(target)
				end)
			end
		end

		if count ~= creature_data_list['count'] and
				self:custom_wait_for_sec(duration) then
			return
		end
	end
end

--오프닝 씬 (첫 텔레포트 이동 연출 씬)
function local_class:opening_scene()
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')

	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local demon_engineer = self.get_demon_engineer()

	local knight_start_pos = self.get_knight_pos(1, 1)
	local demon_engineer_start_pos = self.get_demon_engineer_pos(1, 1)

	local knight_move_pos = self.get_knight_pos(1, 2)
	local demon_engineer_move_pos = self.get_demon_engineer_pos(1, 2)

	local wp_key = 'wp_key'

	camera_util.move(knight_start_pos, 0)

	character_util.set_position(knight, knight_start_pos + vector(0, 9.75, 0))
	character_util.set_position(demon_engineer, demon_engineer_start_pos + vector(0, 9.75, 0))

	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_engineer, 'right', false)

	local knight_fx = self.fx.teleport_red():Instantiate(knight.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0),
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, knight.Transform)

	local demon_engineer_fx = self.fx.teleport_red():Instantiate(demon_engineer.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0),
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, demon_engineer.Transform)

	local amb_ship_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_amb_ship_02', loop = true, volume = 0.8, fade_in_time = 4 })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 기사, 비네트 f_teleprotshere_red 출력 상태에서 Y축 10에서 3까지 서서히 천천히 1초에 걸쳐 이동
	-- 기사 (left, idle, idle)
	-- 비네트 (right, idle, idle) 상태 출력
	-- Y축 3으로 도달하면 0.7초간 3 ~ 2.8 사이를 이동하면 두둥실 떠있는 연출
	-- 이후 1초 후 2초에 걸쳐 Y축 0으로 이동
	-- 도착하면 아래와 같이 이동
	-- 기사, 비네트(down, idle, walk)
	-- 4의 속도
	local finish_count = 0

	local warp_y_offset = 0.3

	local levitation_move = function(target, cur_y)
		target.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position, cur_y)
		target.SpineController.ShadowOffsetY = warp_y_offset - cur_y
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_teleport_01')
	start_coroutine(function()
		self:hero_landing_copy_not_emo_anim(
				knight,
				nil,
				knight_start_pos,
				9.9,
				1,
				3,
				{ shadow_offset_y = 0.3 })

		local levitation = true

		local from = knight.Position.y
		local to = knight.Position.y - 0.2
		start_coroutine(function()
			while levitation do
				coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(0.7, from, to, function(_, cur_value)
					levitation_move(knight, cur_value)

					if not levitation then
						return false
					end
				end)

				local prev_from = from
				from = to
				to = prev_from
			end
		end)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		levitation = false

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		self:hero_landing_copy_not_emo_anim(
				knight,
				nil,
				knight_start_pos,
				knight.Position.y - 0.3,
				2,
				0.3,
				{ shadow_offset_y = 0.3 })

		wait_for_sec(1)

		knight_fx:Dispose()

		yield_return(nil)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_object_warp_01')
		knight_fx = self.fx.teleport_red():Instantiate(knight.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0),
				unity_class.quaternion.identity, knight.Transform)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		knight_fx:Dispose()

		finish_count = finish_count + 1
	end)

	start_coroutine(function()
		self:hero_landing_copy_not_emo_anim(
				demon_engineer,
				nil,
				demon_engineer_start_pos,
				9.75,
				1,
				3,
				{ shadow_offset_y = 0.3 })
		local levitation = true

		local from = knight.Position.y
		local to = knight.Position.y - 0.2

		start_coroutine(function()
			while levitation do
				coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(0.7, from, to, function(_, cur_value)
					levitation_move(demon_engineer, cur_value)

					if not levitation then
						return false
					end
				end)

				local prev_from = from
				from = to
				to = prev_from
			end
		end)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		levitation = false

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		self:hero_landing_copy_not_emo_anim(
				demon_engineer,
				nil,
				demon_engineer_start_pos,
				demon_engineer.Position.y - 0.3,
				2,
				0.3,
				{ shadow_offset_y = 0.3 })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		demon_engineer_fx:Dispose()
		yield_return(nil)

		demon_engineer_fx = self.fx.teleport_red():Instantiate(demon_engineer.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0),
				unity_class.quaternion.identity, demon_engineer.Transform)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		demon_engineer_fx:Dispose()
		demon_engineer_fx = nil

		finish_count = finish_count + 1
	end)

	while finish_count ~= 2 do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--도착하면 fx_teleprotshere_red 출력 사라지고 1초 뒤 아래와 같이 점프 이동
	local jump_move_duration = (knight_move_pos - knight.Position).magnitude / 4

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'jump')
	character_util.jump(knight, 0.4, jump_move_duration)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight,
			knight_move_pos,
			nil,
			jump_move_duration,
			self,
			wp_key)

	scene_util.set_anim(demon_engineer, self, 'jump')
	character_util.jump(demon_engineer, 0.4, jump_move_duration)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(demon_engineer,
			demon_engineer_move_pos,
			nil,
			jump_move_duration,
			self,
			wp_key)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(demon_engineer)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--이동 완료되면 아래와 같이 출력
	--비네트(right, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_engineer, 'right', false)
	--기사(left, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)

	--이후 대화 진행
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(demon_engineer)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(amb_ship_sfx, 4)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
			{ name = 'ondemand/v2_75_civilwar/audio:bgm_civilwar_lab', state = 'field' })

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0, 0)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 4)

	--꼬마 공주 위로 메인 퀘스트 마커 출력
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(self.quest_marker_name,
			self.main_quest_id, true, self.get_princess())

	self.current_state = self.states.start
end

-- 존 이벤트(공주와 만나는 씬)
function local_class:meet_princess_scene()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local demon_engineer = self.get_demon_engineer()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	local target_dir = (knight.Position.x > princess.Position.x) and 'left' or 'right'

	local knight_move_pos = {
		first = {
			vector(self.get_knight_pos(2, 1).x, 0, knight.Position.z),
			vector(self.get_knight_pos(2, 1).x, 0, self.get_knight_pos(2, 2).z),
			self.get_knight_pos(2, 2)
		}
	}

	local demon_engineer_move_pos = {
		first = {
			vector(self.get_knight_pos(2, 1).x, 0, demon_engineer.Position.z),
			vector(self.get_knight_pos(2, 1).x, 0, self.get_knight_pos(2, 2).z),
			self.get_knight_pos(2, 2) + ((target_dir == 'left') and vector(2, 0, 0) or vector(-2, 0, 0))
		},
		second = {
			vector((self.get_knight_pos(2, 2) +
					((target_dir == 'left') and vector(2, 0, 0) or vector(-2, 0, 0))).x,
					0, (self.get_demon_engineer_pos(2, 1) + vector(0, 0, 2)).z),
			self.get_demon_engineer_pos(2, 1) + vector(0, 0, 2),
			self.get_demon_engineer_pos(2, 1)
		}
	}

	-- 왼쪽 진입 시
	-- 기사(right, surprise, idle) 상태에서 1회 jump되며 (notice) 버블 이모티콘 출력
	-- 오른쪽 진입 시
	-- 기사(left, surprise, idle) 상태에서 1회 jump 되며 (notice) 버블 이모티콘 출력
	character_util.normal_jump(knight, '01_player_jump_01')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(knight, self,
			{ dir = target_dir, sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'surprise', keep = true },
			'notice')

	--이후 0.3초에 걸쳐 공주 쪽으로 카메라 포커스 이동하면 3.5크기로 줌인
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 0.3)
	camera_util.move_async(princess.Position, 0.3)

	--2초 후 다시 기사 쪽으로 복귀되면서 카메라 4크기로 줌 아웃
	wait_for_sec(2)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.3)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.3)

	-- 기사 선택지

	-- 기사 왼쪽이면 1번 루트, 오른쪽으면 2번 루트로 이동
	-- 기사 (tired, run) 10의 속도
	-- 비네트 (idle, idle) 7의 속도
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')

	local wp_knight_key = 'wp_knight_key'
	local wp_demon_engineer_key = 'wp_demon_engineer_key'

	local run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight,
			knight_move_pos.first,
			10,
			nil,
			self,
			wp_knight_key,
			{ run = true, last_direction = 'down' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(demon_engineer,
			demon_engineer_move_pos.first,
			7,
			nil,
			self,
			wp_demon_engineer_key)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_knight_key)

	-- 기사, 꼬마 공주 위쪽 0.5타일에 도착하면 (down, tired, frustration)에서 중간에 멈춘 상태) 출력
	local frustration_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(knight, 'frustration')
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'frustration' })
	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(frustration_duration / 2)

		knight.SpineController.TimeScale = 0
	end)

	-- 비네트는 해당 위치 도착하면 동선에 따라 아래와 같이 출력
	-- ① (right, idle, idle)
	-- ② (left, idle, idle)
	-- 이동 시 방향 자동
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_demon_engineer_key)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(run_sfx)

	-- 비네트 도착하면 대사 진행
	--기사(down, tired, frustration의 중간 상태)에서 (sweat) 버블 이모티콘 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(knight, nil, 'sweat')

	--비네트(right, tired, cross_arm): 이렇게 작은 아이가… 챔피언 소드의 주인이라고…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			nil,
			'cross_arm',
			'tired',
			{ key = 'lw_main_s14_1', skip = true })

	--비네트(right, tired, cross_arm) 상태에서 (slience) 버블 이모티콘 출력
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(demon_engineer, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cross_arm', keep = true, one_shot_sfx = false },
			'tired',
			'silence')

	--비네트(right, sleep_deep, cross_arm): 도대체 어떻게…. 직접 보고도 믿을 수가 없네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			'sleep_deep',
			{ key = 'lw_main_s14_3', skip = true })

	--비네트 (right, sleep_deep, cross_arm) 상태에서 1초간 대기
	scene_util.play_wait_action(demon_engineer, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false },
			'sleep_deep',
			1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(demon_engineer)

	--이후 대화 출력

	-- 비네트(right, idle, idle): 감응도가 낮은 상태에서 로봇을 조종해서 무리가 온 것 같은데….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_s14_4', skip = true })

	-- 비네트(right, idle, idle): 공주 상태를 체크해 줘.나는 AI 모듈을 활성화하고 있을게.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_s14_5', skip = true })

	--기사 (right, tired, nod 2회 출력) 후 (down, tired, frustration의 중간 상태) 출력
	knight.SpineController.TimeScale = 1

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	character_util.look_at(knight, demon_engineer)

	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'frustration' })
	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(frustration_duration / 2)

		knight.SpineController.TimeScale = 0
	end)

	run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

	-- 비네트 아래와 같이 이동
	-- (idle, run)

	wp_util.move_async(demon_engineer, demon_engineer_move_pos.second, 7, nil,
			{ run = true, last_direction = 'down' })

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(run_sfx)

	scene_util.set_anim(demon_engineer, self, { name = 'dualgun_attack3', loop = true })

	local qte_routine = function(dir, duration, fail_func, success_func)
		local is_success = false

		if type_util.is_string(dir) then
			dir = { dir }
		end

		while not is_success do
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')

			-- Z NPC(cw_npc_a#cw_labose_creature) Y축 0에 도달하면 QTE(→) 진행

			-- QTE {durantion}초 제한
			for idx = 1, #dir do
				is_success = qte_play_util.swipe(dir[idx], { duration = duration })

				if not is_success then
					break
				end
				if #dir > 1 then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_style_guide_01')
				end
			end

			-- 실패 연출
			if not is_success then
				fail_func()
			end

			-- 성공 시 탈출
		end
		success_func()
	end

	local knight_arrow_atk = function(target, offset)
		-- 기사가  화살 쏘는 연출
		local start_pos = knight.Bounds.center
		local end_pos = target.Bounds.center
		local duration = 0.3

		local arrow = self.fx.knight_projectile():Instantiate(start_pos)

		local shoot_dir = (end_pos - start_pos).normalized
		arrow.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(shoot_dir)

		local time_passed = 0
		local progress = 0
		while progress < 1 do
			progress = time_passed / duration

			local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			arrow.transform.position = pos

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		arrow:Dispose()
		self.fx.hit():Instantiate(end_pos)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_creature_06')
		character_util.air_spin(target, { offset = offset })

		scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'release', count = 3 })

	elseif choose_result_1 == 2 then
		--얼마나 더 견뎌야 하는지?(forced)
		--기사 (left, tired, hold_loop) 1.5초 간 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
		scene_util.play_wait_action(knight, self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				'hold_loop',
				'tired',
				1.5)
	end

	--이후 다시 (left, attack, sword_idle) 상태 출력
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'sword_idle')

	--비네트는 (left, sleep_deep, cross_arm) 상태 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_engineer, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_engineer, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_engineer, self, { name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false })

	--카메라 3크기로 줌인
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.5)

	--카메라 0.5초에 걸쳐 비네트 포커스로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(demon_engineer.Position, 0.5)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--비네트 (left, sleep_deep, cross_arm): 다른 AI를 수정해서 사용하기엔 너무 리스크가 커….
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
					nil,
					nil,
					'sleep_deep',
					{ key = 'lw_main_s14_18', skip = true })
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--위 대사 출력 시 왼쪽으로 1초에 걸쳐 0.5 타일 이동 후 모션 출력
			character_util.remove_anim(demon_engineer)
			scene_util.set_anim(demon_engineer, self, { name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false, upper = true })

			wp_util.move_async(demon_engineer, demon_engineer.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), nil, 1)
		end),
	})

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--비네트 (right, sleep_deep, cross_arm): 복구 시스템을 사용하기엔 시간이 너무 오래 걸릴 거야….
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
					{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
					nil,
					'sleep_deep',
					{ key = 'lw_main_s14_19', skip = true })

		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--위 대사 출력 시 오른쪽으로 1초에 걸쳐 1 타일 이동 후 모션 출력
			wp_util.move_async(demon_engineer, demon_engineer.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), nil, 1)
		end),
	})

	--비네트 (right, sleep_deep, cross_arm) 상태에서 (silence) 버블 이모티콘 출력
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(demon_engineer, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			'sleep_deep',
			'silence')

	--비네트 왼쪽으로 0.5타일 0.5초에 걸쳐 이동 후 1.5초 뒤 대화 진행
	wp_util.move_async(demon_engineer, demon_engineer.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), nil, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--비네트 (down, idle, cross_arm): 헤븐홀드 완성이 어지간히 두려운가 본데….
	--위 대사 출력과 동시에 카메라 5초에 걸쳐 3.2크기로 줌아웃
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.2, 5)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			{ dir = 'down' },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_s14_21', skip = true })

	--비네트 2초간 (down, sleep_deep, idle) 상태로
	character_util.remove_anim(demon_engineer, true)

	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_engineer, self, 'sleep_deep')

	wait_for_sec(2)

	--비네트(down, sleep_deep, idle): 이 정도로 나를 막을 수 있다고 생각하다니…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_s14_22', skip = true })

	--비네트(down, idle, idle): 날 너무 과소평가 했어.
	--위 대사 출력 시 화면 shake 0.01 세기로 지속 출력
	--위와 동시에 카메라1초에 걸쳐  3크기로 줌 인
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_01')
	camera_util.cancel_resize_to()
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 1)
	camera_util.shake(0.01, 9999)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(demon_engineer)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_s14_23', skip = true })

	--비네트(down, attack, idle): 너는 절대 할 수 없는 방법을 보여주지!
	--위 대사 출력시 화면 shake 0.1 세기로 0.3초간 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			nil,
			'attack',
			{ key = 'lw_main_s14_24', skip = true })

	--비네트 나노머신화 준비 연출 진행
	--비네트 (down, sleep_deep, idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_engineer, self, 'sleep_deep')

	--동시에 2초에 걸쳐 카메라 2.8크기로 줌인
	camera_util.cancel_resize_to()
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.8, 2)

	--1초 뒤 비네트(down, sleep_deep, unique/nanomachine_mode) 출력되고 모션 끝날 때 (unique/nanomachine_mode_loop) 출력
	--동시에 카메라 0.3초에 걸쳐 2.6크기로 줌인
	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.6, 0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_demonengineer_cast_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_engineer, self, 'unique/nanomachine_mode')

	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	scene_util.set_anim(demon_engineer, self, 'unique/nanomachine_mode_loop')

	--1초 뒤 fx_lw_nanomachine_mode 이펙트 출력
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gimmick_vacuum_03')
	self.fx_nanomachine_mode = self.fx.nanomachine_mode():Instantiate(demon_engineer.Position)--, unity_class.quaternion.identity, demon_engineer.Transform)

	--1초 뒤 비네트(down, idle, unique/nanomachine_mode_loop) 출력
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_emotion(demon_engineer)

	--1초 뒤 fx_lw_nanomachine_mind_uploading 이펙트 출력
	--동시에 비네트 (attack) 표정 출력
	wait_for_sec(1)
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_engineer, self, 'attack')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_qc_03')
	self.fx_nanomachine_mind_uploading = self.fx.nanomachine_mind_uploading():Instantiate(demon_engineer.Position + self.fx_uploading_offset)--, unity_class.quaternion.identity, demon_engineer.Transform)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.5, 0.2)

	--이펙트 출력 완료되면 비네트 1.5초 후 대화 진행
	wait_for_sec(1.3)

	--비네트(down, attack, idle): $name, 시간이 필요해! 완료 될 때까지, 날 지켜줘!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			'attack',
			{ key = 'lw_main_s14_25', skip = true })

	--위 대사 출력 후에 fx_lw_nanomachine_mode_hologram 출력
	self.fx_nanomachine_mode_hologram = self.fx.nanomachine_mode_hologram():Instantiate(demon_engineer.Position)--, unity_class.quaternion.identity, demon_engineer.Transform)

	--카메라 기사 포커스로 0.3초에 걸쳐 이동
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.3)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.3)

	--기사 선택지
	--맡겨만 줘! (mercy)
	--얼마나 더 견뎌야 하는지? (brutal)
	local choose_result_2 = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'lw_main_s14_choose_8', 'mercy' },
		{ 'lw_main_s14_choose_9', 'brutal' },
	})

	if choose_result_2 == 1 then
		--맡겨만 줘! (mercy)
		--기사 (left, attack, victory_get) 출력
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, keep_anim = true })

		wait_for_sec(1.5)
	elseif choose_result_2 == 2 then
		--얼마나 더 견뎌야 하는지? (brutal)
		--기사 (left, tired, hold_loop) 1.5초간 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')

		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'hold_loop')

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
	end

	--공동 연출
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_02')

	for idx = 1, 6 do
		local target = creature_npcs.third[creature_name.third .. idx]

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

		character_util.normal_jump(target)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--기사 무기 변경 연출 출력
	--기사(left, attack, cwp/knight) 출력한 상태에서 fx_cwp_knight_fire 출력되면서 무기 활베라(cwp_knight2) 착용 전환
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_sword_short_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'cwp/knight', loop = false, keep_anim = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_impact_lightning_02')
	self.fx.cwp_knight_fire():Instantiate(knight.Position)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(knight, '[base]weapon1', 'cwp_knight2')
	self.lw_util:change_knight_weapon_to_bow()
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(demon_engineer)

	for idx = 1, third_labose_creature_count - 1 do
		local target = creature_npcs.third[creature_name.third .. idx]

		character_util.convert_to_monster(target, self.battle_group_name, 's14_battle_zone')
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(target, knight, 'battle')
		character_util.set_death_type(target, 'airspin')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)
		scene_util.show_weapon(target)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--비네트는 (down, attack, dualgun_attack3) 출력한 상태
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_engineer, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_engineer, self, 'attack')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	stage:SetGameOver(CS.Oak.UIGameOver.UIGameOverButtonType.OnlyWaypoint, false, false)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

	self.current_battle_state = self.battle_states.wave_1
end

--배틀 종료 씬
function local_class:end_battle_scene()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local battle_center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('battle_center_pos')

	local leader = self.get_knight()

	local is_sub_quest_clear = user_progress:ClearedQuest(self.sub_mk_quest_id)

	-- 기사 아래와 같은 위치에 (left, attack, bow_idle) 상태로 위치
	--무기는 cwp_knight2 착용한 상태
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(leader, '[base]weapon1', 'cwp_knight2')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	leader.Position = battle_center_pos

	-- 적 동적 생성
	local dynamic_npc_spec = {}
	local spec_name = 'lw_ghoul'

	for i = 1, 16 do
		dynamic_npc_spec['left_creature_' .. i] = spec_name
	end

	for i = 1, 16 do
		dynamic_npc_spec['right_creature_' .. i] = spec_name
	end

	for i = 1, 6 do
		dynamic_npc_spec['bottom_creature_' .. i] = spec_name
	end

	for i = 1, 6 do
		dynamic_npc_spec['center_creature_' .. i] = spec_name
	end

	local dynamic_npcs = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(dynamic_npc_spec)

	local left_creature_npc = {}

	for i = 1, 16 do
		table.insert(left_creature_npc, dynamic_npcs['left_creature_' .. i])
	end

	local right_creature_npc = {}

	for i = 1, 16 do
		table.insert(right_creature_npc, dynamic_npcs['right_creature_' .. i])
	end

	local bottom_creature_npc = {}

	for i = 1, 6 do
		table.insert(bottom_creature_npc, dynamic_npcs['bottom_creature_' .. i])
	end

	local center_creature_data = {
		offset = {
			vector(-1.5, 0, 2.5),
			vector(2.5, 0, 2),
			vector(-2.5, 0, -2),
			vector(1, 0, -2.5),
			vector(-1.5, 0, 1),
			vector(3, 0, -1.5),
		}
	}
	self.fx_black_liquid = {}

	for i = 1, #center_creature_data.offset do
		local pos = battle_center_pos + center_creature_data.offset[i]

		table.insert(self.fx_black_liquid, self.fx.black_liquid():Instantiate(pos))
	end

	--기사 아래와 같은 위치에 (left, attack, bow_idle) 상태로 위치
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bow_idle')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 1초 후 화면 shake 0.1세기로 0.5초간 출력
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_light_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 이후 0.3초에 걸쳐 카메라 아래와 같이 이동
	camera_util.move_async(battle_center_pos + vector(-5, 0, 0), 0.3)

	local move_speed = 1

	local left_outside_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left',
			battle_center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1.5), -1.5)

	local move_dist_x = battle_center_pos.x - left_outside_pos.x - 10
	local move_key = 'left_move'

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_02')
	for i = 1, #left_creature_npc do
		local left_creature = left_creature_npc[i]
		local index = i - 1
		left_creature.Position = left_outside_pos + vector(-math.floor(index / 4) - (index % 2) * 0.5, 0, -(index % 4))
		character_util.set_direction(left_creature, 'right', false)

		-- Z NPC (right, idle, walk) 상태로 그리드 밖에서 1의 속도로 진입
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(left_creature, left_creature.Position + vector(move_dist_x, 0, 0),
				move_speed, nil, self, move_key)
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	-- 카메라 이동 시작되면 위치는 고정되고 모션만 출력
	-- 1초 후 1초에 걸쳐 카메라 다시 이동
	camera_util.move_async(battle_center_pos + vector(5, 0, 0), 1)

	-- Z NPC (left, idle, walk) 상태로 그리드 밖에서 1의 속도로 진입
	local right_outside_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right',
			battle_center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1.5), 1.5)

	move_dist_x = battle_center_pos.x - right_outside_pos.x + 10
	move_key = 'right_move'

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_02')
	for i = 1, #right_creature_npc do
		local right_creature = right_creature_npc[i]
		local index = i - 1
		right_creature.Position = right_outside_pos + vector(math.floor(index / 4) + (index % 2) * 0.5, 0, -(index % 4))
		character_util.set_direction(right_creature, 'left', false)

		-- Z NPC (right, idle, walk) 상태로 그리드 밖에서 1의 속도로 진입
		--이때 기사 (right, attack, bow_idle)에서 활베라 착용한 상태로 출력
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(right_creature, right_creature.Position + vector(move_dist_x, 0, 0),
				move_speed, nil, self, move_key)
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	-- 카메라 이동 시작되면 위치는 고정
	-- 카메라는 기사 포커스로 0.3초에 걸쳐 이동
	camera_util.move_async(battle_center_pos + vector(0, 0, 0), 0.3)

	-- (left, attack, bow_idle) 1초간 출력
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- (right, attack, bow_idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)

	-- 기사 선택지
	local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 이 정도로 쓰러지지 않는다! (mercy)
		{ 'lw_main_s14_59', 'mercy' },
		-- 아 우리 팀 뭐 함?! (forced)
		{ 'lw_main_s14_60', 'forced' },
		--또 얼마나 더 견뎌야 하는지? (brutal)
		{ 'lw_main_s14_61', 'brutal' }
	})

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)

	if player_choice == 1 then
		-- 기사 (left, attack, jingak) 출력
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'jingak', sfx_name = '01_jingak_01' })
	elseif player_choice == 2 then
		-- 기사 (left, damaged, release 2회)/(right, damaged release 2회)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
	elseif player_choice == 3 then
		--또 얼마나 더 견뎌야 하는지? (brutal)
		--기사 (left, tired, hold_loop) 1.5초간 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				'hold_loop',
				'tired',
				1.5)
	end
	-- 선택지 선택 연출 끝나면 아래의 위치에 shout 말풍선 출력

	-- 말풍선 출력되면 기사 (down, attack, bow_idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bow_idle')

	-- 마스터, 지원 왔습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_worker_appear_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader,

--하늘에서 떨어지는 연출용
function local_class:hero_landing_copy_not_emo_anim(fo, dir, pos, jump_height, fall_duration, finish_y_pos, data)
	dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(dir, fo.Direction)
	pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(pos, fo.Position)
	finish_y_pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(finish_y_pos, 0)
	jump_height = lua_helper.get_or_default(jump_height, 10)
	fall_duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(fall_duration, 0.4)

	local info = {}

	info.is_hit = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'is_hit', false)
	info.shadow_offset_y = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'shadow_offset_y', 0)
	info.is_active = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'is_active', true)

	-- 캐릭터를 히어로 랜딩 할 위치로 배치
	if info.is_active then
		character_util.set_active_state(fo, 'enabled')
	end

	character_util.set_position(fo, pos + vector(0, jump_height, 0), true)
	character_util.set_direction(fo, dir)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_pos = fo.Position
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, fo.Position.y, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		if start_pos.y + dist_y > finish_y_pos then
			character_util.set_position(fo, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0))
		else
			character_util.set_position(fo, vector(start_pos.x, finish_y_pos, start_pos.z))
		end

		fo.SpineController.ShadowOffsetY = info.shadow_offset_y - fo.Position.y

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--TODO: 착지 될 때 효과음이 고정이라면 여기서 랜딩 끝날 때의 사운드 재생 하는 것도 좋을 듯함
	character_util.set_position(fo, vector(start_pos.x, finish_y_pos, start_pos.z))

	if info.is_hit then
		self.fx.hit():Instantiate(vector(start_pos.x, finish_y_pos, start_pos.z))
	end
end

function local_class:create_white_tint()
	self.white_tint_obj = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.resholder,
			'ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/theatres/ending', 'white_tint_background')

	self.white_tint_renderer = self.white_tint_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer))
	self.white_tint_obj.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 40
	self.white_tint_obj:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:white_tinting(from, to, duration)
	self.white_tint_obj:SetActive(true)

	self.white_tint_renderer.color = unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, from })

	self.white_tint_renderer.sortingLayerName = 'Top Effects'
	self.white_tint_renderer.sortingOrder = 16

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		self.white_tint_renderer.color = unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, from * (1 - progress) + to * progress })

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.white_tint_renderer.color = unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, to })
end

function local_class:set_white_tint_pos(pos)
	self.white_tint_obj.transform.localPosition = vector_util.get_x0z(pos, 6)
end

function local_class:set_npcs_sorting_layer(npcs, layer_name, order)
	if layer_name == nil then
		layer_name = 'Default'
	end

	if order == nil then
		order = 0
	end

	for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		local origin_dir = npc.Direction
		npc.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
		npc.SpineController:SetSortingLayer(layer_name, order)
		npc.Direction = origin_dir
	end
end

	--미니 게임 이름
	self.mini_game_name = 'RobotFight'

	self.is_playing = false
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()

end

	self.cs_controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

--미니 게임 로드
function local_class:load_mini_game()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	self.mini_game_instance = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.mini_game_name)

	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false

	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, stage.Name, function()
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	-- 미니 게임 로드 대기
	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--현재 섹션에서 스테이지 진입 했을 경우
	if self.cs_controller.StartingInnerProgress == self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_86_laboseworld/audio:bgm_heavenhold_battle_normal',
											 state = 'event', volume = 1, mix = 0 })

		screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
	end

	self:start_mini_game()
end

-- 미니 게임 시작
function local_class:start_mini_game()
	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)

	self:update_mini_game()
end

function local_class:update_mini_game()
	self.is_playing = true
	while self.is_playing do
		self.is_playing = self.mini_game_instance:update(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.mini_game_instance.is_clear then
		sp_util.enter_scene(nil)
		self:finish_mini_game()
	end
end

--fade out(white)로 미니게임 종료
function local_class:finish_mini_game()
	mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)

	camera_util.move_async(vector(-500, 0, 0), 0)

	--이후 컷신
	local media_path = 'ondemand/v2_86_laboseworld/video/chapter18_MS_ending.$codec.mp4'

	screen_util.play_media(media_path, { start_fade_out_color = unity_class.color.white })

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 이벤트 종료. 다음 섹션으로
	self.controller:progress_section()
end

return local_class

end

	})

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
end

	self.dynamic_npc:dispose()

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
end

	return false

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.battle_zone_name) and
		self.current_state == self.states.none then
		self.current_state = self.states.entered_battle_zone
		self:close_battlegate()
		self.controller.sp_manager:start_coroutine_delayed(self.start_battle, self)
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_zone_name and
		self.current_state == self.states.entered_battle_zone then
		self.current_state = self.states.cleared_battle
		self:open_battlegate()
		self.controller.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.talk_with_lilith_scene, self)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

				true,
				self.markers.knight_pos() + vector(-3, 0, 0)

		field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton)

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.battle_zone) then
		self.current_state = self.states.role_tutorial
		start_coroutine(self.role_button_tutorial, self)

		return true
	end


	if self.current_state == self.states.role_tutorial and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.swat_zone) then
		self.current_state = self.states.show_swat
		start_coroutine(self.swat_dead_event, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.show_swat and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.gravity_gun_zone) then
		self.current_state = self.states.get_gravity_gun
		self.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.get_gravity_gun_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 롤 버튼 튜토리얼
function local_class:role_button_tutorial()
	local battle_monsters = {}
	local monster_name_pre_fix = 'battle_3_'
	local index = 1

	while true do
		local monster = get_character(monster_name_pre_fix .. index)

		if monster == nil then
			break
		end

		table.insert(battle_monsters, monster)
		index = index + 1
	end

	for i = 1, #battle_monsters do
		character_util.convert_to_npc(battle_monsters[i])
	end

	stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton)
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(get_party_leader(), CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton)

	qte_play_util.show_action_tap(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton, true, 1, true)

	local wait_check = false
	local touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action5TouchDown or
					e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown then
				wait_check = true
				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	message_system:Subscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'callback')
	message_system:Subscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	while not wait_check do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)

	for i = 1, #battle_monsters do
		character_util.convert_to_monster(battle_monsters[i], 'battle_3', 'battle_3')
		command_util.publish_monster_notice(battle_monsters[i], get_party_leader(), 'battle')
	end

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

--- 라보스에 닿아 터지는 경찰
function local_class:swat_dead_event()
	local swat = self.characters.swat()
	local labose_zone_count = 12
	local stage_controller = get_stage_event_controller('LaboseWorld1Controller')

	--경찰 0.5의 속도로 오른쪽으로 이동하기 시작
	wp_util.move(swat, swat.Position + vector(6.5, 0, 0), 0.5)

	local swat_dead = function()
		character_util.stop(swat)

		--경찰(right, idle, dead1) 애니메이션 끝날 때까지 대기
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_villain_scream_02', play_pos = swat.Position })
		scene_util.set_anim(swat, self, { name = 'dead1', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01' })

		--동시에 1.83초 동안 경찰 완전히 검은색으로 틴트 처리
		character_util.add_color(swat, swat.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 1.83)
		self:custom_wait_for_sec(spine_util.get_animation_duration(swat, 'dead1'))

		--0.5초 대기
		self:custom_wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--경찰 1초간 shake 시작
		character_util.shake(swat, 0.02, 1)
		--경찰 1초간 크기 0.5배로 줄어듬. 끝날 때까지 대기
		character_util.spine_scale(swat, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5, 1)
		self:custom_wait_for_sec(1)

		--(현재 플레이어가 해당 그리드 내에 있다면) 카메라 shake (0.5, 0.4)
		if screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(swat.Position) then
			camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.4)
		end

		--경찰 위치에 fx_lilithtower_virus_death_explosion 이펙트 생성
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fly_explosion_02', play_pos = swat.Position })
		self.fx.lilithtower_virus_death_explosion():Instantiate(swat.Position)
		--경찰 캐릭터 제거
		character_util.set_active_state(swat, 'disabled')
	end

	start_coroutine(function()
		--라보스 안개 이미지에 표시한 범위와 방향에 따라 왼쪽 그리드 바깥에서부터 1칸씩 생성되기 시작
		--fx_lw_virus_fog_weak 이펙트 사용
		--이미지에 나오는 1층 공간을 전부 채울때까지 진행
		local index = 2
		local swat_dead_check = false

		while self.swat_event_loop and index <= labose_zone_count do
			self:custom_wait_for_sec(1)

			stage_controller:add_labose_zone(index)

			index = index + 1

			local zone = field_util.get_zone('scene_labose_zone_' .. index)
			if not swat_dead_check and CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(zone.Bounds, swat.Position) then
				swat_dead_check = true
				start_coroutine(swat_dead)
			end
		end
	end)

	--경찰: 으, 으아아아…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01', play_pos = swat.Position })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat, 'lw_main_s2_1', false)

	--2초 대기
	self:custom_wait_for_sec(2)

	--경찰: 살려줘… 죽고싶지 않아…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_sadness_01', play_pos = swat.Position })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat, 'lw_main_s2_2', false)
end

--- 비네트가 네오 D O 포켓을 개조해줌
function local_class:get_gravity_gun_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local demon_engineer = self.characters.demon_engineer()
	local leader_pos = self.markers.knight_pos()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)
	--다음 동작 동시에 실행
	wait_all_lua(
			{
				--가디언 1초간 이미지의 경로를 따라 이동
				wp_util.move_async, leader, leader_pos, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' }
			},
			{
				--카메라 1초간 가디언 도착위치 왼쪽 1칸 옆 지점으로 이동
				camera_util.move_async, leader_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0), 1
			}
	)

	--모든 동작 끝난 후 다음 동작 진행
	--가디언(left, tired, question, loop = false) 1.5초 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'question')
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--가디언(right, tired, idle) 0.5초 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'idle')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--가디언(left, tired, idle) 1초 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--가디언(left, attack, nod 1회) 끝날 때까지 대기
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1, one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_ready_01' })

	--가디언(left, attack, run, jump 1회) 1.5초 대기
	local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'run')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, '01_player_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--다음 동작 동시에 실행
	dash_sfx:Stop()
	--카메라 shake(0.3, 0.2)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
	--가디언(left, surprise, embarrassed, jump 1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'embarrassed')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader)
	--비네트(shout 말풍선, 크기 1.3, 위치 중앙 상단): 잠깐 멈춰!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(demon_engineer, 'lw_main_s2_3', true,
			{ scale = 1.3, screen_pos = vector(-100, 250) })

	--가디언(up, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'idle')

	--다음 동작 동시에 실행
	wait_all_lua(
			{
				--카메라 1.5초간 위로 2칸 이동
				camera_util.move_async, leader_pos + vector(0, 0, 2), 1.5
			},
			function()
				--비네트(attack) 위쪽 그리드 밖에서 이미지의 경로를 따라 5의 속도로 이동
				scene_util.hide_weapon(demon_engineer)
				scene_util.set_emotion(demon_engineer, self, 'attack')
				character_util.remove_anim(demon_engineer)

				local move_pos = self.markers.demon_engineer_pos(2)

				wp_util.move_async(demon_engineer, wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(demon_engineer, move_pos, false),
						5, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'down', play_sfx = true })

				--비네트(down, attack, idle) 0.5초 대기
				scene_util.set_anim(demon_engineer, self, 'idle')
				wait_for_sec(0.5)
			end
	)

	--모든 동작 끝난 후 다음 동작 진행
	--비네트(down, attack, shoot): 너 또 저거 몸으로 뚫으려 그랬지?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_engineer, self, 'shoot')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_engineer, 'lw_main_s2_4')

	--비네트(down, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_engineer, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_engineer, self, 'idle')

	do
		--선택지
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--(forced) 이 한 몸 망가지는건 두렵지 않다!
			{ 'lw_main_s2_5', 'forced' },
			--(brutal) 살살 뚫으면 안 아파.
			{ 'lw_main_s2_6', 'brutal' }
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--가디언(left, attack, salute, loop = false) 1초 대기
			scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'salute')
			wait_for_sec(1)
		else
			--가디언(left, doyagao, victory_get, loop = false) 2초 대기
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
			scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'doyagao')
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'victory_get')
			wait_for_sec(2)
		end
	end

	--가디언(up, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'idle')

	--비네트(down, tired, idle): 뭐래, 그때도 내가 치료제 안보내줬으면 그대로 죽었을 거면서….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			'down',
			'idle',
			'tired',
			'lw_main_s2_7')

	--비네트(down, idle, release): 아무튼, 전에 쓰던 그 총 같은거 잠깐 나 줘봐.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self,
			'down',
			'release',
			'idle',
			'lw_main_s2_8')

	--가디언(up, idle, throw, loop = false)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'throw', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	--네오 D.O. 포켓을 비네트에게 던지는 가디언
	--drop_item_util.throw_item 사용
	--아이템 스프라이트 gravity_gun
	--생성 위치는 가디언의 현재 위치
	--도착 위치는 비네트 오른쪽 0.2칸 옆 지점
	local gravity_gun_id = 21151
	local gravity_gun_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = leader.Position,
		target = demon_engineer.Position + vector(0.2, 0, 0),
		itemid = gravity_gun_id,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		showoncharacter = false,
		skip_text = true,
		sprscale = 0.5
	})

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--가디언(up, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'idle')
	--0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--비네트(right, idle, eat): 어디 보자… 출력 쪽 회로만 이렇게 살짝 손봐주면….
	local clang_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clang_01', loop = true })

function local_class:custom_wait_for_sec(duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration and self.swat_event_loop do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

	self:pre_setting()
end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

	self.controller = nil

end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's20_virus_explosion_event') and
		self.current_state == self.states.none then
		self.current_state = self.states.entered_explosion_zone
		self.controller.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.virus_explosion_scene, self)
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object(self.exit_inner_name)) and
		self.current_state == self.states.entered_explosion_zone then
		self.current_state = self.states.entered_legendary_hero_old_event
		self.controller.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.play_legendary_hero_old_meeting_event, self)

	return false

function local_class:demon_queen_cry_routine()
	local demon_queen = self.characters.demon_queen()
	local offset = vector(0.15, 0.1, 0)
	self.demon_queen_cry = true

	while self.demon_queen_cry do
		self.fx:tear():Instantiate(demon_queen.Position + offset)

		wait_for_sec(4)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	-- 섹션 시작 셋팅
	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.controller.cs_controller.StartingInnerProgress == 20 then
		start_coroutine(function()
			screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
			screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

			music_player:PlayStageIntroMusic()

			scene_util.set_anim(get_party_leader(), self, 'victory_get')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name), 1)

			wait_for_sec(1.5)
			character_util.remove_anim(get_party_leader())
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
			party_util.reset_controllers()

			self.s21_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '01_war_loop_01',
				loop = true,
				type_priority = 'loop',
			})
		end)
	else
		self.s21_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_war_loop_01',
			loop = true,
			type_priority = 'loop',
			fade_in_time = 16
		})
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	if self.s21_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.s21_loop_sfx:FadeOut()
		self.s21_loop_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil

	self.dynamic_npc:dispose()
end

	return false

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's21_ending') and
		self.current_state == self.states.none then
		self.current_state = self.states.entered_ending_zone
		self.controller.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.ending_scene, self)
		return true
	end
end

		scene_util.set_emotion(demon_queen, self, 'tear')
		character_util.set_active_state(demon_queen, 'enabled')
		demon_queen.Interactable.Talk = 'lw_main_s20_1_8'

		-- creature 세팅
		local creature_count = 13
		for i = 1, creature_count do
			local creature = get_character('s20_1_labose_creature_' .. i)
			local pos = self.markers.labose_creature(1, i)
			local dir = self.markers.legendary_hero_old().x > pos.x and 'right' or 'left'
			character_util.set_position(creature, pos)
			scene_util.set_direction(creature, dir, false)
			scene_util.set_anim(creature, self, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false })
			character_util.add_color(creature, creature.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.7, 0)
			creature.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(creature, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end
		character_util.set_anim(get_character('s20_1_labose_creature_12'), { name = 'dead', loop = false, scale = 100 })
		character_util.set_anim(get_character('s20_1_labose_creature_13'), { name = 'dead', loop = false, scale = 100 })
	end
end

function local_class:set_dynamic_npc()

	for key, npc in pairs(self.dynamic_npc.container) do
		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('ending_' .. key)
		character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'up')
	end

	if user_util.has_fei() then
		character_util.set_position(self.dynamic_npc:get('china_hero_girl'), vector(999, 0, 999))
	else
		character_util.set_position(self.dynamic_npc:get('china_hero_boy'), vector(999, 0, 999))
	end
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	self:set_npc()
	self:set_dynamic_npc()

	self:set_main_quest_marker_in_section()

	-- 에리나 시체에 나레이션 추가
	local legendary_hero_old = self.characters.legendary_hero_old()
	local narration_interactable = CS.Oak.NarrationInteractable()

	narration_interactable.StringKeys = { 'lw_main_s20_1_narration_1' }
	legendary_hero_old.Interactable = narration_interactable

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
end

function local_class:set_main_quest_marker_in_section()
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'entrance_to_the_other_world', target = self.markers.other_world_portal_center() }
	})
end

	-- 가디언 up 방향 전환.

	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_queen, self, 'tired')

	-- 리리스 NPC가 1초에 걸쳐 표시된 지점으로 up 방향으로 정렬.

	wp_util.move_async(demon_queen, char_align_pos_list,

	-- 리리스 (up, idle, idle) : $name… 난…

			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_s21_1_3', skip = true })

	-- 비록 에리나는 죽었지만…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self, nil, nil, nil, 'lw_main_s21_1_3_1')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_walk_04')
	-- 리리스 (up, idle, 0.03값으로 1초 shake) : 내겐… 아직 지켜야 할… 소중한 마계가 남아 있으니까.

			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_s21_1_4', skip = true })

	-- 리리스 (up, idle, idle) : 저번처럼 앉아서 울고만 있진 않을거야.

			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_s21_1_5', skip = true })

			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_s21_1_6', skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	-- 리리스 (up, idle, idle) : 너는 저 문으로 들어갈 수 있는거지?

			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_s21_1_7', skip = true })

	scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	-- 리리스 (up, idle, idle) : 너라면… 가능하겠지.

			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_s21_1_9', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({

		while time_passed < duration and not stop_portal_sfx do

			portal_sfx.Volume = cur_volume + ((result_volume - cur_volume) * progress)

function local_class:set_loop_sfx_volume(sfx, value, duration)
	start_coroutine(function()
		local time_passed = 0
		local cur_volume = sfx.Volume
		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			sfx.Volume = cur_volume + ((value - cur_volume) * progress)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		sfx.Volume = value
	end)
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.get_name_puzzle_doors[1]), true)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.get_name_puzzle_doors[2]), true)

	if quest_util.get_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.first_in_stage_key) == 1 then
		self.is_first_in_stage = false
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_state = self.states.opening

	if self.is_first_in_stage then
		self.is_first_in_stage = false

		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene()

			self:opening_scene()

			sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
		end)
	else
		start_coroutine(function()
			--화면 페이드인과 함께 BGM 재생, 믹스 4초
			self.amb_1_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(

					})

					true, false)

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
		end)
	end

end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_maiden()) then

		self.current_state = self.states.interact_maiden
		self.get_maiden().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		sp_util.start_scene(self.maiden_before_battle_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_fake_switch()) and
			self.current_state == self.states.pushing_switch then

		self.current_state = self.states.interact_bw_switch
		sp_util.start_scene(self.puzzle_after_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

		if self.fairy_zone_data[zone_name] ~= nil and
				self.fairy_zone_data[zone_name].is_first_enter == false then

			self.fairy_zone_data[zone_name].is_first_enter = true
			start_coroutine(self.fairy_zone_routine, self, self.fairy_zone_data[zone_name])
			return true
		end
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(),
			'main_s22_maiden_event_zone') and
			self.current_state == self.states.opening then

		local leader = get_party_leader()

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			--왼쪽 존 엔터하면 컨트롤 뺏고 로레인 대사

function local_class:opening_scene()

	--라보스 괴물들이 있는 모습이 보인다.
