local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldMainSection29')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = LaboseWorldMain @
		Comment = 케이든 보스 1페이즈로 전환 @
		Index = 28 @
		NextSections = 29 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type LaboseWorldMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'laboseworld_7'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	-- 보스전 1, 2 페이즈 제작 이후 설정
	self.states = {
		boss_battle_phase_1_start = 1,
		boss_battle_phase_1_end = 2,
		boss_battle_phase_2_start = 3,
		boss_battle_phase_2_end = 4
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.boss_battle_phase_1_start

	--역병의사
	self.get_plague_doctor = function()
		return get_character('plague_doctor')
	end

	-- 역병의사 보스 phase 1
	self.get_boss_plague_doctor_phase_1 = function()
		return get_character('boss_plague_doctor_phase_1')
	end

	-- 역병의사 보스 phase 2
	self.get_boss_plague_doctor_phase_2 = function()
		return get_character('boss_plague_doctor_phase_2')
	end

	self.get_pivot_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('s29_pivot_pos')
	end

	self.get_boss_dw_scene = function()
		return get_field_object('boss_dw_scene_phase_1')
	end

	---@type SpineCharacterDissolver
	self.dissolver = nil

	-- 역병의사 전투 관련 키 값
	self.boss_battle = {
		phase_1 = {
			group_name = 'main_s29_boss_battle_phase_1',
			title = 'lw_main_s29_boss_phase_1_title',
			subtitle = 'lw_main_s29_boss_phase_1_sub_title',
			end_custom_key = 'phase_1_battle_end'
		},
		phase_2 = {
			group_name = 'main_s29_boss_battle_phase_2',
			title = 'lw_main_s29_boss_phase_2_title',
			subtitle = 'lw_main_s29_boss_phase_2_sub_title',
		},
		zone_name = 'boss_battle',
	}

	self.fx = {
		plaguedoctor_transform = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_plaguedoctor_transform')
		end,
		plaguedoctor_black_feather = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_plaguedoctor_black_feather')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_boss_title()
	self.fx:load_all()

	self.dissolver = get_or_create_global_table('utils/SpineCharacterDissolver')
	self.dissolver:load_async('ondemand/v2_75_civilwar/theatres/dissolve', 'dissolve_material_container')
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEnterEvent), 'on_battle_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), 'on_battle_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent), 'on_field_object_revived_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent), 'on_pause_end_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	local custom_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress,
			self.boss_battle.phase_1.end_custom_key)

	self:battle_map_setting()

	if custom_state ~= nil and custom_state == 1 then
		self:boss_phase_2_pre_setting()
	else
		self:pre_setting(custom_state)
	end

	local section_progress = 28
	local start_on_this = self.cs_controller.StartingInnerProgress == section_progress

	start_coroutine(function()
		sp_util.enter_scene()

		local camera_start_pos
		local camera_size
		if custom_state ~= nil and custom_state == 1 then
			--카메라 2페이즈 보스 위치 2칸 위 지점에서 대기
			--카메라 크기 5.5
			camera_start_pos = self.get_pivot_pos() + vector(0, 0, 2)
			camera_size = 5.5
		else
			--카메라 1페이즈 보스 위치 1.3칸 위 지점에서 대기
			--카메라 크기 3.5
			camera_start_pos = self.get_pivot_pos() + vector(0, 0, 1.3)
			camera_size = 3.5
		end

		if start_on_this then
			camera_util.move_async(camera_start_pos, 0)
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(camera_size, 0)
			screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		end

		if custom_state ~= nil and custom_state == 1 then
			self.current_state = self.states.boss_battle_phase_2_start
			self:boss_phase_2_change_scene(start_on_this)
		else
			self:boss_change_scene()
		end

		--보스 hp 바가 튀어보이는 이슈 때문에 한프레임 쉬어줌
		coroutine.yield()

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

		--화면 좌측 상단의 미니맵 / 캐릭터 스탯 UI 비활성화
		self:hide_ui()

		if start_on_this then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

-- BattleEnterEvent로 BattleInstanceID 받아와서 설정
function local_class:on_battle_enter_event(e)
	if(self.phase_1_battleInstance_id == nil and e.FieldObject == self.get_boss_plague_doctor_phase_1()) then
		self.phase_1_battleInstance_id = e.BattleInstanceId;

	elseif(self.phase_2_battleInstance_id == nil and e.FieldObject == self.get_boss_plague_doctor_phase_2())then
		self.phase_2_battleInstance_id = e.BattleInstanceId;
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_end_event(e)
	if e.IsKill then
		if self.phase_1_battleInstance_id == e.BattleInstanceId and
				self.current_state == self.states.boss_battle_phase_1_start then
			start_coroutine(function()
				sp_util.enter_scene()
				self:deactivate_battle(self.get_boss_plague_doctor_phase_1())

				--customState로 진행상황 저장
				quest_util.set_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.boss_battle.phase_1.end_custom_key, 1)

				self.current_state = self.states.boss_battle_phase_1_end

				self:boss_phase_1_dead_scene()
				self.current_state = self.states.boss_battle_phase_2_start

				--보스 hp 바가 튀어보이는 이슈 때문에 한프레임 쉬어줌
				coroutine.yield()

				sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

				--화면 좌측 상단의 미니맵 / 캐릭터 스탯 UI 비활성화
				self:hide_ui()
			end)

			return true
		elseif self.phase_2_battleInstance_id == e.BattleInstanceId and
				self.current_state == self.states.boss_battle_phase_2_start then
			start_coroutine(function()
				sp_util.enter_scene()
				self:deactivate_battle(self.get_boss_plague_doctor_phase_2())

				self.current_state = self.states.boss_battle_phase_2_end
				self:boss_phase_2_dead_scene()
			end)

			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_revived_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader) then
		self:hide_ui()

		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_pause_end_event(e)
	self:hide_ui()

	return true
end

function local_class:battle_map_setting()
	--보스전 공간(boss_dw_scene) boss_DW_scene_idle_off 애니메이션 재생
	local boss_dw_scene = self.get_boss_dw_scene()
	animator_util.play(boss_dw_scene, 'idle_off')
	boss_dw_scene.ActiveState = active_state('visible')

	-- 투명벽 설치
	local vfo_pos = {
		vector(-2, 1, 14),
		vector(-1, 1, 14),
		vector(0, 1, 14),
		vector(1, 1, 14),
		vector(2, 1, 14),
	}

	for i = 1, 5 do
		field_object_util.create_virtual_field_object(vfo_pos[i])
	end
end

function local_class:hide_ui()
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:SetActiveFieldResourceBoxAndSettingAndChatButton(false)
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	local plague_doctor = self.get_plague_doctor()
	local pivot_pos = self.get_pivot_pos()
	local plague_doctor_pos = pivot_pos

	--역병의사
	character_util.set_active_state(plague_doctor, 'disabled')
	scene_util.set_direction(plague_doctor, 'down', false)
	plague_doctor.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	--역병의사 보스 페이즈 1
	local boss_plague_doctor_phase_1 = self.get_boss_plague_doctor_phase_1()
	character_util.set_active_state(boss_plague_doctor_phase_1, 'enabled')
	scene_util.set_direction(boss_plague_doctor_phase_1, 'down', false)
	boss_plague_doctor_phase_1.Position = plague_doctor_pos
	scene_util.set_anim(boss_plague_doctor_phase_1, self, { name = 'transform_loop' })

	--역병의사 보스 페이즈 2
	local boss_plague_doctor_phase_2 = self.get_boss_plague_doctor_phase_2()
	character_util.set_active_state(boss_plague_doctor_phase_2, 'enabled')
	scene_util.set_direction(boss_plague_doctor_phase_2, 'down', false)
	boss_plague_doctor_phase_2.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local leader_pos = pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, -3.5)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up', false)
	character_util.set_position(leader, leader_pos)
end

function local_class:boss_change_scene()
	local boss_plague_doctor_phase_1 = self.get_boss_plague_doctor_phase_1()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		name = 'ondemand/v2_86_laboseworld/audio:bgm_dimension_boss_01', state = 'combat', mix = 0 })

	--보스 타이틀 2초간 출력
	--title: 역병의사
	--subtitle: 진실에 도달한 자
	screen_util.show_boss_title(self.boss_battle.phase_1.title,
			self.boss_battle.phase_1.subtitle, 2, false)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.remove_anim(boss_plague_doctor_phase_1)

	--카메라 줌아웃 (5.25, 1)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5.25, 1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--카메라 크기 8은 보스 전투에 설정된 것. 계속 소통하며 싱크 맞출 것
	--1초간 카메라 가디언에게 이동. 카메라 가디언 팔로우.
	--컨트롤 회복. 전투 시작.
	self:custom_convert_to_boss_monster(boss_plague_doctor_phase_1, self.boss_battle.phase_1.group_name,
			self.boss_battle.zone_name)
end

function local_class:custom_convert_to_boss_monster(fo, enemy_group_name, battle_zone_name)
	-- 몬스터로
	character_util.convert_to_monster(fo, enemy_group_name, battle_zone_name)

	-- 보스가 죽어서 사라지지 않고 바로 이어서 연출을 하기 위함
	character_util.set_death_type(fo, 'none')

	-- 보스가 리더를 발각
	command_util.publish_monster_notice(fo, get_party_leader(), 'battle')

	-- 보스 hp 바가 공격하지 않아도 바로 보이도록
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(fo))

	stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = false
end

function local_class:deactivate_battle(boss)
	character_util.cancel_all_battle_actions(boss, true)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(boss)
end

function local_class:boss_phase_1_dead_scene()

function local_class:talk_demon_engineer_event()

	local leader_pos = self.markers.knight_pos()
	local demon_engineer_pos = self.markers.demon_engineer_pos()

	--가디언(right, smile, idle, jump 1회) notice 이모티콘 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')

	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'notice')

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--가디언 2초간 이미지의 경로를 따라 이동
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
				wp_util.move_async(leader, leader_pos, nil, 2, { last_direction = 'right' })
			end,
			function()
				scene_util.hide_weapon(demon_engineer)
				--비네트 2초간 이미지의 경로를 따라 이동
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(demon_engineer)
				wp_util.move_async(demon_engineer, demon_engineer_pos, nil, 2, { last_direction = 'left' })

function local_class:item_move_and_fade(item, target_pos, duration, target_alpha)
	local start_pos = item.Position
	local item_sprite = item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local item_start_color = item_sprite.TintColor

	-- 챔피언 소드는 그림자를 제외 하고 생성 했음
	coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
		item.Position = cur_pos

		item_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 }) * unity_class.mathf.Lerp(item_start_color.a, target_alpha, progress)
		item_sprite:Rebuild()
	end)

	item_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 }) * target_alpha
	item_sprite:Rebuild()
end

function local_class:set_particle_speed(particle_system, speed)
	for idx = 0, particle_system.Length - 1 do
		particle_system[idx].main.simulationSpeed = speed
	end
end

function local_class:red_alert_routine()
	local tint_duration = 1.0
	local timer = tint_duration
	local is_tint = false
	local siren_tint_key = 'siren_tint'

	self.siren_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = "01_siren_loop_08", loop = true, fade_in_time = 0, type_priority = 'loop' })

	while self.is_red_alert_routine do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= tint_duration then
			timer = 0

			if is_tint then
				is_tint = false

				field:RemoveTint(siren_tint_key, tint_duration)
			else
				is_tint = true

				field:Tint(siren_tint_key, unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 0.8 }), tint_duration)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if not self.is_red_alert_routine and is_tint then
		field:RemoveTint(self.siren_tint_key, tint_duration)
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:custom_convert_to_boss_monster(fo, enemy_group_name, battle_zone_name)

function local_class:deactivate_battle()
	local boss = self.get_kaden()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	character_util.cancel_all_battle_actions(boss, true)
	character_util.cancel_all_battle_actions(leader, true)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(boss)

	boss.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'idle'
	boss.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'walk'
	boss.CustomRunAnimationName = 'run'

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = leader
	heal_info.target = leader
	heal_info.heal = leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.skipEffect = true

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
end

function local_class:boss_dw_scene_camera_tracking(fo)
	local stage_camera_pivot_transform = stage_camera.Transform.parent
	local boss_dw_camera_pivot_transform = fo.transform:Find('Camera_pivot')
	local boss_dw_camera_transform = boss_dw_camera_pivot_transform.transform:Find('camera')
	local boss_dw_camera = boss_dw_camera_transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
	local boss_dw_camera_shaker = boss_dw_camera_transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.ObjectShaker))
	local boss_dw_camera_size
	local is_camera_shake = false

	while not self.is_boss_dw_scene_anim_end do
		stage_camera_pivot_transform.position = boss_dw_camera_pivot_transform.position
		stage_camera_pivot_transform.rotation = boss_dw_camera_transform.rotation

		if not is_camera_shake and boss_dw_camera_shaker.enabled then
			is_camera_shake = true
			camera_util.shake(boss_dw_camera_shaker.ShakeMagnitude, boss_dw_camera_shaker.ShakeDuration)
		elseif is_camera_shake and not boss_dw_camera_shaker.enabled then
			is_camera_shake = false
			camera_util.cancel_shake()
		end

		boss_dw_camera_size = boss_dw_camera.orthographicSize
		camera_util.resize_to(boss_dw_camera_size, 0)

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:item_move_rotate(item, target_pos, duration, rotation_num)
	local start_pos = item.Position

	coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
		local cur_rotation = progress * 360 * rotation_num

		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.back)

		item.Position = start_pos + ((target_pos - start_pos) * progress * 2)
	end)

	item:ConsumeComplete()
end

function local_class:princess_scene()
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	local pivot_pos = self.get_princess_pos()
	local knight_pos = pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, -1.5)

	--공주에게 인터랙트하면 이벤트 진행.
	--
	--1초에 걸쳐 위 상태로 정렬
	do
		local move_key = 'align_party_member'
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight,
				knight_pos,
				nil,
				1,
				self, move_key,
				{ last_direction = 'up' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
	end

	--가디언 선택지
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'lw_main_s33_choose_1_1', 'mercy' },
		{ 'lw_main_s33_choose_1_2', 'forced' },
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--모시러 왔어요, 공주님!(초록)
		--가디언 up, success 3회
		local anim_name = 'success'
		local anim_count = 3
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(knight,
				anim_name)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'up', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = anim_name })
		for i = 1, anim_count do
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
			wait_for_sec(anim_duration)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
	else
		--집에 갈 시간이예요.(노랑)

		--가디언 up, release 3회
		local anim_name = 'release'
		local anim_count = 3
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(knight,
				anim_name)

		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'up', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = anim_name, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

		wait_for_sec(anim_duration * anim_count)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
	end

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 공주에게로 이동.

	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')

		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'bomb_idle')
		character_util.normal_jump_async(knight, '01_player_jump_01')

		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'sleep_deep')
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'cast')

		--가디언 left, tired, unique/seat_hold_cup 1초

		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'unique/seat_hold_cup', upper = true })

		--가디언 선택지

		choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'lw_main_s33_choose_7', 'mercy' }
		})

		--가디언 up, release 3회

		local anim_count = 3
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(knight,

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	--공주(down, cry, cast, shake 0.3초) : $name(이)랑 같이…
	--대사 끝나도 애니메이션, 이모션 유지.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(princess, 0.05, 0.3)
	scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, 'cast')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
			'down', nil, { name = 'cry', keep = true },
			'lw_main_s33_35_2')

	--가디언 선택지
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--언제나 당신의 기사로 함께 할게요, 공주님!(초록)

		{ 'lw_main_s33_choose_8_1', 'mercy' },
		{ 'lw_main_s33_choose_8_2', 'intellect' },
	})

	--region 가디언 up, push로 2초간 다가가 공주와 0.5 거리까지 이동. 공주 안는 연출 진행.

	--카메라 포커스도 기사 이동 시작과 동시에 2초간 공주에게로 이동한다.
	camera_util.move_to_target(princess, 2)

	--카메라 사이즈도 기사 이동 시작과 동시에 2초간 사이즈 2.8로 줌인.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.8, 2)

	--가디언 up, push, 재생속도 0.1배, z축으로 0.5초간 10도 기울인다.
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'up', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'walk' })
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'push', upper = true, scale = 0.1 })

	--2초간 다가가 공주와 0.5 거리까지 이동
	wp_util.move_async(knight, princess.Position + vector(-0.2, 0, -0.2), nil, 2)

	--공주 안기는 순간 cry2, idle로 변경.
	--플레이어 공주 안아줄 때	02_costume_equip_02
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_costume_equip_02')
	character_util.remove_anim(knight)

	--기사 목표 x 좌표도 공주 좌표 기준 -0.15 ~ -0.2 정도로.
	character_util.spine_rotate(princess, -5, 0.5)
	--공주는 z축으로 0.5초간 -5도 정도 기울인다.
	character_util.spine_rotate(knight, 5, 0.5)
	--endregion

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--공주(sad, shake 0.3초) : … 나도…
	scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, 'cast')
	character_util.shake(princess, 0.05, 0.3)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
			'down', nil, { name = 'cry', keep = true },
			'lw_main_s33_36')

	--공주(cry, shake 지속) : 나도… $name이랑…
	character_util.shake(princess, 0.05, 999)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
			nil, nil, nil,
			'lw_main_s33_37')

	--region 대사 시작과 동시에 공주 힘쓰는 연출 진행

	--공주(cry2, shake 지속) : 나도 $name이랑 계속 같이 있고 싶어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_lw_10')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 6 })
	character_util.shake(princess, 0.05, 999)
	local speech_routine = true
	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
				nil, 'idle', { name = 'cry2', keep = true },
				{ key = 'lw_main_s33_38',
				  skip = false })
		speech_routine = false
	end)

	--카메라 shake 세기 0.15로 시작.
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 999)

	--fx_event_princess_barrier_wings_ready 공주 위치에 재생.
	self.fx_princess.ready = self.fx:princess_barrier_wings_ready():Instantiate(princess.Position,
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, princess.Transform)

	--3.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2.3)

	--(일본어 보이스 여부에 따라 말풍선 삭제 )
	local is_voice_available = music_player_util.is_voice_available()

	if not is_voice_available then
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(princess)
	end

	--fx_event_princess_barrier_wings_ready 이펙트 제거
	if self.fx_princess.ready ~= nil then
		self.fx_princess.ready:Dispose()
		self.fx_princess.ready = nil
	end

	--동시에 fx_event_princess_barrier_wings_start 공주 위치에 재생.
	self.fx_princess.start = self.fx:princess_barrier_wings_start():Instantiate(princess.Position,
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, princess.Transform)

	--화면 검게 0.1초만에 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--fx_event_princess_barrier_wings_loop 이펙트 공주 위치 + (-0.05, 0, -0.1)위치에 재생.
	self.fx_princess.loop = self.fx:princess_barrier_wings_loop():Instantiate(princess.Position + vector(-0.05, 0, -0.1),
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, princess.Transform)

	--한프레임 대기 후
	coroutine.yield()

	--화면 0.3초만에 검게 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.3, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--카메라 쉐이크 세기 0.3으로 지속.
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 999)

	--2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--이후 0.3초만에 화면 하얗게 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_09')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.3, unity_class.color.white, 'ease_in_out_sine')

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	character_util.stop_shake(princess)

	--잔여 이펙트 제거
	for _, effect in pairs(self.fx_princess) do
		if effect ~= nil then
			effect:Dispose()
			effect = nil
		end
	end

	--기사 / 공주 회전값 초기화
	character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_rotate(knight, 0, 0)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight, true)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	self:demon_engineer_scene()
end

function local_class:demon_engineer_scene()
	local pivot_pos = self.get_staff_roll_pos(2)
	local princess_pos = pivot_pos + vector(0, 0.5, -1)
	local knight_start_pos = pivot_pos + vector(0.25, 0.5, -0.25)
	local knight_pos = pivot_pos + vector(1, 0.5, -1)
	local champion_sword_pos = pivot_pos + vector(0, 0.5, -0.25)
	local cam_pos = princess_pos

	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local knight = get_party_leader()

	--처음에는 아무도 없는 상태.
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(princess, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_position(princess, princess_pos)

	--공주 down, sleep_deep, idle
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, 'idle')

	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'push')

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(knight, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_position(knight, knight_start_pos)

	--카메라 포커스는 공주 나타날 위치에.
	camera_util.move_async(cam_pos, 0)

	--2초에 걸쳐서 하얗게 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(2, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	--공주가 down, sleep_deep, idle로 0.5초만에 알파 페이드 인 되며 나타난다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'sleep_deep')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(princess, 1, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--비네트AI : 작은 사용자님의 존재를 재인식했습니다. 다시 만나 반갑습니다, 작은 사용자님.
	self.amb_ship_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_amb_ship_02', volume = 0.8, mix = 8, loop = true
	})
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_engineer', 'lw_main_s33_38_1')

	--공주 down, attack, idle, jump 1회
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, 'idle')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(princess, '01_small_jump_01')

	--공주(스킵 불가능) : $name! $name은…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
			nil, nil, nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_s33_38_2', skip = false })

	--공주 left, attack, idle 1초
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'left', true)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, 'idle')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--공주 right, attack, idle 1초
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'right', true)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, 'idle')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--local knight_champ_pos = pivot_pos + vector(0.5, 0.5, 0)
	--공주 1초만에 챔피언소드 왼쪽으로 이동.
	--카메라 포커스는 공주 이동속도에 맞추어 1초간 챔피언소드로 이동.
	local princess_waypoint = {
		pivot_pos + vector(-0.25, 0.5, -1),
		pivot_pos + vector(-0.25, 0.5, -0.25)
	}
	camera_util.move(champion_sword_pos, 1)
	wp_util.move_async(princess, princess_waypoint, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'right' })


	--공주 right, attack, push로 1초.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, 'push')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--region 기사가 공주 오른쪽에 깜빡거리며 나타난다.
	--기사 나타나기 시작할 때에 공주 right, attack, idle
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, 'push')

	--기사 스파인이 0.5초만에 알파 0.6까지 페이드 인 되었다가
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_champ_sword_06')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(knight, 0.6, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--0.2초 대기후

	--0.3초만에 알파 페이드 아웃으로 사라진다.
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(knight, 0, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--다시 0.3초 대기한 후,
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 0.5초만에 알파 0.6까지 페이드 인 된다.

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	--endregion

	do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
		character_util.remove_anim(princess)
		--기사, 공주 각자 챔피언소드와 1거리만큼 멀어지도록 마주본채로 뒷걸음질
		wp_util.move(princess,
				princess.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
				nil,
				1,
				{ locked_dir = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_async(knight,
				knight.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
				nil,
				1,
				{ locked_dir = 'left' })
		--공주 표정은 attack 유지
	end

	--공주(right, attack, cast) : $name은 아직 이면세계에…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
			nil, 'cast', nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_s33_38_3', skip = true })

	music_player_util.change_sfx_volume(self.amb_ship_sfx, 0.4, 4)
	self.siren_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_siren_loop_08', volume = 0.7, mix = 3, loop = true
	})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.5)
	--동시에 필드를 2초간 붉게 틴트, 다시 2초간 틴트 해제 하는 루틴 시작.

	self.is_red_alert_routine = true
	start_coroutine(self.red_alert_routine, self)

	--공주 right, attack
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'attack')

	--기사 left, attack, idle로 jump 1회
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'idle')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(knight)

	--비네트AI : 균열의 크기가 임계점을 넘어섰습니다. 이대로라면 마계 전체가 모두 저 균열에 삼켜질겁니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bunker_ui_01')
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_engineer', 'lw_main_s33_38_4')

	--공주(right, attack, cast) : $name이(가) 이겼는데도 아직…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
			nil, 'cast', nil,
			{ key = 'lw_main_s33_38_5', skip = true })

	--기사 right로 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right', false)

	--카메라 포커스 1.2초간 오른쪽으로 2칸 이동.
	camera_util.move(champion_sword_pos + vector(2, 0, 0), 1.2)

	--1초만에 검게 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.amb_ship_sfx, 3)
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.siren_sfx, 3)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.is_red_alert_routine = false

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

	self:staff_roll_monster_scene()

	camera_util.move_async(champion_sword_pos, 0)

	self.amb_ship_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_amb_ship_02', volume = 0.7, mix = 6, loop = true
	})
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--공주(right, attack, idle) : $name. 어떻게 해야할 지 알 것 같아.
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
			nil, 'cast', { name = 'attack', keep = true },
			{ key = 'lw_main_s33_39', skip = true })

	--공주(right, sleep_deep, nod 1회) : 내가 할 수 있어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
			nil, { name = 'nod', count = 1 }, { name = 'sleep_deep', keep = true },
			{ key = 'lw_main_s33_40', skip = true })

	--기사 표정 attack
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')

	--공주( right,  tired,  cast) : 나 혼자서는 안되겠지만… $name와(과) 함께라면…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
			nil, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'sleep_deep', keep = true },
			{ key = 'lw_main_s33_41', skip = true })

	--공주(right, attack, bomb_idle) : 내 힘과, 챔피언소드의 힘을 함께 모은다면…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
			nil, { name = 'bomb_idle' }, { name = 'attack', keep = true },
			{ key = 'lw_main_s33_41_1', skip = true })

	--기사 attack, nod 2회
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, 'nod')

	--공주( down, attack, bow_idle) : 가자, $name.
	--대사 시작과 동시에 기사도 down, attack으로 전환.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
			'down', { name = 'bomb_idle' }, { name = 'attack', keep = true },
			{ key = 'lw_main_s33_42', skip = true })

	--가디언 선택지
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'lw_main_s33_choose_9_1', 'mercy' },
		{ 'lw_main_s33_choose_9_2', 'intellect' },
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--캔터베리 가디언, 출격 준비 완료!(초록)
		--가디언 down, sleep_deep, cross_arm 1초
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'sleep_deep')
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'cross_arm')

		wait_for_sec(1)

		--가디언 down, attack, bomb_idle, jump 1회 0.7초 대기
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'bomb_idle')
		character_util.normal_jump_async(knight, '01_jump_01')
		wait_for_sec(0.7)

		character_util.remove_anim(knight)
	else
		--그 말만을 기다리고 있었어요.(노랑)
		--가디언 down, sleep_deep, nod 1회
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'sleep_deep')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, 'nod')
		character_util.remove_emotion(knight)

		--가디언 attack, dagger_idle 1초 대기
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'dagger_idle')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim(knight)
	end

	do
		local move_key = 'champion_move'

		--공주 챔피언소드 꽂힌 곳으로 attack 표정으로 1초동안 이동.
		local knight_end_pos = champion_sword_pos + vector(0.25, 0, 0)
		local princess_end_pos = champion_sword_pos + vector(-0.25, 0, 0)

		local knight_waypoint = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(knight, knight_end_pos, false)

		princess_waypoint = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(princess, princess_end_pos, true)

		--동그라미 친 지점으로 이동.
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess,
				princess_waypoint,
				nil,
				1,
				self, nil,
				{ last_direction = 'right' })

		-- 공주와 같은 길을 따라 이동.
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight,
				knight_waypoint,
				nil,
				1,
				self, move_key,
				{ last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

		--기사도 공주와 동일한 위치에 도착하는 순간, 공주 attack, push로 전환.
		--가디언도 도착하면 attack, push로 전환.
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'push' })
		scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, { name = 'push' })

		--공주 도착하고 0.5초만에 카메라 사이즈 3으로 줌인.
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.5)

		--동시에 화면 1초만에 하얗게 페이드 아웃.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_08')
		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.amb_ship_sfx, 1)
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
		camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	end

	knight.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	princess.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	--기사 속도 원복
	--self:set_slow_run_speed(false)
	self:set_slow_speed(false)

	--챔피언소드 없애줌
	if self.champion_sword ~= nil then
		self.champion_sword:ConsumeComplete()
		self.champion_sword = nil
	end

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(knight, 1, 0)

	if self.dynamic_demon_world_npc_list ~= nil then
		self.controller:dispose_dynamic_npc(self.dynamic_demon_world_npc_list)
		self.dynamic_demon_world_npc_list = nil
	end

	--엔딩 크레딧 씬 시작(쿠키, 차회 예고 포함)
	self.controller:staff_roll_scene(true)
end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.get_staff_roll_npc(1, 1))

	--endregion

	--region 균열 세팅
	local crack_pos = {
		pivot_pos + vector(-12, 1, 1),
		pivot_pos + vector(3, 1, -1),
		pivot_pos + vector(6, 1, 1),
	}

	if self.fx_crack_table ~= nil then
		self.fx_crack_table = {}
	end

	for idx = 1, #crack_pos do
		local fx_crack = self.fx:crack():Instantiate(crack_pos[idx])

		fx_crack.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0, 0.5)

		table.insert(self.fx_crack_table, fx_crack)
	end

	--endregion

	--region 카메라 세팅

	local cam_pos_table = {
		pivot_pos + vector(-11, 0, 0),
		pivot_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0),
	}

	camera_util.move_async(cam_pos_table[1], 0)

	--endregion

	--region 카메라 이동 + 캐릭터 연출
	do
		--region 1번 괴물은 앞에 있는 1번 경찰이후 attack 1회 하여 경찰 뒤로 3칸 밀려난다.
		local npc_attack_routine = true
		start_coroutine(function()
			local monster = self.get_staff_roll_monster(1, 1)
			local anim_name = 'attack'
			local anim_count = 1
			local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(monster,
					anim_name)

			scene_util.set_direction(monster, 'left', false)
			scene_util.set_anim(monster, self, { name = anim_name, count = 1 })

			wait_for_sec(anim_duration * anim_count * 0.6)

			--맞을 때 fx_hit, fx_lasthit, damagesquish, redpulse
			local npc = self.get_staff_roll_npc(1, 1)
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = 'dead1', loop = false })
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'damaged')
			self:damaged_npc(npc, true, false)
			wp_util.move_async(npc,
					npc.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0),
					4,
					nil,
					{ locked_dir = 'right' })

		end)
		--endregion

		--region 2번 괴물과 2번 경찰은 attack, push로 힘싸움 하고 있는 상태.
		--5, 6 번도 2번과 동일한 루틴 반복
		local npc_push_routine = true
		start_coroutine(function()

			local push_npc_info = {
				{
					npc_up = self.get_staff_roll_monster(1, 2),
					npc_down = self.get_staff_roll_npc(1, 2),
					pivot_pos = self.get_staff_roll_npc(1, 2).Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
				},
				{
					npc_up = self.get_staff_roll_npc(1, 5),
					npc_down = self.get_staff_roll_monster(1, 5),
					pivot_pos = self.get_staff_roll_npc(1, 5).Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
				},
				{
					npc_up = self.get_staff_roll_npc(1, 6),
					npc_down = self.get_staff_roll_monster(1, 6),
					pivot_pos = self.get_staff_roll_npc(1, 6).Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
				},
			}

			while npc_push_routine do
				local push_duration = 0.5

				for idx = 1, #push_npc_info do
					local npc_up = push_npc_info[idx].npc_up
					local npc_down = push_npc_info[idx].npc_down
					local push_pivot_pos = push_npc_info[idx].pivot_pos

					--0.5초간 shake하며
					character_util.shake(npc_down, 0.05, 0.5)
					character_util.shake(npc_up, 0.05, 0.5)

					--아래쪽으로 0.5칸 이동.
					wp_util.move(npc_down,
							push_pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5),
							nil,
							push_duration,
							{ locked_dir = 'up' })
					wp_util.move(npc_up,
							push_pivot_pos,
							nil,
							push_duration,
							{ locked_dir = 'down' })
				end

				--이동 대기
				wait_for_sec(push_duration)

				--1초 대기
				wait_for_sec(1)

				--0.5초간 shake 하며
				for idx = 1, #push_npc_info do
					local npc_up = push_npc_info[idx].npc_up
					local npc_down = push_npc_info[idx].npc_down
					local push_pivot_pos = push_npc_info[idx].pivot_pos

					--0.5초간 shake하며
					character_util.shake(npc_down, 0.05, 0.5)
					character_util.shake(npc_up, 0.05, 0.5)

					--위쪽으로 0.5칸 이동.
					wp_util.move(npc_down,
							push_pivot_pos,
							nil,
							push_duration,
							{ locked_dir = 'up' })
					wp_util.move(npc_up,
							push_pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
							nil,
							push_duration,
							{ locked_dir = 'down' })
				end

				--이동 대기
				wait_for_sec(push_duration)

				wait_for_sec(1)

			end

		end)
		--endregion

		--region 4번과 9번 경찰/괴물은 아래 서로 때리기 루틴 반복
		local npc_hit_routine = true
		start_coroutine(function()
			local hit_npc_info = {
				{
					npc_left = self.get_staff_roll_npc(1, 4),
					npc_right = self.get_staff_roll_monster(1, 4),
					pivot_pos = self.get_staff_roll_npc(1, 4).Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
				},
				{
					npc_left = self.get_staff_roll_npc(1, 9),
					npc_right = self.get_staff_roll_monster(1, 9),
					pivot_pos = self.get_staff_roll_npc(1, 9).Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
				},
			}

			local anim_name = 'attack'
			local anim_count = 1
			local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(hit_npc_info[1].npc_left,
					anim_name)

			--밀려나는데 걸리는 시간
			local hit_back_duration = 0.25

			--밀려난 후 복귀하는 데 걸리는 시간
			local come_back_duration = 0.1

			while npc_hit_routine do
				--1) 왼쪽 npc 때리기 시작
				for idx = 1, #hit_npc_info do
					local npc_left = hit_npc_info[idx].npc_left

					--표정은 경찰만 attack
					scene_util.set_direction(npc_left, 'right', false)
					scene_util.set_anim(npc_left, self, { name = anim_name, count = anim_count })
				end

				--때리기 애니메이션 만큼 대기
				wait_for_sec(anim_duration * anim_count * 0.6)

				--2) 오른쪽 npc 맞고 뒤로 밀려남
				for idx = 1, #hit_npc_info do
					local npc_right = hit_npc_info[idx].npc_right
					local hit_pivot_pos = hit_npc_info[idx].pivot_pos

					--맞은 쪽은 fx_hit, damagesquish, redpulse 되며 뒤로 0.5칸 밀려난다.
					self:damaged_npc(npc_right, false, true)
					scene_util.set_anim(npc_right, self, 'damaged')
					wp_util.move(npc_right,
							hit_pivot_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
							nil,
							hit_back_duration,
							{ locked_dir = 'left' })
				end

				--밀려나는 시간 + 1초 만큼 대기
				wait_for_sec(hit_back_duration)

				wait_for_sec(1)

				--3) 원래 자리로 복귀. come_back_duration = 0.5
				for idx = 1, #hit_npc_info do
					local npc_right = hit_npc_info[idx].npc_right
					local hit_pivot_pos = hit_npc_info[idx].pivot_pos

					character_util.remove_anim(npc_right)
					wp_util.move(npc_right,
							hit_pivot_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
							nil,
							come_back_duration,
							{ locked_dir = 'left' })
				end

				wait_for_sec(come_back_duration)

				--4) 오른쪽 npc 때리기 시작
				for idx = 1, #hit_npc_info do
					local npc_right = hit_npc_info[idx].npc_right

					--표정은 경찰만 attack
					scene_util.set_direction(npc_right, 'left', false)
					scene_util.set_anim(npc_right, self, { name = anim_name, count = anim_count })
				end

				--때리기 애니메이션 만큼 대기
				wait_for_sec(anim_duration * anim_count * 0.6)

				--2) 왼쪽 npc 맞고 뒤로 밀려남
				for idx = 1, #hit_npc_info do
					local npc_left = hit_npc_info[idx].npc_left
					local hit_pivot_pos = hit_npc_info[idx].pivot_pos

					--맞은 쪽은 fx_hit, damagesquish, redpulse 되며 뒤로 0.5칸 밀려난다.
					self:damaged_npc(npc_left, false, false)
					scene_util.set_anim(npc_left, self, 'damaged')
					scene_util.set_emotion(npc_left, self, 'damaged')
					wp_util.move(npc_left,
							hit_pivot_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0),
							nil,
							hit_back_duration,
							{ locked_dir = 'right' })
				end

				--밀려나는 시간 + 1초 만큼 대기
				wait_for_sec(hit_back_duration)

				wait_for_sec(1)

				--3) 원래 자리로 복귀. come_back_duration = 0.5
				for idx = 1, #hit_npc_info do
					local npc_left = hit_npc_info[idx].npc_left
					local hit_pivot_pos = hit_npc_info[idx].pivot_pos

					character_util.remove_anim(npc_left)
					scene_util.set_emotion(npc_left, self, 'attack')
					wp_util.move(npc_left,
							hit_pivot_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
							nil,
							come_back_duration,
							{ locked_dir = 'right' })
				end

				wait_for_sec(come_back_duration)
			end
		end)
		--endregion

		--region 8번 괴물은 8번 경찰의 앞까지 속도 2로 이동.
		local monster_attack_routine = true
		start_coroutine(function()
			wait_for_sec(4)

			local monster = self.get_staff_roll_monster(1, 8)
			local npc = self.get_staff_roll_npc(1, 8)

			wp_util.move_async(monster, npc.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 2)
			local anim_name = 'attack'
			local anim_count = 1
			local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(monster,
					anim_name)

			scene_util.set_direction(monster, 'left', false)
			scene_util.set_anim(monster, self, { name = anim_name, count = 1 })

			wait_for_sec(anim_duration * anim_count * 0.6)

			--맞을 때 fx_hit, fx_lasthit, damagesquish, redpulse
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'damaged')
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'damaged')
			self:damaged_npc(npc, true, false)
			wp_util.move_async(npc,
					npc.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0),
					4,
					nil,
					{ locked_dir = 'right' })

			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'attack')
			character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			--이후 attack 1회 하여 경찰 뒤로 3칸 밀려난다.

			--맞을 때 fx_hit, fx_lasthit, damagesquish, redpulse
		end)

		--endregion

		--페이드 인과 함께 1초간 사이즈 1에서 1.5까지 커진다.
		start_coroutine(function()
			local time_passed = 0
			local duration = 2
			local crack_scale_original = self.fx_crack_table[1].transform.localScale
			while time_passed < duration do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				local progress = time_passed / duration

				for _, effect in pairs(self.fx_crack_table) do
					effect.transform.localScale = crack_scale_original * (1 + 0.5 * progress)
				end

				coroutine.yield(nil)

			end
		end)

		--카메라 검은색 페이드 인 1초간.
		self.war_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_war_loop_02', mix = 1, loop = true
		})
		screen_util.fade_in_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		camera_util.move(cam_pos_table[2], 6)

		--카메라 포커스 이동 시작하고 4.9초 뒤부터,
		wait_for_sec(4.9)

		--카메라 검은색 페이드 아웃 1초간.
		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.war_sfx, 1)
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')


		--관련 루틴 모두 종료
		npc_attack_routine = false
		npc_hit_routine = false
		npc_push_routine = false
		monster_attack_routine = false

	end

	--endregion
	--camera_util.move_to_target_async(self.get_princess(), 0)

	--여기서 비활성화 하기에는, 루틴 종료가 보장되지 않음
	--self:disable_npc_by_list(npc_info_list)

	for _, effect in pairs(self.fx_crack_table) do
		if effect ~= nil then
			effect:Dispose()
			effect = nil
		end
	end
end


function local_class:damaged_npc(damaged_target, use_lasthit, is_monster)
	is_monster = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_monster, false)

	self.fx:hit():Instantiate(damaged_target.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(damaged_target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(damaged_target,
			CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)

	if is_monster then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_heavy_slash_02', parent = damaged_target })
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', parent = damaged_target })

function local_class:set_npc_by_list(npc_info_list)
	for name, info_list in pairs(npc_info_list) do
		local npc = nil
		local pos = info_list.pos
		local direction = info_list.direction
		local anim = info_list.anim
		local emotion = info_list.emotion
		local hide_weapon = info_list.hide_weapon

		if name == 'china_hero' then
			npc = user_util.get_china_hero_character('china_hero_boy', 'china_hero_girl')
		elseif name == 'knight' then
			npc = user_util.get_knight_character('knight_female', 'knight_male')
		else
			npc = get_character(name)
		end

		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')

		if pos ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
		end

		if direction ~= nil then
			character_util.set_direction(npc, direction)
		end

		if anim ~= nil then
			if type_util.is_table(anim) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, anim)
			else
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = anim, sfx_name = false, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if emotion ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, emotion)
		end

		if hide_weapon ~= nil then
			character_util.hide_weapon(npc, hide_weapon)
		end
	end

function local_class:disable_npc_by_list(npc_info_list)
	for name, info_list in pairs(npc_info_list) do
		local npc = nil

		if name == 'china_hero' then
			npc = user_util.get_china_hero_character('china_hero_boy', 'china_hero_girl')
		elseif name == 'knight' then
			npc = user_util.get_knight_character('knight_female', 'knight_male')
		else
			npc = get_character(name)
		end

		character_util.set_position(npc, vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
	end
end


function local_class:red_alert_routine()
	local tint_duration = 1.0
	local timer = tint_duration
	local is_tint = false
	local siren_tint_key = 'siren_tint'

	while self.is_red_alert_routine do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= tint_duration then
			timer = 0

			if is_tint then
				is_tint = false

				field:RemoveTint(siren_tint_key, tint_duration)
			else
				is_tint = true

				field:Tint(siren_tint_key, unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 0.8 }), tint_duration)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if not self.is_red_alert_routine and is_tint then
		field:RemoveTint(self.siren_tint_key, tint_duration)
	end
end

end

function local_class:add_camera_param(params, delay, value, duration)
	local delay_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(delay, 0)
	local value_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(value, nil)
	local duration_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 0)

	table.insert(params, { delay = delay_val, value = value_val, duration = duration_val })
end

function local_class:camera_move_by_param(data)
	-- 카메라 위치
	local pos = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'pos', nil)

	-- 연출 시간
	local duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'duration', 0)

	-- 카메라 각도
	local angle = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'angle', nil)

	if pos ~= nil then
		start_coroutine(self.control_camera_pos, self, pos)
	end

	if angle ~= nil then
		start_coroutine(self.control_camera_angle, self, angle)
	end

	wait_for_sec(duration)
end

-- 카메라 회전 처리
function local_class:control_camera_angle(angle)
	for i = 1, #angle do
		local delay = lua_helper.get_value(angle[i], 'delay', 0)
		local value = lua_helper.get_value(
				angle[i], 'value', stage_camera.Transform.parent.localRotation.eulerAngles)
		local duration = lua_helper.get_value(angle[i], 'duration', 0)

		wait_for_sec(delay)

		local timer = 0
		local start_value = stage_camera.Transform.parent.localRotation.eulerAngles

		while timer < duration do
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local cur_value = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_value, value, timer / duration)
			stage_camera.Transform.parent.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(cur_value)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:control_camera_pos(pos)
	for i = 1, #pos do
		local delay = lua_helper.get_value(pos[i], 'delay', 0)
		local value = lua_helper.get_value(pos[i], 'value', 0)
		local duration = lua_helper.get_value(pos[i], 'duration', 0)

		wait_for_sec(delay)

		camera_util.move_async(value, duration)
	end
end

function local_class:move_bg_y_pos(move_dist_y, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local bg = self.gimmicks.robot_vs_labose_bg_set()
	local start_pos = bg.Position
	local end_pos = bg.Position + vector(0, move_dist_y, 0)
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local cur_pos = start_pos * (1 - progress) + end_pos * progress

		bg.Position = cur_pos

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

--region SavingAllyHelper
local saving_npc_helper = newclass('SavingAllyHelper')

function saving_npc_helper:init()
	self.interacting_gimmick = get_field_object('ally_interacting')

	self.alive_ally_npc_list = {}

	self.started_event_idx = police_event_type.event_1
end

function saving_npc_helper:start()
end

function saving_npc_helper:set_npc_interactable(npc)
	npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	self.interacting_gimmick.Position = npc.Position
	self.interacting_gimmick.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
end

function saving_npc_helper:remove_npc_interactable(npc)
	self.interacting_gimmick.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

	npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
end

function saving_npc_helper:change_started_event_index(event_index)
	self.started_event_idx = event_index
end

function saving_npc_helper:get_started_event_index()
	return self.started_event_idx
end

function saving_npc_helper:save_alive_npc_info(npcs)
	if type_util.is_array(npcs) then
		for _, npc in ipairs(npcs) do
			local num = string.match(npc.Name, "%d+$")
			num = tonumber(num)

			self.alive_ally_npc_list[num] = npc
		end
	else
		local num = string.match(npcs.Name, "%d+$")
		num = tonumber(num)

		self.alive_ally_npc_list[num] = npcs
	end
end

function saving_npc_helper:compare_save_npc_list(compare_npc_list)
	local compare_result_list = {}

	for _, npc in ipairs(compare_npc_list) do
		local num = string.match(npc.Name, "%d+$")
		num = tonumber(num)

		local save_npc = self.alive_ally_npc_list[num]

		if save_npc ~= nil then
			table.insert(compare_result_list, save_npc)
		end
	end

	return compare_result_list
end

function saving_npc_helper:get_save_npc_list()
	return self.alive_ally_npc_list
end

function saving_npc_helper:is_ally_alive_by_idx(idx)
	if self.alive_ally_npc_list ~= nil then
		local compare_police_name = 's7_police_' .. idx

		for _, police in pairs(self.alive_ally_npc_list) do
			if police.Name == compare_police_name then
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function saving_npc_helper:dispose()
	self.interacting_gimmick = nil
	self.alive_ally_npc_list = nil
end

--endregion

	return nil

function police_event_interface:subscribe_events()
end

function police_event_interface:unsubscribe_events()
end

function police_event_interface:end_events()
end

-- [ 시스템 ] : 특정 마커 이름 포맷+ 경찰 캐릭터 이름 포맷팅해서 필드에 세팅
-- 예시: 캐릭터 이름이 's7_police_1'이고, 마커 이름이 's7_align_s7_police_1' 일 경우.
--      align_marker_name에 's7_align_%s'을 넘기면 됨
function police_event_interface:align_polices(polices, align_marker_name)
	for i = 1, #polices do
		local police = polices[i]
		local marker_name = string.format(align_marker_name, police.Name)
		character_util.set_position(police, field_util.get_marker_pos(marker_name))
		character_util.set_direction(police, field_util.get_marker_dir(marker_name))
	end
end

-- [ 시스템 ] : 현재까지 구조하여 파티에 합류한 경찰 NPC들을 마커 이름에 맞춰서 자동 정렬
function police_event_interface:align_alive_polices(align_marker_name)

	self:align_polices(polices, align_marker_name)
end

function police_event_interface:convert_polices_to_following_npc(polices)
	if not type_util.is_table(polices) then return end

	for _, police in pairs(polices) do
		self:convert_police_to_following_npc(police)
		scene_util.show_weapon(police)
		character_util.convert_to_following_npc(police, user_party, false)
	end
end

function police_event_interface:convert_police_to_following_npc(police)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(police)
	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(police, user_party, false)
end

	self.main_quest_controller:deactive_police_event(event)
end

function police_event_interface:dispose()
	self.saving_npc_helper = nil
	self.main_quest_controller = nil
end

	if battle_group_name == 's7_battle_1' then
		self.is_battle_ended = true

		self.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.scene_end_event, self)
	end
end

function police_event_1:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local is_this_event_battle_zone = type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.battle_zone_name)
	local is_able_to_start_event = is_this_event_battle_zone and not self.is_battle_started

	if is_able_to_start_event then
		start_coroutine(self.start_event, self)
	end
end

function police_event_1:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	local event_name = e:GetParamAt(0)

	if event_name == 'interacting' then
		if not self.is_battle_ended then
			quest_marker_util.remove('main_quest')

			start_coroutine(self.convert_police_to_ally, self)
		else
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.police)
		end
	end
end

function police_event_1:is_police_saved()
	return true
end

function police_event_1:get_polices()
	return self.police
end

function police_event_1:start_event()
	self.is_battle_started = true

	self.main_quest_controller.saving_npc_helper:set_npc_interactable(self.police)

	-- shout 말풍선, 스킵 불가능 : 살려줘어어!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(self.police, 's7_lw_main_0', false)
end

function police_event_1:convert_police_to_ally()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.police)
	character_util.mario_jump_async(self.police, self.police.Direction)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	self.saving_npc_helper:remove_npc_interactable(self.police)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.police)
	character_util.convert_to_non_party_player(self.police)

	if not self.is_battle_ended then
		local battle = stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty()
		message_system:SendSync(self.police, CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent.Create(battle))
	end
end

--region 경찰 이벤트 2: 자석 + 라보스 안개 퍼즐
local police_event_2 = newclass('PoliceEvent2', police_event_interface)

function police_event_2:init(main_quest_controller)
	self.super:init(main_quest_controller)

	self.event_zone_name = 's7_puzzle_area'

	self.polices = main_quest_controller.characters.polices_by_idx(2, 3)

	self.door_switch = main_quest_controller.gimmicks.puzzle_door_switch()
	self.door = main_quest_controller.gimmicks.puzzle_door()

	self.are_polices_alive = true

	self.are_police_state = {
		none = 1,
		start_directing = 2,
		end_directing = 3,
	}
	self.cur_are_police_state = self.are_police_state.none

	self.is_puzzle_solved = false
	self.has_player_skipped_puzzle = false
end

function police_event_2:start()
	for i = 1, #self.polices do
		local police = self.polices[i]
		character_util.set_direction(police, 'up')
		character_util.set_active_state(police, 'enabled')
		character_util.spine_rotate(police, 0, 0)
	end

	self.main_quest_controller:prepare_for_event_3()

	self:place_virtus_fx()
end

function police_event_2:is_police_saved()
	return self.are_polices_alive
end

function police_event_2:get_polices()
	return self.polices
end

function police_event_2:subscribe_events()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_event')
end

function police_event_2:unsubscribe_events()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
end

function police_event_2:end_events()
	quest_marker_util.remove('main_quest')

	self.is_passed_event = true
end

function police_event_2:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local is_able_to_play_event = self.cur_are_police_state == self.are_police_state.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.event_zone_name)

	if is_able_to_play_event then
		start_coroutine(self.start_polices_asking_for_help, self)
	end
end

function police_event_2:on_switch_event(e)
	local puzzle_door_switch = self.main_quest_controller.gimmicks.puzzle_door_switch()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(puzzle_door_switch, e.SwitchObject) then
		if not self.is_puzzle_solved and self.are_polices_alive then
			self.is_puzzle_solved = true

			self.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.solved_puzzle_area, self)
		end
	end
end

function police_event_2:start_polices_asking_for_help()
	local p2 = self.polices[1]
	local p3 = self.polices[2]

	self.cur_are_police_state = self.are_police_state.start_directing

	character_util.shake(p2, 0.03, 999999999)
	character_util.shake(p3, 0.03, 999999999)

	-- 2번 경찰(up, idle, shake 지속) : 이… 이대로면… 저 안개에…
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01', parent = p2 })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(p2, self, 'up', nil, nil,
			{ key = 's7_lw_main_12', skip = false })

	-- 3번 경찰(left, scared, release 3회, shake 지속) : 다… 당장 도망가야 해!!
	start_coroutine(function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', parent = p3 })

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', parent = p3 })

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', parent = p3 })
	end)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(p3, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01', count = 3 },
			{ name = 'scared', keep = true },
			{ key = 's7_lw_main_13', skip = false })

	-- 2번 경찰(down, scared, idle, jump 1회) : 퇴… 퇴로도 막혔어…
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jump_01', parent = p2 })
	character_util.normal_jump(p2, false)
	-- 3번 경찰도 down으로 전환.
	character_util.set_direction(p2, 'down')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(p2, self, 'down', nil,
			{ name = 'scared', keep = true }, { key = 's7_lw_main_14', skip = false })

	-- 2, 3번 경찰 둘 다 문 앞으로 속도 4로 이동한다.
	character_util.move_group_distance_async({ p2, p3 }, vector(0, 0, -4), nil, 4, true, true)

	-- scared 표정은 계속 유지
	-- 3번 경찰(scared, success, shake 지속) : 살려줘!! 제발 살려줘!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_victim_scream_02', parent = p3 })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(p3, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'success', sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', keep = true },
			nil, { key = 's7_lw_main_15', skip = false })

	-- 대사 끝난 이후로 2번 경찰도 success 애니메이션 실행.
	scene_util.set_anim(p2, self, { name = 'success', sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', keep = true })

	self.cur_are_police_state = self.are_police_state.end_directing

	-- 이후 scared, success, shake 지속하고 있는 상태.
	self:fill_virus_field_progressively()
end

function police_event_2:solved_puzzle_area()
	self.door_switch.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullFieldObjectBehaviour()

	local police_1 = self.main_quest_controller.characters.police_by_idx(1)
	local police_2 = self.polices[1]
	local police_3 = self.polices[2]
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local eng = self.main_quest_controller.characters.demon_engineer()
	local queen = self.main_quest_controller.characters.demon_queen()

	local align_dur = 1
	local align_data = { last_direction = 'left' }
	-- 1 초간 기사 일행 위 그림처럼 정렬.(정렬 끝나면 전원 left로)
	-- 동시에 카메라 포커스는 1초간 문으로 이동.

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	wp_util.move(police_1, { field_util.get_marker_pos('s7_puzzle_p1_align') }, nil, align_dur, align_data)
	wp_util.move(eng, { field_util.get_marker_pos('s7_puzzle_engineer_align') }, nil, align_dur, align_data)
	wp_util.move(queen, { field_util.get_marker_pos('s7_puzzle_queen_align') }, nil, align_dur, align_data)

function police_event_2:fill_virus_field_progressively()
	local fx = self.main_quest_controller.fx
	local virus_pool = fx.virus_fog_strong()
	local initial_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s7_puzzle_area_labose_effect_start')

	for i = 3, 8 do
		fx:cache(virus_pool:Instantiate(initial_pos + vector(0, 0, 1 - i)))
		fx:cache(virus_pool:Instantiate(initial_pos + vector(1, 0, 1 - i)))

		if i < 8 then
			self:wait_for_sec_to_stop(10)
		end
	end

	if not self.is_puzzle_solved then
		self.are_polices_alive = false

		self.door_switch.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullFieldObjectBehaviour()
		self.door_switch.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NullFieldObjectController.Instance

		self.door.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullFieldObjectBehaviour()
		self.door.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NullFieldObjectController.Instance

		local police_2 = self.polices[1]
		local police_3 = self.polices[2]

		character_util.stop_shake(police_2)
		character_util.stop_shake(police_3)

		character_util.set_direction(police_2, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(police_3, 'left')

		scene_util.set_group_anim(self.polices, self, { name = 'dead', loop = false })

		character_util.add_color(police_2, police_2.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 1)
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(police_2, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

		character_util.add_color(police_3, police_3.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 1)
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(police_3, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.main_quest_controller.quest_progress, 's7_second_rescue_event', 0)
	end
end

function police_event_2:wait_for_sec_to_stop(sec)
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < sec do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 모든 시간 기다리지 않고 탈출
		if self.main_quest_controller.skip_event_2 then
			return false
		end

		if self.loop_escape then
			return false
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 기다림 완료
	return true
end

function police_event_2:place_virtus_fx()
	local virus_pool = self.main_quest_controller.fx.virus_fog_strong()
	local initial_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s7_puzzle_area_labose_effect_start')

	for i = 1, 2 do
		self.main_quest_controller.fx:cache(virus_pool:Instantiate(initial_pos + vector(0, 0, 1 - i)))
		self.main_quest_controller.fx:cache(virus_pool:Instantiate(initial_pos + vector(1, 0, 1 - i)))
	end
end

function police_event_2:dispose()
	self.polices = nil
	self.door_switch = nil
	self.door = nil

	self.cur_are_police_state = self.are_police_state.end_directing
	self.loop_escape = true
end

--region 경찰 이벤트 3: 전투중인 마계 경찰 구해주기
local police_event_3 = newclass('PoliceEvent3', police_event_interface)

function police_event_3:init(main_quest_controller)
	self.super:init(main_quest_controller)
	self.polices = main_quest_controller.characters.polices_by_idx(4, 5)

	self.labose_npcs = {
		battle_2_orge			= function(idx) return get_character('s7_battle_2_ogre_' .. idx) end,
	}

	self.gimmicks = {
		battle_2_wall			= function() return get_field_object('s7_battle_2_wall') end,
	}

	self.shoot_helpers = nil

	self.second_battle_convert_mob_orge_count = 1

	self.is_keep_shooting_routine = false
end

function police_event_3:start()
	if not self.main_quest_controller.going_in_stage then
		self:set_shoot_helper()

		local wall_in_battle_2 = self.gimmicks.battle_2_wall()
		wall_in_battle_2.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible

		start_coroutine(self.play_pre_fight_rifle_shooting_event, self, self.labose_npcs.battle_2_orge(1))

		start_coroutine(self.refresh_quest_marker, self)
	end

	for i = 1, #self.polices do
		character_util.set_active_state(self.polices[i], 'enabled')
	end
end

function police_event_3:is_police_saved()
	return true
end

function police_event_3:subscribe_events()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent), 'on_battle_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
end

function police_event_3:unsubscribe_events()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
end

function police_event_3:end_events()
	self.is_passed_event = true
	self.is_keep_shooting_routine = false
end

function police_event_3:on_battle_start_event(e)
	if e ~= nil and e.StartedBattle ~= nil then
		self.main_quest_controller.current_started_battle = e.StartedBattle
	end
end

function police_event_3:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local second_battle_zone_name = self.main_quest_controller.event_zone_names.second_battle_zone
	local is_able_to_play_event = type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, second_battle_zone_name)

	if is_able_to_play_event then
		self.main_quest_controller:convert_following_npcs_to_ally(self.saving_npc_helper:get_save_npc_list())

		start_coroutine(self.convert_labose_npc_to_monster, self)

		quest_marker_util.remove('main_quest')
	end
end

function police_event_3:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	local battle_group_name = e.BattleGroupName

	if battle_group_name == 's7_battle_2' then
		self.main_quest_controller.current_started_battle = nil

		start_coroutine(self.fix_event_2_state, self)

		self.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.scene_end_event, self)
	end
end

function police_event_3:fix_event_2_state()
	local second_rescue_event_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 's7_second_rescue_event')

	if second_rescue_event_state < 0 then
		self.main_quest_controller.skip_event_2 = true
	end
end

function police_event_3:refresh_quest_marker()
	quest_marker_util.remove('main_quest')

	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo('main_quest',
			self.main_quest_controller.quest_id, true, self.polices[1])
end

function police_event_3:convert_labose_npc_to_monster()
	local wall_in_battle_2 = self.gimmicks.battle_2_wall()
	wall_in_battle_2.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

	self.is_keep_shooting_routine = false

	for i = 1, self.second_battle_convert_mob_orge_count do
		local npc = self.labose_npcs.battle_2_orge(i)

		character_util.convert_to_monster(npc, 's7_battle_2')
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(npc, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
	end
end

function police_event_3:set_shoot_helper()
	local rifle_polices = {}
	for i = 1, #self.polices-1 do
		table.insert(rifle_polices, self.polices[i])
	end

	-- 피격 대상에 대미지 표시가 나오도록
	local shoot_handler = {
		on_hit = function(_, _, hit_info, _)
			if hit_info.target then
				if hit_info.target.SpineController then
					unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(hit_info.position)
					--CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(0, unity_class.color.gray, user_party.Leader.Position)

					character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(hit_info.target)
					character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(hit_info.target)
				end
			end
		end
	}

	-- ShootHelper
	self.shoot_helpers = {}
	for _, v in pairs(rifle_polices) do
		local pattern_info = { columns = 1 }
		local proj_data = game_data_service.GetData('ProjectileData')
		local proj_spec = proj_data:GetSpec('rifle_bullet'):Clone()
		local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(shoot_handler, v)
		local shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional, ps,
				proj_spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachBullet)
		table.insert(self.shoot_helpers, shoot_helper)
	end
end

function police_event_3:play_pre_fight_rifle_shooting_event(target)
	local shooter_idx = 1
	for i = 1, #self.polices do
		character_util.set_active_state(self.polices[i], 'enabled')

		scene_util.set_emotion(self.polices[i], self, 'attack')

		if shooter_idx == i then
			scene_util.set_anim(self.polices[i], self, 'rifle_shoot')
		end

		character_util.set_position(self.polices[i], field_util.get_marker_pos('s7_police_' .. (3 + i) .. '_init'))

		scene_util.set_direction(self.polices[i], 'up', false)

		self.polices[i].SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.is_keep_shooting_routine = true

	local shooter_target_pos = target.Position
	--+ vector(0.5, 0, -0.25)

	local muzzle_start_pos_adj = vector(-0.2, 0, 0.1)
	local delay = 0.03

	local num_helpers = #self.polices
	local num_sounds = num_helpers - 1
	local sfx_info = { sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_01', volume = 0.3, loop = false, parent = self.polices[1] }

	while self.is_keep_shooting_routine do
		for k, v in pairs(self.shoot_helpers) do
			local dir_vec_diff = unity_class.vector3.up
			local shooter_bound_center = self.polices[k].Bounds.center
			local target_direction = (shooter_target_pos - shooter_bound_center + dir_vec_diff).normalized
			local muzzle_pos = self.polices[k].Bounds.center + muzzle_start_pos_adj

			if k <= num_sounds then
				music_player_util.play_sfx(sfx_info)
			end

			if v ~= nil then
				v:ShootDirectionAtPosition(muzzle_pos, target_direction)
			end

			wait_for_sec(delay * 2)
		end

		wait_for_sec(delay)
	end

	-- 이미 혀당 이벤트를 지나간 상태이면 경찰 후처리 하지 않음(이 경우는 정상 루트로는 발생하지 않음, 디버깅 용)
	if self.is_passed_event then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.polices do

function police_event_3:convert_police_to_ally()
	for i = 1, #self.polices do
