--region 경찰 이벤트 4: 라보스 크리쳐와 고립된 마계 경찰에 총알 구해다 주기
local police_event_4 = newclass('PoliceEvent4', police_event_interface)

function police_event_4:init(main_quest_controller)
	self.super:init(main_quest_controller)
	self.polices = main_quest_controller.characters.polices_by_idx(6)

	self.labose_npcs = {
		event_4			= function(idx) return get_character('s7_event_4_labose_' .. idx) end,
	}

	self.gimmicks = {
		event_area_wall			= function(idx) return get_field_object('s7_event_4_interact_obj_' .. idx) end,
		bullet = function() return get_field_object('s7_bullet_item') end
	}

	self.fx = {
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,

		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,

		queen_attack = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_m_demonceo_claw')
		end,

		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if type_util.is_function(load_func) and
						name ~= 'load_all' and
						name ~= 'cache' and
						name ~= 'dispose' then

					load_func()
				end
			end
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			for i = 1, #this.cached_inst do
				this.cached_inst[i]:Dispose()
				this.cached_inst[i] = nil
			end

			this.cached_inst = nil
		end
	}

	-- 6번 경찰, 라보스와 대치 중 체크 플래그
	self.confrontation_loop = false

	-- 총알 아이템 겟
	self.get_bullet_item = false

	-- 현재 이벤트의 시작 씬 존 엔터 한번만 발동 체크
	self.play_pre_scene_once = false

	self.play_main_scene_once = false

	self.bullet_item = nil
	self.bullet_item_id = 21143

	self.shoot_helpers = nil

	self.is_keep_shooting_routine = false
end

function police_event_4:start()
	self.fx:load_all()

	self:pre_setting()
end

function police_event_4:is_police_saved()
	return true
end

function police_event_4:subscribe_events()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function police_event_4:unsubscribe_events()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function police_event_4:end_events()
	if self.main_quest_controller.rescue_event_state ~= nil and self.main_quest_controller.rescue_event_state[self.main_quest_controller.rescue_event.police_event_4] > 0 then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.labose_npcs.event_4(1), 'disabled')

		local lost_bullet = self.gimmicks.bullet()

		if lost_bullet ~= nil then
			lost_bullet.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
	end

	if self.bullet_item then
		self.bullet_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.bullet_item = nil
	end

	self.is_passed_event = true
end

function police_event_4:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gimmicks.bullet()) then
		self.sp_manager:try_start_scene(self.bullet_get_event, self)

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gimmicks.event_area_wall(1)) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gimmicks.event_area_wall(2)) then

		self.sp_manager:try_start_scene(self.scene_end_event, self)

		return true
	end
end

function police_event_4:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local fourth_event_zone_name = self.main_quest_controller.event_zone_names.fourth_event_zone
	local is_able_to_play_event = type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, fourth_event_zone_name)

	if is_able_to_play_event and not self.play_pre_scene_once then
		self.play_pre_scene_once = true

		start_coroutine(self.play_labose_confrontation_event, self)
	end
end

function police_event_4:pre_setting()
	for i = 1, #self.polices do
		scene_util.set_emotion(self.polices[i], self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(self.polices[i], self, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
		character_util.set_active_state(self.polices[i], 'enabled')
	end

	local cur_event_labose = self.labose_npcs.event_4(1)
	character_util.set_active_state(cur_event_labose, 'enabled')

	local bullet_item_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s7_event_4_bullet_item_1')
	self.bullet_item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = bullet_item_pos,
													itemid = self.bullet_item_id,
													notforinven = true,
													lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
													skip_text = true })

	self.gimmicks.bullet().Position = bullet_item_pos

	local event_wall = self.gimmicks.event_area_wall(1)
	event_wall.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	event_wall = self.gimmicks.event_area_wall(2)
	event_wall.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point('main_quest',
			self.main_quest_controller.quest_id, true, vector(-192.5, 0, 36.5))

	self:set_shoot_helper()
end

function police_event_4:set_shoot_helper()
	local rifle_polices = {}
	for i = 1, #self.polices do
		table.insert(rifle_polices, self.polices[i])
	end

	-- 피격 대상에 대미지 표시가 나오도록
	local shoot_handler = {
		on_hit = function(_, _, hit_info, _)
			if hit_info.target then
				if hit_info.target.SpineController then
					unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(hit_info.position)

					character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(hit_info.target)
					character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(hit_info.target)
				end
			end
		end
	}

	-- ShootHelper
	self.shoot_helpers = {}
	for _, v in pairs(rifle_polices) do
		local pattern_info = { columns = 1 }
		local proj_data = game_data_service.GetData('ProjectileData')
		local proj_spec = proj_data:GetSpec('rifle_bullet'):Clone()
		local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(shoot_handler, v)
		local shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional, ps,
				proj_spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachBullet)
		table.insert(self.shoot_helpers, shoot_helper)
	end
end

function police_event_4:change_gimmick_state()
	local event_wall = self.gimmicks.event_area_wall(1)
	event_wall.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	event_wall = self.gimmicks.event_area_wall(2)
	event_wall.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

function police_event_4:play_labose_confrontation_event()
	local cur_event_police = self.polices[1]
	local cur_event_labose = self.labose_npcs.event_4(1)

	-- 존 엔터하면 컨트롤 뺏지 않고 이벤트 진행.
	-- 6번 경찰 attack, rifle_shoot 2회.
	-- 동시에 라보스 괴물 속도 1로 1칸 오른쪽으로 움직인다.
	wp_util.move(cur_event_labose,
			cur_event_labose.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
			1,
			nil )
	scene_util.set_emotion(cur_event_police, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(cur_event_police, self, { name = 'rifle_shoot', count = 2 })

	scene_util.set_anim(cur_event_police, self, { name = 'rifle_idle' })

	wait_for_sec(0.35)

	-- 6번 경찰(attack, idle, jump 1회) : 젠장! 총알이…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(cur_event_police)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cur_event_police, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 's7_lw_main_45', skip = false })

	-- 라보스 괴물 달려들어와 6번 경찰과 몸싸움 시작.
	-- 둘다 attack, push로 0.5칸 거리까지 달라붙는다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_06')
	wp_util.move_async(cur_event_labose,
			cur_event_police.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			nil,
			0.75 )

	scene_util.set_anim(cur_event_police, self, { name = 'push' })
	scene_util.set_anim(cur_event_labose, self, { name = 'push' })

	-- 부딪히는 순간 fx_hit 이펙트
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	self.fx:hit():Instantiate(cur_event_police.Position + vector(-0.25, 0, 0))

	-- shake loop
	start_coroutine(self.confrontation_event_loop, self, cur_event_police)

	-- 6번 경찰(루틴 유지한 채로) : 총알만 있었으면 이 놈 정도는…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cur_event_police, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 's7_lw_main_46', skip = false })
end

function police_event_4:confrontation_event_loop(shaking_npc)
	self.confrontation_loop = true

	-- 아래 루틴 반복
	-- 1초 대기
	-- 1초간 shake

	while self.confrontation_loop do
		character_util.shake(shaking_npc, 0.03, 1)

		wait_for_sec(2)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function police_event_4:bullet_get_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local bullet = self.gimmicks.bullet()

	party_util.align_party(bullet.Position, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true})

	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'eat')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.bullet_item.ConsumeTarget = leader
	self.bullet_item:Fly()
	self.bullet_item = nil

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	eat_sfx = nil

	self.get_bullet_item = true

	self:change_gimmick_state()
	screen_util.item_get_event(
			self.bullet_item_id,
			'lw_main_s7_item_title',
			'lw_main_s7_item_subtitle',
			'lw_main_s7_item_desc')

	bullet.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

function police_event_4:scene_end_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local queen = self.main_quest_controller.characters.demon_queen()
	local engineer = self.main_quest_controller.characters.demon_engineer()
	local cur_event_police = self.polices[1]
	local cur_event_labose = self.labose_npcs.event_4(1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	-- 1초간 정해진 위치로 정렬.
	--카메라 포커스는 그대로 기사에게.
	--경찰들은 right로. 리리스, 기사, 비네트는 down으로
	local police_align_marker = 's7_event_4_align_%s'
	local polices = self.saving_npc_helper:get_save_npc_list()

	for i, npc in pairs(polices) do
		wp_util.move(npc, { field_util.get_marker_pos('s7_event_4_align_s7_police_' .. i) }, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'right' } )
	end

	-- 비네트, 기사 left, idle, idle
	wp_util.move(queen, { field_util.get_marker_pos('s7_event_4_end_queen') }, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'down' } )
	wp_util.move(engineer, { field_util.get_marker_pos('s7_event_4_end_engineer') }, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'down' } )
	wp_util.move_async(leader, { field_util.get_marker_pos('s7_event_4_end_leader') }, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'down' } )

	--self:align_polices(polices, police_align_marker)

	--내레이션 박스
	--총알을 던져 주시겠습니까?
	local nar_data = {
		key = 's7_lw_main_47'
	}

	--가디언 선택지
	local choose_data = {}
	if self.get_bullet_item then
		table.insert(choose_data, { 's7_lw_main_48', 'mercy' })
	end

	table.insert(choose_data, { 's7_lw_main_49', 'brutal' })

	--나레이션 박스를 유지한 채 선택지
	local choose_result = field_ui_util.show_narration_talk_branch_async(nar_data, choose_data)

	if choose_result == 1 then
		if not self.get_bullet_item then
			--물러난다.
			-- 가디언 컨트롤 해제.
			return
		end
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		--물러난다.
		-- 가디언 컨트롤 해제.
		return
	end

	--다음 연출로 진행.
	--가디언 down, attack, release 1회로 총알 던져준다,
	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(leader, 'release')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')

	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 1 })

	wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.75)

	local throw_drop_item_complete = false

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.bullet_item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = leader.Position,
														itemid = self.bullet_item_id, notforinven = true, skip_text = true,
														lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
		drop_item_util.throw_item(self.bullet_item, cur_event_police.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.3))

		throw_drop_item_complete = true
	end)

	--1초에 걸쳐서 6번 경찰에게 dropitemutil로 날아간다.
	--카메라 포커스도 동시에 1초간 6번 경찰에게 이동.
	--동시에 사이즈도 1초간 3으로 줌인.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 1)
	camera_util.move_async(cur_event_police.Position, 1)

	--6번 경찰 총알 획득
	--이름은 뜨지 않도록 처리.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_reload_04')

	while not throw_drop_item_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	self.bullet_item.ConsumeTarget = cur_event_police
	self.bullet_item:Fly()

	--6번 경찰(루틴 유지한 채로) : 드디어…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cur_event_police, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 's7_lw_main_50', skip = true })

	self.confrontation_loop = false

	-- 6번 경찰 attack, sword_attack_stab 1회
	anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(cur_event_police, 'sword_attack_stab')

	scene_util.set_anim(cur_event_police, self, { name = 'sword_attack_stab', count = 1 })

	wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.5)

	--    맞는 순간
	--      라보스 괴물 damaged 애니메이션으로 damagesquish,redpulse 되며 벽 끝까지 0.3초만에 밀려난다.
	--      fx_hit 이펙트, fx_lasthit 이펙트
	--      카메라도 0.3초만에 연두색 마름모로 포커스 이동.
	--      카메라 사이즈도 0.3초만에 원래 사이즈로
	--      카메라 0.3초간 shake
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

	self.fx:hit():Instantiate(cur_event_labose.Position)
	self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(cur_event_labose.Position)

	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(cur_event_labose)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(cur_event_labose)

	scene_util.set_anim(cur_event_labose, self, { name = 'damaged' })

	start_coroutine(function()
		character_util.move_to_async(cur_event_labose,
				field_util.get_marker_pos('s7_event_4_end_labose_1'),
				0.3,
				nil,
				false,
				false)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(cur_event_labose)
	end)

	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.6)

		scene_util.set_anim(cur_event_police, self, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
	end)

	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.3)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.3)
	camera_util.move_async(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(-1.5, 0, 0), 0.3)

	start_coroutine(self.police_rifle_shooting, self, cur_event_labose)

	while not self.is_keep_shooting_routine do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 임시로 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	while self.is_keep_shooting_routine do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(cur_event_police)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 6번 경찰(left, attack, idle) : 후… 해치웠나.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cur_event_police, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			{ key = 's7_lw_main_52', skip = true })

	--라보스 괴물 shake 0.3초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(cur_event_labose, 0.02, 0.3)

	-- 6번 경찰(up, release 3회) : 도와주셔서 감사합니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cur_event_police, self,
			{ dir = 'up' },
			{ name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01', count = 3 },
			nil,
			{ key = 's7_lw_main_53', skip = true })

	-- 라보스 괴물 shake 0.3초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(cur_event_labose, 0.02, 0.3)

	-- 6번 경찰(up, idle) : 거기…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cur_event_police, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 's7_lw_main_54', skip = true })

	-- 6번 경찰 left로 전환.
	character_util.set_direction(cur_event_police, 'left')
	-- 기사 surprise, idle로
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
	-- 비네트 attack, idle로
	scene_util.set_emotion(engineer, self, 'attack')

	-- 라보스 괴물이 마리오 점프하며 일어난다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(cur_event_labose)
	character_util.mario_jump_async(cur_event_labose, 'right')

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 6번 경찰 scared, embarrassed로 전환.
	-- 카메라도 0.2초간 사이즈 2.8로 줌인.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(cur_event_police, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(cur_event_police, self, 'embarrassed')
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.8, 0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')

	-- 라보스 괴물이 0.5초만에 오른쪽으로 2.5칸 점프하여 prostrate로 움직이면서 타임 스케일 0.2배속으로 슬로우.
	scene_util.set_anim(cur_event_labose, self, 'prostrate')

	local target_pos = cur_event_labose.Position + vector(1.5, 1.7, 0)
	local info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo.Create(target_pos, 4, false)
	info.yMode = CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Flying
	local duration = info:GetDuration(cur_event_labose.Position)
	character_util.jump_move(cur_event_labose, target_pos, 4, 0.5, false)

	wait_for_sec(duration * 0.55)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')

	local slow_key = 'labose_rushes'
	time_util.mod(slow_key, 0.1)

	wait_for_sec(duration * 0.15)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_demon_claw_01')
	self.fx:queen_attack():Instantiate(cur_event_labose.Position)

	wait_for_sec(duration * 0.05)

	-- 타임 스케일 원복.
	time_util.unmod(slow_key)

	wait_for_sec(duration * 0.1)

	-- 카메라 사이즈 0.3초만에 원래 사이즈로.
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.3)
	-- 카메라 shake 0.3초간
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.3)
	-- 6번 경찰 surprise, idle로
	scene_util.set_emotion(cur_event_police, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.remove_anim(cur_event_police)

	-- 그 때 리리스의 fx_lilith_basic_claw 이펙트가 나타나면서 라보스 괴물 down 방향으로 airspin 되어 날아간다.
	character_util.air_spin(cur_event_labose, { offset = unity_class.vector3.down * 2 })

	-- 1.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	scene_util.set_emotion(queen, self, 'attack')

	--카메라 포커스 리리스에게로 0.5초간 이동.
	camera_util.move(queen.Position, 0.5)

	-- 카메라 포커스 이동과 동시에 6번 경찰 속도 4로 이동하여 리리스 앞으로 간다.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(cur_event_police)
	wp_util.move_async(cur_event_police, { cur_event_police.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5) }, 4, nil )

	-- 중간에 장애물은 jump하여 넘어간다.
	-- 점프 하는 순간 리리스 sleep_deep으로 표정 변경.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(queen, self, 'sleep_deep')
	character_util.jump_move(cur_event_police, field_util.get_marker_pos('s7_event_4_align_s7_police_6'), 4, 1.7, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	character_util.set_direction(cur_event_police, 'left')

	-- 6번 경찰 도착하면, 리리스, 비네트, 기사
	character_util.set_group_direction({ leader, queen, engineer }, 'right')

	-- 6번 경찰(smile, sing, jump 2회) : 리리스 각하! 마계의 영웅님까지!
	-- 리리스 표정 tired로 변경.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')

	scene_util.set_emotion(queen, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_emotion(cur_event_police, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(cur_event_police, self, { name = 'sing' })
	character_util.normal_double_jump(cur_event_police, '01_small_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cur_event_police, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 's7_lw_main_55', skip = true })

	-- 6번 경찰(smile, release 3회) : 두 분께서 제 목숨을 구해주셨군요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cur_event_police, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01', count = 3 },
			nil,
			{ key = 's7_lw_main_56', skip = true })

	-- 가디언 선택지
	choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 's7_lw_main_57', 'brutal' }, { 's7_lw_main_58', 'mercy' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 사례금 얘기를 해볼까?(빨강)
		-- 6번 경찰 scared, cast
		scene_util.set_emotion(cur_event_police, self, 'scared')
		scene_util.set_anim(cur_event_police, self, { name = 'cast' })

		-- 가디언 doyagao, clap 3회
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_02')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'doyagao')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'clap', count = 3 })

		-- 비네트(tired, bomb_idle) : 걱정하지마, 농담일테니까.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(engineer, self,
				nil,
				{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
				{ name = 'tired' },
				{ key = 's7_lw_main_59', skip = true })

		-- 가디언 tired, idle
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')

		-- 6번 경찰 smile, nod 1회
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(cur_event_police, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(cur_event_police, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })

	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		-- 당연한 행동을 했을 뿐.
		-- 가디언 sleep_deep, cast 1초
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self,
				nil,
				{ name = 'cast' },
				{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
				1)

		-- 6번 경찰 : 역시 마계의 영웅님이시군요!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cur_event_police, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 's7_lw_main_60', skip = true })
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 6번 경찰(attack, idle, jump 1회) : 게다가 저희 부대원들까지 이곳에…!
	character_util.normal_jump(cur_event_police, '01_small_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cur_event_police, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			{ key = 's7_lw_main_61', skip = true })

	-- 6번 경찰(attack, bomb_idle) : 모두 임무를 충실히 수행중이었군요!
	scene_util.hide_weapon(cur_event_police)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cur_event_police, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			nil,
			{ key = 's7_lw_main_62', skip = true })

	-- 6번 경찰(attack, salute 1회) : 저도 합류하겠습니다!
	-- 02_twohand_stomp_jump_01 + 01_female_shout_01
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_female_shout_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cur_event_police, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'salute', loop = false },
			nil,
			{ key = 's7_lw_main_63', skip = true })

	scene_util.show_weapon(cur_event_police)

	-- 리리스 sleep_deep, nod 1회
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(queen, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(queen, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })

	table.insert(polices, cur_event_police)

	self:convert_polices_to_following_npc(polices)

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.main_quest_controller.quest_progress, 's7_fourth_rescue_event', 1)

function police_event_4:police_rifle_shooting(target)
	for i = 1, #self.polices do
		scene_util.set_anim_async(self.polices[i], self, 'rifle_reload')
	end

	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(self.polices[1], 'rifle_reload')

	wait_for_sec(anim_duration)

	-- 6번 경찰(attack, rifle_shoot, 스킵 불가능, shout 말풍선) : 죽어어어어어!!!
	start_coroutine(function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(self.polices[1], self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 's7_lw_main_51', skip = false })
	end)

	for i = 1, #self.polices do
		scene_util.set_anim(self.polices[i], self, 'rifle_shoot')
	end

	self.is_keep_shooting_routine = true

	local shooter_target_pos = target.Position
	--+ vector(0.5, 0, -0.25)

	local muzzle_start_pos_adj = vector(-0.2, 0, 0.1)
	local delay = 0.03

	local num_helpers = #self.polices
	local num_sounds = num_helpers - 1
	local sfx_info = { sfx_name = '02_minigun_shoot_01', volume = 0.3, loop = false, parent = self.polices[1] }

	-- 라보스 괴물은 총알 맞으면서 dead 애니메이션 실행.
	-- 라보스 괴물 dead 애니메이션 끝난 후, 다음 대사 진행.
	-- 끝나기 전까지는 계속 총알 쏜다.
	local target_dead_anim_end = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(target, 'dead')

		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = 'dead', loop = false })

		wait_for_sec(anim_duration)

		target_dead_anim_end = true
	end)

	local delay_time_passed = 0
	while self.is_keep_shooting_routine do
		for k, v in pairs(self.shoot_helpers) do
			local dir_vec_diff = unity_class.vector3.right
			local shooter_bound_center = self.polices[k].Bounds.center
			local target_direction = (shooter_target_pos - shooter_bound_center + dir_vec_diff).normalized
			local muzzle_pos = self.polices[k].Bounds.center + muzzle_start_pos_adj

			if k <= num_sounds then
				music_player_util.play_sfx(sfx_info)
			end

			if v ~= nil then
				v:ShootDirectionAtPosition(muzzle_pos, target_direction)
			end

			if target_dead_anim_end then
				break
			end

			while delay_time_passed < (delay * 2) do
				delay_time_passed = delay_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				if target_dead_anim_end then
					break
				end

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			delay_time_passed = 0
		end

		if target_dead_anim_end then
			break
		end

		while delay_time_passed < delay do
			delay_time_passed = delay_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if target_dead_anim_end then
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		delay_time_passed = 0

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.is_keep_shooting_routine = false
end

function police_event_4:dispose()
	self.saving_npc_helper = nil
	self.main_quest_controller = nil

	if self.fx ~= nil then
		self.fx:dispose()
	end

	if self.shoot_helpers ~= nil then
		for k, _ in pairs(self.shoot_helpers) do
			self.shoot_helpers[k] = nil
		end

		self.shoot_helpers = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.event_zone_names.last_event_zone) then
		start_coroutine(self.fix_event_4_state, self)

		self.controller.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.play_all_after_event, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's7_battle_1') and
			not self.battle_zone_enter[self.event_zone_names.first_battle_zone] then
		self.battle_zone_enter[self.event_zone_names.first_battle_zone] = true

		self:convert_following_npcs_to_ally(self.saving_npc_helper:get_save_npc_list())
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's7_battle_2') and
			not self.battle_zone_enter[self.event_zone_names.second_battle_zone] then
		self.battle_zone_enter[self.event_zone_names.second_battle_zone] = true

		self:convert_following_npcs_to_ally(self.saving_npc_helper:get_save_npc_list())
	end

	return true
end

-- [ 시스템 ] : 경찰 이벤트 활성화
function local_class:activate_police_event_by_event_type(type)
	-- 중복 이벤트 세팅 방지
	if table_util.contain_key(self.activated_police_events, type) then
		return
	end

	-- 이벤트 인스턴스 생성
	local police_event = self.police_event_constructors[type](self)

	-- 이벤트 시작
	police_event:start()

	-- 이벤트에 필요한 이벤트들 구독
	police_event:subscribe_events()

	-- 이벤트 인스턴스 캐싱
	self.activated_police_events[type] = police_event
end

-- [ 시스템 ] : 경찰 이벤트 비활성화
function local_class:deactive_police_event(event)
	if event then
		-- 이벤트에 사용되었던 이벤트들 전부 구독 해제
		event:unsubscribe_events()

		event:end_events()
	end
end

-- [ 시스템 ] : 현재까지 생성되어있는 경찰 이벤트 인스턴스들 전부 제거
function local_class:dispose_all_police_events()
	for _, event in pairs(self.activated_police_events) do
		self:deactive_police_event(event)
	end

	self.activated_police_events = nil
end

-- [ 시스템 ] : 살아있는 모든 경찰들 받아옴
function local_class:get_all_alive_polices()
	local alive_polices = {}

	for _, event in pairs(self.activated_police_events) do
		if event:is_police_saved() then
			local police = event:get_polices()

			if type_util.is_table(police) then
				for i = 1, #police do
					table.insert(alive_polices, police[i])
				end
			else
				table.insert(alive_polices, police)
			end
		end
	end

	return alive_polices
end

function local_class:start_first_battle_police_shooting(shooters, target)
	self.first_battle_event_helper:start_shooting()

	for i = 1, #shooters do
		scene_util.set_anim(shooters[i], self, 'rifle_shoot')
	end

	local shooter_target_pos = target.Position
	--+ vector(0.5, 0, -0.25)

	local muzzle_start_pos_adj = vector(-0.2, 0, 0.1)
	local delay = 0.03

	local num_helpers = #self.first_battle_event_helper.shooter_helpers
	local num_sounds = num_helpers - 1
	local sfx_info = { sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_01', volume = 0.3, loop = false, parent = shooters[1] }

	while self.first_battle_event_helper.is_keep_shooting_routine do
		for i = 1, num_helpers do
			local dir_vec_diff = unity_class.vector3.up
			local shooter_bound_center = shooters[i].Bounds.center
			local target_direction = (shooter_target_pos - shooter_bound_center + dir_vec_diff).normalized
			local muzzle_pos = shooters[i].Bounds.center + muzzle_start_pos_adj

			if i <= num_sounds then
				music_player_util.play_sfx(sfx_info)
			end

			local shooter_helper = self.first_battle_event_helper.shooter_helpers[i]

			if shooter_helper ~= nil then
				shooter_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(muzzle_pos, target_direction)
			end

			wait_for_sec(delay * 2)
		end

		wait_for_sec(delay)
	end
end

function local_class:place_polics_npcs_all_after()
	local polices = self.characters.all_polices()

	local police_marker = 's7_all_after_ally_'
	local oneline_key = 's7_all_after_ally_oneline_'

	for i = 1, #polices do
		if self.saving_npc_helper:is_ally_alive_by_idx(i) then
			local marker_name = police_marker .. i .. '_2'

			character_util.convert_to_npc(polices[i])

			wp_util.move(polices[i], { field_util.get_marker_pos(marker_name) },
					4, nil,
					{ last_direction = field_util.get_marker_dir(marker_name), end_callback = function()
						local anim_emo = self.anim_emotion_data[i]
						scene_util.set_anim(polices[i], self, anim_emo.anim)
						scene_util.set_emotion(polices[i], self, anim_emo.emo)

						polices[i].Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
						polices[i].Interactable.Talk = oneline_key .. i
					end } )
		end
	end
end

function local_class:place_npcs_all_after()

function local_class:convert_following_npcs_to_ally(npcs)
	local leader_pos = user_party.Leader.Position

	for i, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		start_coroutine(self.jump_to_battle_zone, self, npc, leader_pos,
				direction_util.to_8way_vector3(user_party.Leader.Direction))
	end
end

function local_class:jump_to_battle_zone(npc, leader_pos, leader_direction)
	local front_offset = random_util.get_random_int(2, 4.5)

	local random_angle = random_util.get_random_int(-50, 50)

	local angle_axis = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(random_angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
	local dest_pos = leader_pos + (angle_axis * leader_direction) + leader_direction * front_offset

	character_util.jump_move(npc, dest_pos, 10, 3, true)

	if self.current_started_battle ~= nil then
		character_util.convert_to_non_party_player(npc)

		self.current_started_battle:AddAlly(npc)

		character_util.set_immortal(npc, true)

		self:set_all_npc_battle_state(npc)
	end
end

function local_class:set_all_npc_battle_state(npc)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(npc.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.IBattleAIState) then

		return
	end

	if npc.CharacterBehaviour.BattleStyleSpec == nil then
		return
	end

	local ai_name = npc.CharacterBehaviour.BattleStyleSpec.BattleAI;

	if ai_name == nil then
		return
	end

	local battle_state = CS.Oak.BattleAIStateFactory.Create(ai_name, npc, nil)

	message_system:SendSync(npc.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(battle_state))
end

function local_class:back_to_original_party()
	party_util.add_member(self.characters.demon_engineer())
	party_util.add_member(self.characters.demon_queen())

	local polices = self.saving_npc_helper:get_save_npc_list()

	for _, npc in pairs(polices) do
		scene_util.show_weapon(npc)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		character_util.convert_to_following_npc(npc, user_party, false)
	end
end

function local_class:cleared_event_1(police_list)
	local cur_event = self.activated_police_events[police_event_type.event_1]

	for i = 1, #police_list do
		self.saving_npc_helper:save_alive_npc_info(police_list[i])

		-- 이후 경찰 파티로 합류.
		cur_event:convert_police_to_following_npc(police_list[i])
	end

	cur_event:set_self_completed(cur_event)

	self:deactive_police_event(self.activated_police_events[police_event_type.event_1])

	self:activate_police_event_by_event_type(police_event_type.event_2)

	if self.rescue_event_state[self.rescue_event.police_event_3] < 0 then
		if self.going_in_stage then
			self.going_in_stage = false
			self:prepare_for_event_3()
			self.going_in_stage = true
		else
			self:prepare_for_event_3()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:cleared_event_2(police_list)
	self:deactive_police_event(self.activated_police_events[police_event_type.event_1])

	local cur_event = self.activated_police_events[police_event_type.event_2]

	local last_pos = nil
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		if i == (user_party.Count - 1) then
			last_pos = user_party[i].Position
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #police_list do
		self.saving_npc_helper:save_alive_npc_info(police_list[i])

		character_util.set_position(police_list[i], last_pos + vector(0.75 + (i - 1), 0, 0))

		-- 이후 경찰 파티로 합류.
		if cur_event ~= nil then
			cur_event:convert_police_to_following_npc(police_list[i])
		end
	end

	if cur_event == nil then
		return
	end

	cur_event:set_self_completed(cur_event)

	self:deactive_police_event(self.activated_police_events[police_event_type.event_2])
end

local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldMainSection9')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @

]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type LaboseWorldMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		exit_stage = 2,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'laboseworld_2'

	self.get_demon_engineer = function() return get_character('demon_engineer') end

	-- 마족 그룹
	self.get_demon_queen = function() return get_character('demon_queen') end

	-- 챔피언 그룹
	self.get_ghost_buster = function() return get_character('ghost_buster') end
	self.get_desert_slave = function() return get_character('desert_slave') end
	self.get_china_hero = function()
		return user_util.get_china_hero_character('china_hero_boy', 'china_hero_girl')
	end

	-- 데몬샤이어 그룹
	self.get_half_vampire = function() return get_character('half_vampire') end
	self.get_vampire_captain = function() return get_character('vampire_captain') end
	self.get_sheep_girl = function() return get_character('sheep_girl') end
	self.get_goat_girl = function() return get_character('goat_girl') end

	-- npc 들
	self.get_group_a_npc = function(index) return get_character('s9_group_a_' .. index) end
	self.get_group_b_npc = function(index) return get_character('s9_group_b_' .. index) end

	-- 스테이지 나가는 exit
	self.get_fake_stage_exit = function() return get_field_object('fake_stage_exit') end

	self.group_b_count = 6

	self.is_interact_champion = false
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	local fake_stage_exit = self.get_fake_stage_exit()
	fake_stage_exit.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.controller.sp_manager:start_coroutine_delayed(self.stage_two_epilogue, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	if self.current_state == self.states.none then
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
	end

	if self.is_interact_champion == false then
		local champion_group = {
			self.get_ghost_buster(), self.get_china_hero(), self.get_desert_slave(),
		}

		for i = 1, #champion_group do
			character_util.remove_relate_event(champion_group[i], self.controller)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_fake_stage_exit()) then
		start_coroutine(self.stage_clear_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	local champion_group = {
		self.get_ghost_buster(), self.get_china_hero(), self.get_desert_slave(),
	}

	for i = 1, #champion_group do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, champion_group[i]) then
			self.controller.sp_manager:try_start_scene(self.interact_champion, self, i < #champion_group)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:stage_two_epilogue()
	local is_current_section_start = self.cs_controller.StartingInnerProgress >= 8

	if is_current_section_start then
		sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	, 'bomb_idle', 'attack', is_fei and 'lw_main_s9_19_3' or 'lw_main_s9_19_4')

	-- 비네트(down, sleep_deep, nod 1회) : 그래. 그리고 그 안에 있을 케이든을 막아야 해.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self, nil, { name = 'nod', count = 1 }
	, 'sleep_deep', 'lw_main_s9_19_5')

	-- 소히 right, attack, idle
	scene_util.set_direction(champion_group[1], 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(champion_group[1], self, 'attack')

	-- 마빈(left, question 1회) : 케이든? 그 전설의 용사를 말하는 건가?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(champion_group[3], self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false }
	, 'question', nil, 'lw_main_s9_19_6')

	-- 마빈, 페이/메이, 소히, 기사, 비네트 up으로
	party_util.set_direction('up')
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(champion_group)
	character_util.set_group_direction(champion_group, 'up')

	-- 리리스(down, sleep_deep, idle) : 이제는 그저…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self, { dir = 'down', sfx = false }
	, nil, { name = 'sleep_deep', keep = true }, 'lw_main_s9_19_7')

	-- 카메라 포커스 연두색 마름모로 이동.
	camera_util.move_async(center_pos, 0.5)

	-- 리리스(down, tired, bomb_idle) : 악당일 뿐이지.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self, nil
	, 'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'lw_main_s9_19_8')

	-- 리리스 down, sleep_deep, idle로 1초 대기
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_queen, self, 'sleep_deep')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 리리스(down, tired, idle) : 헤븐홀드까지… 머지 않았어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self, nil
	, 'bomb_idle', { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'lw_main_s9_19_9')

	-- 비네트(up, idle) : 리리스, 잠시만.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self, { dir = 'up', sfx = false }
	, nil, nil, 'lw_main_s9_19_10')

	-- 비네트(up, idle) : 헤븐홀드 바깥에서도 계속해서 싸워줄 사람들이 필요해.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_engineer, 'lw_main_s9_19_11')

	-- 비네트(left, smile, bomb_idle) : 물론 프리실라가 생각보다 더 믿음직스럽기는 하지만.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false }
	, 'bomb_idle', 'smile', 'lw_main_s9_19_12')

	-- 비네트(up, release 2회) : 그래도 상황이 급박해지면 네가 필요할 거야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self, { dir = 'up', sfx = false }
	, 'release', nil, 'lw_main_s9_19_13')

	-- 비네트(left, sleep_deep, cast) : 여기 모인 사람들은 모두…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false }
	, 'cast', 'sleep_deep', 'lw_main_s9_19_14')

	-- 비네트(left, attack, bomb_idle) : 여전히 널 따르니까.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self, nil
	, 'bomb_idle', 'attack', 'lw_main_s9_19_15')

	scene_util.set_direction(demon_engineer, 'up', false)

	-- 리리스 down, sleep_deep, idle, shake 0.3초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(demon_queen, 0.03, 0.3)
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_queen, self, 'sleep_deep')

	-- 0.7초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	-- 리리스(down, tired, nod 1회) : …알겠어, 내가… 해볼게…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 }
	, nil, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'lw_main_s9_19_16')

	-- 리리스(down, tired, bomb_idle) : 둘도 반드시 성공하길… 바랄게.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self, nil
	, 'bomb_idle', nil, 'lw_main_s9_21')

	-- 카메라 포커스 기사에게로 0.5초간 이동
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	-- 가디언 선택지
	-- 내게 맡겨!(초록)
	-- 내가 없으면 마계는 돌아가지를 않는다니까.(노랑)
	-- 새삼 1500년을 같이 지낸 에리나가 대단하다고 느껴지네.(보라)
	choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'lw_main_s9_22', 'mercy' }
	, { 'lw_main_s9_23', 'intellect' }, { 'lw_main_s9_24', 'forced' } })

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_engineer, 'left', false)

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 내게 맡겨!(초록)

		-- 가디언 right, attack, victory_get 1회
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, keep_anim = true })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 리리스(down, sleep_deep, cast) : 그래, 믿고 있어.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self, nil, 'cast'
		, 'sleep_deep', 'lw_main_s9_25')

	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		-- 내가 없으면 마계는 돌아가지를 않는다니까.(노랑)

		-- 가디언 right, doyagao, bomb_idle 1초
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'doyagao')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bomb_idle')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 리리스(down, sleep_deep, nod 1회) : 그래… 네가 없었으면 상황은 더…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self, nil
		, { name = 'nod', count = 1 }, 'sleep_deep', 'lw_main_s9_26')
	else
		-- 새삼 1500년을 같이 지낸 에리나가 대단하다고 느껴지네.(보라)

		-- 가디언 right, sleep_deep, nod 2회
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'sleep_deep')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, 'nod')

		-- 가디언 right, attack, salute 1회, 자세 유지한 채로 0.5초 대기.
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'salute', loop = false, keep_anim = true })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 리리스(tired, question 1회, 루프 없이, 자세 유지) : 비꼬는 거야…?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self, nil
		, { name = 'question', keep = true }, { name = 'tired', keep = true }
		, 'lw_main_s9_27')

		-- 프리실라(right, smile, bomb_idle) : 뒤는 걱정하지 말고 다녀오세요, 기사님.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_shire_group[1], self, nil
		, 'bomb_idle', 'smile', 'lw_main_s9_28')

		-- 리리스 애니메이션 해제
		character_util.remove_anim(demon_queen)
	end

	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_queen, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 비네트 left로 전환

	-- 비네트(left, attack idle) : 어서 가자, $name.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self, nil
	, nil, 'attack', 'lw_main_s9_29')

	-- 비네트(left, attack, bomb_idle) : 헤븐홀드와 공주님이 널 기다리잖아.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self, nil
	, 'bomb_idle', 'attack', 'lw_main_s9_30')

	-- 기사 attack, nod 2회
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, 'nod')
	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

	local move_end_key = 'move_end'

	local move_pos_list = {
		{
			vector(-4, 0, 0),
			vector(-4, 0, 1.5)
		},
		{
			vector(0, 0, 1.5),
			vector(-2, 0, 1.5)
		},
		{
			vector(-4, 0, 0),
			vector(-4, 0, 1)
		},
		{
			vector(-4, 0, 0),
			vector(-4, 0, 1)
		},
	}

	local emotion_list = { 'tired', nil, 'tired', 'sleep_deep' }
	local anim_list = { nil, nil, 'bomb_idle', nil }
	local dir_list = { 'right', 'left', 'left', 'right' }

	local function get_pos_list(start_pos, index)
		local add_pos_list = move_pos_list[index]

		local pos_list = {}
		for i = 1, #add_pos_list do
			table.insert(pos_list, start_pos + add_pos_list[i])
		end

		return pos_list
	end

	local function set_anim_and_emotion(npc, emotion, anim)
		if emotion ~= nil then
			character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = emotion })
		end

		if anim ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = anim })
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #demon_shire_group do
		local npc = demon_shire_group[i]
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, get_pos_list(npc.Position, i)
		, 4, nil, self, move_end_key, { last_direction = dir_list[i], end_callback = function()
					set_anim_and_emotion(npc, emotion_list[i], anim_list[i])
				end })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	local group_a_emotion = { 'attack', 'attack', nil, 'attack', 'tired', 'attack', 'tired', 'tired' }
	local group_a_anim = { 'dagger_idle', nil, 'bomb_idle', nil, 'cast', 'bomb_idle', 'cast', nil }
	local group_a_dir = { 'left', 'right', 'left', 'right', 'right', 'left', 'left', 'right' }

	for i = 1, self.group_a_count do
		local a_npc = self.get_group_a_npc(i)
		scene_util.set_direction(a_npc, group_a_dir[i], false)

		if group_a_emotion[i] ~= nil then
			character_util.set_emotion(a_npc, { name = group_a_emotion[i] })
		end

		if group_a_anim[i] ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim(a_npc, { name = group_a_anim[i] })
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #champion_group do
		character_util.add_listener(champion_group[i], self.controller)
	end

	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(392)

	if quest_progress ~= nil then
		scene_util.set_emotion(demon_shire_group[2], self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(demon_shire_group[2], self, { name = 'cast', one_shot_sfx = false })
	else
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'lw_main_section_9_clear' }))
	end

	local fake_stage_exit = self.get_fake_stage_exit()
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.controller.quest_id
	, true, fake_stage_exit)

	--서브 스테이지 오픈용 커스텀 이벤트 발사
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(
			user_party.Leader, { 'demon_queen_sub_stage_active' }
	))

	-- 이후 컨트롤 해제.
	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)

	if is_current_section_start then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:stage_clear_scene()
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.current_state = self.states.exit_stage

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	self.controller:progress_section()

	-- 스테이지 클리어
	CS.Oak.TeleportPartyStageLogic.Execute('stage_exit', 'passage_18_2', nil, true)
end

function local_class:interact_champion(is_left)
	--컨트롤 뺏김과 함께 BGM 볼륨 0.6으로 조절, 믹스 디폴트값
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	self.is_interact_champion = true
	-- 셋 중 하나에게 말 걸면 1초간 위 위치로 정렬하여 이벤트 진행.
	-- 페이, 소히에게 말 걸면 왼쪽으로 마빈에게 말걸면 오른쪽으로

	local is_fei = user_util.has_fei()

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	-- 페, 소, 마 전원 기사 바라본다.
	local champion_group = {
		self.get_ghost_buster(), self.get_china_hero(), self.get_desert_slave(),
	}

	for i = 1, #champion_group do
		character_util.remove_relate_event(champion_group[i], self.controller)
	end

	-- 기사, 비네트 마빈 바라본다.
	local target_pos = is_left and champion_group[2].Position or champion_group[3].Position
	local dir = is_left and 'left' or 'right'
	character_util.set_group_direction(champion_group, dir)
	party_util.align_party(target_pos, dir, 0.5, 'linear')

	-- 마빈(기사 바라보고, bomb_idle) : 다친 데는 없나, $name.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_group_direction(champion_group, dir)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(champion_group[3], self, nil, 'bomb_idle'
	, nil, 'lw_main_stage2_1')

	-- 페이(smile, cast) : 사제라면 무사할 줄 알았소.
	-- 메이(smile, cast) : 무사해서 정말 다행이야, 사제.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(champion_group[2], self, nil, 'cast'
	, 'smile', is_fei and 'lw_main_stage2_2' or 'lw_main_stage2_3')

	-- 소히(tired, idle) : 진짜 다시 얼굴 못 보는 줄 알았다고.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(champion_group[1], self, nil, nil
	, 'tired', 'lw_main_stage2_4')

	-- 가디언 선택지
	-- 다른 동료들의 행방에 대해 묻는다.(노랑)
	-- 다들 몸은 괜찮은지 묻는다.(초록)
	-- 궁금한 것이 없다.(빨강)

	local branch_data = {
		{ 'lw_main_stage2_5', 'intellect', function()
			-- 가디언 tired, bomb_idle 1초
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bomb_idle')
			wait_for_sec(1)

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

			-- 소히(down, tired, idle) : 난리통에 도망치다 전부 흩어졌어.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(champion_group[1], self, nil, nil
			, 'tired', 'lw_main_stage2_8')

			-- 마빈(idle, idle) : 다들 무사할 테니 너무 걱정하지 마라.
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(champion_group[3], 'lw_main_stage2_9')

			-- 페이(attack, nod 1회) : 맞소! 반드시 다시 모일 수 있을 것이오!
			-- 메이(attack, nod 1회) : 그래, 다같이 살아서 만날 수 있을 거야.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(champion_group[2], self, nil, { name = 'nod', count = 1 }
			, 'attack', is_fei and 'lw_main_stage2_10' or 'lw_main_stage2_11')

		end },
		{ 'lw_main_stage2_6', 'mercy', function()
			-- 가디언 tired, release 3회
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
			scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 3 })
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
			-- 페이/메이 대사

			-- 페이(smile, victory_get 1회) : 우린 괜찮소!
			-- 메이(smile, victory_get 1회) : 우린 괜찮아!
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(champion_group[2], self, nil, 'victory_get'
			, 'smile', is_fei and 'lw_main_stage2_12' or 'lw_main_stage2_13')

			-- 소히(tired, nod 2회) : 프리실라를 만난 게 정말 다행이었어.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(champion_group[1], self, nil, 'nod'
			, 'tired', 'lw_main_stage2_14')

			-- 마빈(idle, idle) : 나도 문제 없다.
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(champion_group[3], 'lw_main_stage2_15')
		end },
		{ 'lw_main_stage2_7', 'brutal', function()
			-- 기사 doyagao, bomb_idle 1초
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'doyagao')
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bomb_idle')
			wait_for_sec(1)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

			-- 소히(mad, cast2, jump 2회) : 야, 고릴라! 우리 걱정은 안 한 거야?
			start_coroutine(character_util.normal_double_jump, champion_group[1], true)
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(champion_group[1], self, nil
			, { name = 'cast2', keep = true }, { name = 'mad', keep = true }
			, 'lw_main_stage2_16')

			-- 페이/메이 대사
			-- 페이(right, tired, release 3회) : 너무 그러지 마시오, 사제도 얼마나 지쳤겠소…
			-- 메이(right, tired, release 3회) : 너무 그러지 마, 사제도 지쳤을 거야…
			local string_key = is_fei and 'lw_main_stage2_17' or 'lw_main_stage2_18'
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(champion_group[2], self, { dir = 'right', sfx = false }
			, { name = 'release', count = 3 }, { name = 'tired', keep = true }
			, string_key)

			-- 마빈(idle, bomb_idle) : 우리가 뒤에 있을테니… 걱정말고 나아가라, 가디언.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(champion_group[3], self, nil
			, { name = 'bomb_idle', keep = true }, nil, 'lw_main_stage2_19')
		end },
	}

	local one_line_state = 1
	local choose_count = 0
	local result = -1

	while choose_count < 2 do
		result = choose_util.play_choose_event(branch_data)

		if result >= #branch_data then
			one_line_state = 0
			break
		end

		table.remove(branch_data, result)
		choose_count = choose_count + 1

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, 's9_champion_choose_result', one_line_state)

	if one_line_state == 1 then
		-- 소히(sleep_deep, cast) : 프리실라를 만난 게 정말 다행이었어.
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(champion_group[1], { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'tired' })
		champion_group[1].Interactable.Talk = 'lw_main_stage2_interact_1_5'

		-- 페이(attack, idle) : 반드시 다시 모일 수 있을 것이오!
		-- 메이(attack, idle) : 다같이 살아서 만날 수 있을 거야.
		character_util.set_emotion(champion_group[2], { name = 'attack' })

local controller_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Base/QuestControllerBase')

---@class LaboseWorldOnigirlController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldOnigirlController', controller_base)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	-- 사용할 섹션 스크립트 정보. 주석 해제하고 사용
	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = true,
		NormalSectionCount = 5,
		HasPostSection = false
	}

	-- characters
	self.labose_creature_count = 3

	self.characters = {
		onigirl = function()
			return get_character('onigirl')
		end,
		labose_creature = function(number)
			return get_character('labose_creature_' .. number)
		end
	}

	-- marker
	self.markers = {
		reset_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_reset_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		labose_creature_pos = function(index, number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_labose_creature_pos_' .. index .. '_' .. number)
		end,
	}

	self.detect_key = 'labose_creature_detect_'

	--pre section item
	self.mall_phone_item = nil
	self.mall_phone_id = 21160

	--helicopter
	self.res_holder = nil

	self.helicopter = {
		prefab_object = nil,
		helicopter_fo = nil,
		helicopter_sfx = nil,
		stop_option = false,
		load_async = function(this)
			if this.prefab_object ~= nil then
				return
			end

			this.prefab_object =  load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder,
					'ondemand/v2_49_queenship/tilesets', '[gimmick]dw_helicopter')

			this.prefab_object.transform.localPosition = vector(999, 0, 999)
		end,
		set_position = function(this, pos)
			this.prefab_object.transform.localPosition = pos
		end,
		move_distance = function(this, move_distance, duration)
			local start_pos = this.prefab_object.transform.localPosition
			local end_pos = start_pos + move_distance
			local time_passed = 0

			while time_passed < duration and not this.stop_option do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				this.prefab_object.transform.localPosition = vector_util.lerp(start_pos, end_pos, time_passed / duration)

				coroutine.yield()
			end

			this.prefab_object.transform.localPosition = end_pos
		end,
		rotate = function(this, target_rotation, duration)
			local time_passed = 0
			local start_rotation = this.prefab_object.transform.localRotation.eulerAngles
			local end_rotation = target_rotation

			while time_passed < duration and not this.stop_option do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				local cur_angle = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_rotation, end_rotation, time_passed / duration)
				this.prefab_object.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(cur_angle)

				coroutine.yield()
			end

			this.prefab_object.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(target_rotation)
		end,
		set_parent = function(this, target, find_key)
			local parent = this.prefab_object.transform:Find(find_key).transform
			character_util.set_position(target, parent.position)
			target.Transform:SetParent(parent)
		end,
		get_camera_pos = function(this)
			return this.prefab_object.transform.position + vector(0, 3.5, 0)
		end,
		play_sfx = function(this)
			if this.helicopter_fo == nil then
				this.helicopter_fo = this.prefab_object:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObject))
			end

			this.helicopter_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
					{ sfx_name = '01_aircraft_01', loop = true, parent = helicopter_fo,
					  type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', max_distance = 10 })
		end,
		fade_out_sfx = function(this)
			if this.helicopter_sfx ~= nil then
				music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(this.helicopter_sfx, 1)
				this.helicopter_sfx = nil
			end
		end,
		stop_move = function(this)
			this.stop_option = true
			coroutine.yield()
			coroutine.yield()
		end,
		dispose = function(this)
			if not is_unity_null(this.prefab_object) then
				CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(this.helicopter_fo)
			end

			if not is_unity_null(this.prefab_object) then
				CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(this.prefab_object)
			end

			this.prefab_object = nil
		end
	}
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	if self.mall_phone_item ~= nil then
		self.mall_phone_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.mall_phone_item = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	self.super:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	for i = 1, self.labose_creature_count do
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == self.detect_key .. i then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.detected_action, self, i)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
end

function local_class:labose_creature_routine_start()
	for i = 1, self.labose_creature_count do
		self:labose_creature_routine(i)
	end
end

function local_class:labose_creature_routine(index)
	local creature = self.characters.labose_creature(index)

	character_util.set_position(creature, self.markers.labose_creature_pos(index, 1))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(creature)

	local wp = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

	wp:Add(self.markers.labose_creature_pos(index, 1))
	wp:Add(self.markers.labose_creature_pos(index, 2))
	wp:Add(self.markers.labose_creature_pos(index, 3))
	wp:Add(self.markers.labose_creature_pos(index, 4))

	character_util.set_position(creature, self.markers.labose_creature_pos(index, 1))
	creature.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	--어택 레인지 :  거리 3 / 반경 60도
	local sight_distance = 3
	local sight_angle = 60

	creature.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(
			creature, wp, self.detect_key .. index, sight_distance, sight_angle, false, true)
end

function local_class:detected_action(index)
	local creature = self.characters.labose_creature(index)
	local onigirl = self.characters.onigirl()

	--플레이어 괴물 NPC 방향으로 전환하는 동시에 surprise 표정으로 jump 1회
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	party_util.look_at(creature)
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'surprise' })
	party_util.jump(0.5, 0.3)

	--괴물 NPC release 동작 2회
	character_util.look_at(creature, onigirl)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(creature, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

	--괴물 NPC가 prostrate 자세로 플레이어를 향해 jump. 동시에 플레이어 (scared 표정, embarrassed 자세)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'scared' })
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'embarrassed' })
	scene_util.set_anim(creature, self, 'prostrate')
	character_util.move_to(creature, onigirl.Position, 1)
	character_util.jump(creature, 1, 1)
	--해당 연출과 동시에 서큘러 페이드 아웃 게임 오버.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.65, 'linear')

	--이후 플레이어 타일에 (left, idle, idle) 자세로 서큘러 페이드 인.
	party_util.align_party(self.markers.reset_pos(index) + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			'right', 0, 'linear')
	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.remove_emotion()

	self.check_detect_key = nil
	self.is_detected = false

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self:labose_creature_routine(index)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.65, 'linear')
end

function local_class:create_mall_phone_item(pos, target)
	self.mall_phone_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = pos,
		target = target,
		itemid = self.mall_phone_id,
		notforinven = true,
		sprscale = 0.7,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldOnigirlPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = LaboseWorldOnigirl @
		Comment = 라나 서브 스테이지 오픈 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type LaboseWorldOnigirlController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	---@type LaboseWorldScreenplayManager
	self.sp_manager = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/LaboseWorld/Common/LaboseWorldScreenplayManager')

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'laboseworld_1'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		start = 2,
		show_police = 3,
		police_talk = 4,
		stage_open = 5,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	--characters
	self.characters = {
		police = function(number)
			return get_character('onigirl_police_' .. number)
		end,
		swat = function()
			return get_character('onigirl_swat')
		end
	}

	-- 퀘스트 오픈 조건 체크
	self.is_before_quest_clear = false
	self.before_quest_id = 364
	self.default_police_count = 5
	self.stage_open_police_number = 6
	self.all_police_count = 9

	--zone
	self.zones = {
		start_zone = 'onigirl_start_zone',
		talk_zone = 'onigirl_open_zone'
	}

	--door
	self.door_name = 'onigirl_door_'

	--item
	self.get_phone_fo = function()
		return get_field_object('onigirl_mall_phone')
	end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	quest_icon_util.pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.sp_manager = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.show_police and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.police(self.stage_open_police_number)) then
		self.current_state = self.states.police_talk
		local is_entered = self.sp_manager:try_start_scene(self.talk_police_event, self)
		if not is_entered then
			self.current_state = self.states.show_police
		end

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.police_talk and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_phone_fo()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.stage_open
		local is_entered = self.sp_manager:try_start_scene(self.stage_open_event, self)
		if not is_entered then
			self.current_state = self.states.police_talk
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.start_zone) then
		self.current_state = self.states.start
		start_coroutine(self.show_start_event, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.start and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.talk_zone) then
		self.current_state = self.states.show_police
		start_coroutine(self.show_police_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion event

function local_class:pre_setting()
	-- civilwar 라나 서브 퀘스트 클리어 체크
	local before_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.before_quest_id)
	self.is_before_quest_clear = before_quest ~= nil and before_quest.IsComplete

	-- 이전 퀘스트를 클리어 했다면 6번째 경찰까지 enable
	for i = 1, self.all_police_count do
		character_util.set_active_state(self.characters.police(i), 'enabled')
	end

	scene_util.set_emotion(self.characters.police(2), self, 'cry')

	if self.is_before_quest_clear then
		local police =  self.characters.police(self.stage_open_police_number)

		character_util.spine_set_attachment(police, '[base]weapon1', 'mall_phone')
		scene_util.set_anim(police, self, 'twohand_idle')

		character_util.set_active_state(self.characters.swat(), 'enabled')

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	else
		local police =  self.characters.police(self.stage_open_police_number)

		character_util.set_active_state(police, 'disabled')
	end
end

--- 첫 진입 시 대화
function local_class:show_start_event()
	local police_1 = self.characters.police(1)
	local police_2 = self.characters.police(2)

	--경찰2 (right, cry, cast) : 엘리… 헨리… 제임스…! 오 안돼…!!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(police_2, 'lw_sub_lana_pre_2', false)

	--경찰1 (right, attack, idle) : 약해지지마! 지금은 전시상황이다!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(police_1, 'lw_sub_lana_pre_1', false)
end

--- 전화후 퀘스트 마커 오픈
function local_class:show_police_event()
	local police = self.characters.police(self.stage_open_police_number)

	--경찰6 (right, tired, hwohand_idle) : 구조 팀, 들리나? 들리면 응답하라, 오버!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glitch_02')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(police, 'lw_sub_lana_pre_6', false)

	--경찰6 (right, tired, hwohand_idle) : 젠장… 누구라도 좋으니 응답하라고…!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(police, 'lw_sub_lana_pre_7', false)

	--이후 경찰6 NPC한테 퀘스트 아이콘 출력됨.
	quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(police)
	--인터렉트 가능하도록
	character_util.add_listener(police, self.controller)
end

--- 스테이지 오픈 이벤트
function local_class:talk_police_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local swat = self.characters.swat()
	local polices = {}
	local fo = self.get_phone_fo()

	for i = 1, self.stage_open_police_number do
		table.insert(polices, self.characters.police(i))
	end

	quest_icon_util.remove(polices[6])
	fo.Position = polices[6].Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0)

	--1초에 걸쳐 ■타일로 right 방향 정렬.
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
	party_util.align_party(polices[6], 'left', 1, 'linear')

	--경찰6 손에 든 mall_phone 아이템 제거하면서 left 방향 전환.
	scene_util.hide_weapon(polices[6])
	scene_util.set_direction(polices[6], 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim(polices[6])

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--경찰6 (left, surprise, jump 1회) : 앗, 당신은…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(polices[6], true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(polices[6], self,
			'left',
			'idle',
			'surprise',
			'lw_sub_lana_pre_8')

	--경찰6 (left, attack, salute) : 여기서 또 뵙는군요! 그 때는 정말 감사드렸습니다!
	--대사 이후 attack 표정 유지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(polices[6], self,
			'left',
			'salute',
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			'lw_sub_lana_pre_9')

	--선택지 출력
	do
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--(intellect)  『누구신지…?』
			{ 'lw_sub_lana_pre_10', 'intellect' },
			--(brutal) 『별 말씀을! 뭔진 모르겠지만.』
			{ 'lw_sub_lana_pre_11', 'brutal' }
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--가디언 (right, tired, bomb_idle 1초)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bomb_idle')
			wait_for_sec(1)
		else
			--가디언 (right, doyagao, cross_arm 1초)
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'doyagao')
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = '01_gatcha_point_01' })
			wait_for_sec(1)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	end

	--경찰6 (left, idle, idle) : 저번에 수도 지역에서 구호 활동을 해주셨던 분 맞으시죠?
	character_util.remove_emotion(polices[6])
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(polices[6], 'lw_sub_lana_pre_12')

	--경찰6 (left, idle, question) : 분명 성함이… $name, 라나, 라라 씨 세분이었던거로 기억하는데…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(polices[6], self,
			'left',
			'question',
			'idle',
			'lw_sub_lana_pre_13')

	--가디언 (right, idle, nod 2회)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, 'nod')

	--선택지 출력
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--(normal)  『여기서 뭐하고 있는거야?』
		{ 'lw_sub_lana_pre_14', 'normal' }
	})

	--가디언 (right, idle, release 2회)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

	--가디언 (right, idle, bomb_idle 1초)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bomb_idle')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	--경찰6 (left, idle, idle) : 저희들은 이곳에서 구조대가 오기를 기다리고 있는 중이었습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(polices[6], self,
			'left',
			'idle',
			'idle',
			'lw_sub_lana_pre_16')

	--경찰6 (left, tired, idle) : …최근에 일어난 일들 때문에 다들 많이 지쳐있는 상태예요.
	scene_util.set_emotion(polices[6], self, 'tired')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(polices[6], 'lw_sub_lana_pre_17')

	--경찰6 (left, tired, idle) : 사람들이 끊임없이 죽어나가고… 마계도 점점 무너져가고 있죠.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(polices[6], 'lw_sub_lana_pre_18')

	--경찰6 (left, tired, cast) : …무고한 사람들이 희생 당하는 걸 더는 보고 싶지 않아요.

function local_class:intro_3_event()
	local police_male = self.characters.police_male()
	character_util.set_position(police_male, self.markers.police_pos(2))
	scene_util.set_direction(police_male, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(police_male, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(police_male, self, 'release')

	local civilian_male = self.characters.civilian_male()
	local civilian_female = self.characters.civilian_female()
	local punk_male = self.characters.punk_male()
	local punk_female = self.characters.punk_female()

	local civilians = {}
	table.insert(civilians, civilian_male)
	table.insert(civilians, civilian_female)
	table.insert(civilians, punk_male)
	table.insert(civilians, punk_female)

	--화면은 ●지점을 포커스한 상태.
	camera_util.move_async(self.markers.camera_pos(4), 0)

	--지점에서 캐릭터들이 생성됨.
	--순서 ( 아래의 순서대로 ■지점에서 순서대로 NPC들이 생성되어 이동하기 시작함./ 각 캐릭터마다 1초의 텀을 둠.)
	--1. demon_civilian_male
	--2. demon_civilian_female
	--3. demon_punk_male
	--4. demon_punk_female
	--■지점에서 생성된 시민 NPC들은 이동속도 5값으로 위쪽으로 run 자세로 달린 뒤, 도착하면 0.5초에 걸쳐 알파 페이드 아웃되며 사라짐.
	--4번 (demon_punk_female) 이후엔 다시 1번 (demon_civilian_male) 순서로 나타나며 출현 반복.
	local civilian_loop = true
	local cur_index = 1
	local start_pos = self.markers.camera_pos(4) + vector(0, 0, -10)
	local end_pos = self.markers.camera_pos(4)

	local run_civilian = function(index)
		character_util.set_position(civilians[index], start_pos)
		character_util.remove_anim(civilians[index])
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(civilians[index], 1, 0)
		wp_util.move_async(civilians[index], end_pos, 5, nil, { run = true })

		if civilian_loop then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(civilians[index], 0, 0.5)
		end
	end

	start_coroutine(function()
		while civilian_loop do
			start_coroutine(run_civilian, cur_index)

			cur_index = (cur_index % #civilians) + 1
			wait_for_sec(1)
		end
	end)

	--1초에 걸쳐 화면 일반 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--대기 0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--경찰 (right, attack, release) : 모두 안쪽으로 대피하세요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(police_male, 'lw_sub_lana_s1_22')

	--경찰 (right, attack, release)  : 최대한 높은 곳으로 피해야 합니다!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(police_male, 'lw_sub_lana_s1_23')

	--1초에 걸쳐 화면 일반 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 3 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	civilian_loop = false
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 시민 루틴 중지
	for i = 1, #civilians do
		character_util.stop(civilians[i])
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(civilians[i], 1, 0)
	end
end

		zone = 2,

		save = 4

		none = 0,
		zone_1 = 1 << 0,
		zone_2 = 1 << 1,
		zone_3 = 1 << 2,

	}

		end,

			return get_character('onigirl_mother')

			return get_character('demon_oldman')
		end,

			return get_character('demon_carpenter')

end

	character_util.stop(self.characters.onigirl_mother())

	if self.thunder_effect ~= nil then
		self.thunder_effect:Dispose()

	end

	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_oldman_state == self.oldman_states.zone and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.oldman()) then
		self.current_oldman_state = self.oldman_states.interact
		sp_util.start_scene(self.oldman_interact_event, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_carpenter_state == self.carpenter_states.zone and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.carpenter()) then
		self.current_carpenter_state = self.carpenter_states.interact
		sp_util.start_scene(self.carpenter_interact_event, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_kid_boy_state == self.kid_boy_states.zone and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.kid_boy()) then
		self.current_kid_boy_state = self.kid_boy_states.interact
		sp_util.start_scene(self.kid_boy_interact_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	for i = 1, self.mother_zone_count do
		local bit_mask = 1 << i

		if (self.current_show_mother_state & bit_mask) == 0 and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.mother_zone(i)) then
			self.current_show_mother_state = self.current_show_mother_state | bit_mask
			start_coroutine(self.onigirl_mother_move, self, i)

			return true
		end
	end

	if self.current_oldman_state == self.oldman_states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.oldman_zone()) then
		self.current_oldman_state = self.oldman_states.zone
		sp_util.start_scene(self.oldman_zone_event, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_carpenter_state == self.carpenter_states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.carpenter_zone()) then
		self.current_carpenter_state = self.carpenter_states.zone
		sp_util.start_scene(self.carpenter_zone_event, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_kid_boy_state == self.kid_boy_states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.kid_boy_zone()) then
		self.current_kid_boy_state = self.kid_boy_states.zone
		sp_util.start_scene(self.kid_boy_zone_event, self)

		return true
	end

	if (self.current_oldman_state == self.oldman_states.interact or
			self.current_carpenter_state == self.carpenter_states.interact or
			self.current_kid_boy_state == self.kid_boy_states.interact) and
					type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.kid_girl_zone()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.safe_civilian, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 시민을 데리고 도착 지점에 옴
function local_class:safe_civilian()
	local stage_controller = get_stage_event_controller('LaboseWorldOnigirlController')
	local onigirl = self.characters.onigirl()
	local npcs = {
		{
			npc = self.characters.oldman(),
			--시민1 (left, smile, nod 1회) : 정말 고맙소, 아가씨!
			talk_key = 'lw_sub_lana_s2_29',
			sfx_key = '03_dialogue_positive_01'
		},
		{
			npc = self.characters.carpenter(),
			--시민2 (left, smile, nod 1회) : 감사합니다! 몸 조심하세요!
			talk_key = 'lw_sub_lana_s2_30',
			sfx_key = '01_rustle_01'
		},
		{
			npc = self.characters.kid_boy(),
			--시민3 (left, smile, nod 1회) : 고마워! 누나도 조심해서 올라와!
			talk_key = 'lw_sub_lana_s2_31',
			sfx_key = '01_bad_fairy_01'
		}
	}

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	local safe_count = 0
	local align_markers = {}
	local safe_npcs = {}

	--1초에 걸쳐 정해진 위치에 라나 right 방향 정렬. 시민 1,2,3은 left 방향 정렬.
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		for j = 1, #npcs do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party[i], npcs[j].npc) then
				safe_count = safe_count + 1
				table.insert(safe_npcs, npcs[j])
			end
		end
	end

	if safe_count == 1 then
		table.insert(align_markers, self.markers.safe_pos(1))
	elseif safe_count == 2 then
		table.insert(align_markers, self.markers.safe_pos(2))
		table.insert(align_markers, self.markers.safe_pos(3))
	else
		table.insert(align_markers, self.markers.safe_pos(4))
		table.insert(align_markers, self.markers.safe_pos(5))
		table.insert(align_markers, self.markers.safe_pos(6))
	end

	local wp_key = 'safe_wp'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(onigirl, self.markers.onigirl_pos(4),
			nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

	for i = 1, #safe_npcs do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(safe_npcs[i].npc, align_markers[i],
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	--라나 (up, idle, release 2회) : 위쪽 건물 옥상으로 올라가면 사람들이 있을 거야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(onigirl, self,
			{ dir = 'up', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'idle',
			'lw_sub_lana_s2_27')

	--라나 (right, idle, idle) : 곧 헬기가 도착한다니까, 거기서 얌전히 대피해있어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(onigirl, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			'idle',
			'idle',
			'lw_sub_lana_s2_28')

	for i = 1, #safe_npcs do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(safe_npcs[i].sfx_key)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(safe_npcs[i].npc, self,
				'left',
				{ name = 'nod', count = 1, one_shot_sfx = false },
				{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
				safe_npcs[i].talk_key)
	end

	--라나 up 방향 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(onigirl, 'up', false)
	--시민 1,2,3 run 자세로 이동속도 5값으로 위쪽으로 8칸 이동하며 화면에서 사라짐.
	for i = 1, #safe_npcs do
		character_util.convert_to_npc(safe_npcs[i].npc)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(safe_npcs[i].npc, safe_npcs[i].npc.Position + vector(0, 0, 10),
				5, nil, self, wp_key, { run = true, play_sfx = true })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	for i = 1, #safe_npcs do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(safe_npcs[i].npc, self.characters.oldman()) then
			self.current_oldman_state = self.oldman_states.save
			stage_controller:safe_oldman_setting()
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(safe_npcs[i].npc, self.characters.carpenter()) then
			self.current_carpenter_state = self.carpenter_states.save
			stage_controller:safe_carpenter_setting()
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(safe_npcs[i].npc, self.characters.kid_boy()) then
			self.current_kid_boy_state = self.kid_boy_states.save
			stage_controller:safe_kid_boy_setting()
		end
	end

	if self.current_oldman_state == self.oldman_states.save and
			self.current_carpenter_state == self.carpenter_states.save and
			self.current_kid_boy_state == self.kid_boy_states.save then
		self:section_end_event()
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end
